# 2) 🔁 Partner Sync — offline, file-based

## a) Server: export / import / watch (`server.js`)
```js
const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path');
const SYNC_DIR = './sync'; const OUT_DIR = path.join(SYNC_DIR,'outgoing'); const IN_DIR = path.join(SYNC_DIR,'incoming');
for(const d of [SYNC_DIR,OUT_DIR,IN_DIR]) if(!fs.existsSync(d)) fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});

// Export all (as single JSON)
app.get("/api/sync/export_all", (req,res)=>{
  const pack = {};
  const tables = ['reward_log','summaries','mood_state','next_actions'];
  let left = tables.length;
  tables.forEach(t=>{
    db.all(`SELECT * FROM ${t}`,[],(e,rows)=>{
      pack[t]=rows||[]; if(--left===0){
        const fname = `aum_sync_${Date.now()}.json`;
        fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT_DIR,fname), JSON.stringify(pack,null,2));
        res.json({ok:true, file:fname, data:pack});
      }
    });
  });
});

// Import (merge) JSON posted
app.post("/api/sync/import", express.json({limit:'5mb'}), (req,res)=>{
  const data = req.body||{};
  const safe = (arr)=>Array.isArray(arr)?arr:[];

  db.serialize(()=>{
    const rl = safe(data.reward_log);     rl.forEach(r=> db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reward_log (id,ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)`,
      [r.id||null, r.ts, r.kind, r.amount, r.note]));
    const sm = safe(data.summaries);      sm.forEach(s=> db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO summaries (id,kind,text,ts) VALUES (?,?,?,?)`,
      [s.id||null, s.kind, s.text, s.ts]));
    const ms = safe(data.mood_state);     ms.forEach(m=> db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO mood_state (id,ts,calm,stress,grateful,connected,note_count) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
      [m.id||null, m.ts, m.calm, m.stress, m.grateful, m.connected, m.note_count]));
    const na = safe(data.next_actions);   na.forEach(a=> db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO next_actions (id,ts,suggestion,source,status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)`,
      [a.id||null, a.ts, a.suggestion, a.source, a.status]));
  });
  res.json({ok:true, merged:true});
});

// Auto-merge any .json dropped to sync/incoming
fs.watch(IN_DIR, (evt, file)=>{
  if(file && file.endsWith('.json')){
    try{
      const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(IN_DIR,file),'utf8');
      const data = JSON.parse(raw);
      // reuse import logic:
      fetch('http://localhost:8080/api/sync/import', {method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(data)});
      console.log('🔁 merged', file);
    }catch(e){ console.log('sync import error', e.message); }
  }
});
```

> Usage: copy the created file from `sync/outgoing/…json` to another device’s `sync/incoming/`, or drop any partner’s JSON into `sync/incoming/` to auto-merge.

```js
               WHERE note IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(note)!=''
```

## 2) Ears – Voice Auto-Tagger (watch folder, read optional transcript)
```js
const VOICE_DIR = './voice';
if (!fs.existsSync(VOICE_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(VOICE_DIR, {recursive:true});

// Helper: read transcript if exists (same basename .txt)
function readTranscriptIfAny(file){
  try{
    const base = file.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    const txp = path.join(VOICE_DIR, base + ".txt");
    if(fs.existsSync(txp)) return fs.readFileSync(txp,'utf8');
  }catch(_){}
  return '';
}

// Watch for new voice files; log pulse + mood from transcript (if any)
fs.watch(VOICE_DIR, (evt, file)=>{
  if(!file || !file.match(/\.(mp3|m4a|wav|ogg)$/i)) return;
  const transcript = readTranscriptIfAny(file);
  const mood = transcript ? moodScore(transcript) : null;

  const kind = transcript && (mood.grateful+mood.connected)>=0.6 ? 'reflect'
             : /active|focus/i.test(file) ? 'focus'
             : 'voice';

  const note = transcript ? transcript.slice(0,280) : `voice:${file}`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),?,?,?)`,
         [kind, 0.10, note]);
  console.log('🎧 Voice logged:', file, '→', kind);
});
```
> Use: drop `voice_*.mp3` into `./voice`. If you also drop `voice_*.txt` with a short transcript, it will bias mood & log the text.

## 3) Hands – Action Planner (3 micro tasks/day from mood + harmony)
```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS actions_plan(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT NOT NULL,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'new'  -- new|done|skipped
)`);

function todayIsoUTC(){ const d=new Date(); d.setUTCHours(0,0,0,0); return d.toISOString().slice(0,19); }

// Compute harmony (last 24h)
function getHarmony(cb){
  const q = `SELECT kind, SUM(amount) s FROM reward_log
             WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-24 hours') GROUP BY kind`;
  db.all(q,[],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return cb(0);
    const f=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='focus')?.s||0),
          r=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='reflect')?.s||0),
          v=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='voice')?.s||0);
    const tot=f+r+v; if(!tot) return cb(0);
    const mean=tot/3, variance=((f-mean)**2+(r-mean)**2+(v-mean)**2)/3;
    const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (100 - Math.sqrt(variance)*300)));
    cb(score);
  });
}

// Generate three lightweight actions based on mood + harmony
app.post("/api/plan/generate", (req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM mood_state ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,m)=>{
    getHarmony(h=>{
      const acts=[];
      if(h<60 || (m?.stress||0)>0.35){
        acts.push("2 slow breaths + 1 gratitude word");
        acts.push("Write one feeling → one insight (≤1 line)");
        acts.push("Short walk or water break (2 min)");
      } else if(h>80 || ((m?.grateful||0)+(m?.connected||0))>0.7){
        acts.push("Ship one tiny task (<2 min) and mark Focus");
        acts.push("Copy Share Pack (Today) to partner chat");
        acts.push("Record 10-sec Voice with mood tag");
      } else {
        acts.push("Review Energy chart 30s and pick one focus");
        acts.push("Write a one-line Reflection");
        acts.push("Check Micro-Coach → press Done once");
      }
      const now = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19);
      db.serialize(()=>{
        acts.forEach(a=> db.run(`INSERT INTO actions_plan(ts,text) VALUES(?,?)`,[now,a]));
      });
      res.json({ok:true, actions:acts});
    });
  });
});

app.get("/api/plan/list", (req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM actions_plan WHERE ts >= ? ORDER BY id DESC`,[todayIsoUTC()],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
app.post("/api/plan/act", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {id, status} = req.body||{};
  if(!id || !status) return res.json({ok:false,error:'bad args'});
  db.run(`UPDATE actions_plan SET status=? WHERE id=?`,[status,id],(e)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    if(status==='done'){
      db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),'focus',0.10,'plan_done')`);
    }
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});
```

## 4) Spine – Stability Thread (daily backup + restore)
```js
const BK_DIR = './backups';
if(!fs.existsSync(BK_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(BK_DIR,{recursive:true});

function backupNow(){
  const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:T]/g,'-').slice(0,16);
  const out = path.join(BK_DIR, `aum_${stamp}.db`);
  fs.copyFileSync('./aum_data.db', out);
  // keep last 7
  const files = fs.readdirSync(BK_DIR).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.db')).sort();
  while(files.length>7){ const rm=files.shift(); fs.unlinkSync(path.join(BK_DIR,rm)); }
  return out;
}

// Daily at 00:10
cron.schedule('10 0 * * *', ()=>{ try{ const f=backupNow(); console.log('💾 backup', f); }catch(e){ console.log('backup fail', e.message);} });

// Manual
app.get("/api/backup/now", (req,res)=>{
  try{ const f=backupNow(); res.json({ok:true,file:path.basename(f)}); }
  catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
app.get("/api/backup/list", (req,res)=>{
  const files = fs.readdirSync(BK_DIR).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.db')).sort();
  res.json({ok:true, files});
});
app.post("/api/backup/restore", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {file} = req.body||{};
  if(!file) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing file'});
  const src = path.join(BK_DIR,file);
  if(!fs.existsSync(src)) return res.json({ok:false,error:'not found'});
  fs.copyFileSync(src, './aum_data.db');
  res.json({ok:true, restored:file});
});
```

```js
// 🧩 System Check organ — status of all AUMNITY organs
app.get("/api/system/check", async (req,res)=>{
  try {
    const result = {
      db_alive: false,
      last_backup_hours: null,
      last_mood_hours: null,
      voice_watch: fs.existsSync('./voice'),
      planner_today: false,
      reminder_alive: true, // assumed for now
      harmony: 0
    };

    // 1️⃣ DB alive
    await new Promise((ok, fail)=>{
      db.get("SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log",[],(e,r)=>{
        if(!e) { result.db_alive=true; ok(); } else fail(e);
      });
    });

    // 2️⃣ Last backup
    const bkDir='./backups';
    if(fs.existsSync(bkDir)){
      const files = fs.readdirSync(bkDir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.db')).sort();
      if(files.length){
        const last = files[files.length-1];
        const ts = fs.statSync(path.join(bkDir,last)).mtime;
        result.last_backup_hours = Math.round((Date.now()-ts.getTime())/36e5);
      }
    }

    // 3️⃣ Last mood update
    const row = await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.get(`SELECT ts FROM mood_state ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,r)=>ok(r));
    });
    if(row){
      const t = new Date(row.ts+"Z");
      result.last_mood_hours = Math.round((Date.now()-t.getTime())/36e5);
    }

    // 4️⃣ Planner today?
    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    const row2 = await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.get(`SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM actions_plan WHERE ts>=?`,[today+"T00:00:00"],(e,r)=>ok(r));
    });
    result.planner_today = row2 && row2.c>0;

    // 5️⃣ Harmony
    await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.all(`SELECT kind,SUM(amount) s FROM reward_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-24 hours') GROUP BY kind`,[],(e,rows)=>{
        if(!e && rows.length){
          const f=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='focus')?.s||0);
          const r2=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='reflect')?.s||0);
          const v=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='voice')?.s||0);
          const tot=f+r2+v; if(tot>0){
            const mean=tot/3; const variance=((f-mean)**2+(r2-mean)**2+(v-mean)**2)/3;
            result.harmony=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(100 - Math.sqrt(variance)*300)));
          }
        }
        ok();
      });
    });

    // Overall
    let score=0, parts=0;
    if(result.db_alive) score+=1; parts++;
    if(result.last_backup_hours!==null && result.last_backup_hours<24) score+=1; parts++;
    if(result.last_mood_hours!==null && result.last_mood_hours<12) score+=1; parts++;
    if(result.planner_today) score+=1; parts++;
    if(result.harmony>50) score+=1; parts++;
    const pct=Math.round((score/parts)*100);
    result.overall=pct;

    res.json({ok:true,result});
  } catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

```js
// 🎧 Daily System Voice Report
const { exec } = require("child_process");
const SYS_VOICE_DIR = "./voice_reports";
if (!fs.existsSync(SYS_VOICE_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(SYS_VOICE_DIR, { recursive: true });

// Function to create short voice file describing system health
async function speakSystemHealth(){
  try {
    const js = await fetch("http://localhost:8080/api/system/check").then(r=>r.json());
    if(!js.ok) throw new Error("check failed");
    const r = js.result;
    const health = r.overall;
    let mood = "calm and balanced";
    if(health < 50) mood = "drifting, needs gentle care";
    else if(health < 80) mood = "steady but watchful";

    const message = `Aumnity system report. Overall health ${health} percent, feeling ${mood}. 
    Backup age ${r.last_backup_hours} hours, harmony level ${r.harmony.toFixed(1)}.`;

    // Save text for record
    const fileBase = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,16).replace(/[:T]/g,'-');
    const textFile = path.join(SYS_VOICE_DIR, `report_${fileBase}.txt`);
    fs.writeFileSync(textFile, message);

    // Use OS TTS (macOS 'say', Windows 'PowerShell', Linux 'espeak')
    if (process.platform === "darwin") exec(`say "${message}"`);
    else if (process.platform === "win32") exec(`PowerShell -Command "Add-Type –AssemblyName System.Speech; (New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer).Speak('${message}');"`);
    else exec(`espeak "${message}"`);
    console.log("🗣️ System health spoken:", message);
  } catch(e){ console.log("Voice report error:", e.message); }
}

// schedule every day 09:00
cron.schedule("0 9 * * *", speakSystemHealth);
```

## 1) Phase 1 – Collect signals (today)
```js
// Pull today's check-ins & reflections (from reward_log)
async function collectTodaySignals(){
  const since = isoTodayStart();
  const q = `SELECT ts, kind, amount, COALESCE(note,'') note
             FROM reward_log WHERE ts >= ? ORDER BY ts ASC`;
  return await new Promise(ok=>{
    db.all(q,[since],(e,rows)=> ok(e?[]:rows));
  });
}
```

## 2) Phase 2 – Analyse tone (calm / stress / grateful / connected)
```js
function analyseToneFromNotes(rows){
  const notes = rows.map(r=>r.note).filter(t=>t && t.trim());
  if(!notes.length) return {calm:0, stress:0, grateful:0, connected:0, basis:0};
  let agg={calm:0,stress:0,grateful:0,connected:0};
  notes.forEach(t=>{ const s=moodScore(t); for(const k in agg) agg[k]+=s[k]; });
  for(const k in agg) agg[k] = +(agg[k]/notes.length).toFixed(3);
  return {...agg, basis: notes.length};
}
```

## 3) Phase 3 – Generate the Human Mirror line
```js
async function getSystemHealth(){
  try{
    const js = await fetch("http://localhost:8080/api/system/check").then(r=>r.json());
    return js.ok ? js.result : { overall:0, harmony:0 };
  }catch{ return { overall:0, harmony:0 }; }
}

function craftMirrorLine({tone, health, signals}){
  const h = health.harmony||0, overall = health.overall||0;
  const calm = tone.calm||0, stress=tone.stress||0, grat=tone.grateful||0, conn=tone.connected||0;
  const flow = (grat+conn)/2, tension = stress;

  let msgCore = "steady and aware";
  if(h>=80 && flow>0.45) msgCore = "in sync — clarity is flowing";
  else if(h<60 && tension>0.35) msgCore = "a little strained — softness will help";
  else if(h>=60 && h<80) msgCore = flow>tension ? "rebalancing — gentle momentum" : "rebalancing — ease first";

  const acts = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='focus').length;
  const refl = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='reflect').length;
  const voice = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='voice').length;

  const line = `Human Mirror — Today you and AUMNITY feel ${msgCore}. `
    + `Harmony ${h.toFixed(0)}%, System ${overall}%. `
    + `Signals: focus ${acts}, reflect ${refl}, voice ${voice}.`;

  return line;
}
```

## 4) Phase 4 – Store + (optional) speak
```js
async function generateHumanMirror({speak=false}={}){
  const signals = await collectTodaySignals();
  const tone = analyseToneFromNotes(signals);
  const health = await getSystemHealth();
  const line = craftMirrorLine({tone, health, signals});

  // store in summaries
  db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES(?,?,datetime('now'))`, ['mirror', line]);

  if(speak){
    const msg = line.replaceAll('"','').replaceAll("'", "");
    if (process.platform === "darwin") require('child_process').exec(`say "${msg}"`);
    else if (process.platform === "win32") require('child_process').exec(`PowerShell -Command "Add-Type –AssemblyName System.Speech; (New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer).Speak('${msg}');"`);
    else require('child_process').exec(`espeak "${msg}"`);
  }
  return line;
}
```

# 🧠 `server.js` — add these blocks

## 1) API: build weekly summary (last 7 days of ‘mirror’)
```js
function weekRange() {
  const end = new Date(); // now
  const start = new Date(Date.now() - 6*24*3600*1000); // last 7 days window
  const iso = d => d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
  return { start: iso(start), end: iso(end) };
}

function craftWeeklyParagraph(lines=[], meta={}) {
  // lines: [{text, ts}], meta: {avgHarmony, days, mirrors}
  const { avgHarmony=0, days=0, mirrors=0 } = meta;
  const feel = avgHarmony>=80 ? "in flow"
             : avgHarmony>=60 ? "rebalancing"
             : "grounding";
  const open = `Week in Reflection — ${feel} (${avgHarmony.toFixed(1)}% harmony avg, ${mirrors} mirrors over ${days} days).`;
  const picks = lines.slice(-3).map(x => `• ${x.text}`);
  return [open, "", ...picks].join("\n");
}

app.get("/api/mirror/weekly_generate", (req,res)=>{
  const { start, end } = weekRange();
  const sql = `
    WITH mirrors AS (
      SELECT text, ts FROM summaries
      WHERE kind='mirror' AND DATE(ts) BETWEEN DATE(?) AND DATE(?)
      ORDER BY ts ASC
    ), signals AS (
      SELECT kind, SUM(amount) s FROM reward_log
      WHERE DATE(ts) BETWEEN DATE(?) AND DATE(?)
      GROUP BY kind
    )
    SELECT
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DATE(ts) d FROM mirrors GROUP BY d)) AS days,
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mirrors) AS mirrors,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='focus' THEN s END),0) FROM signals) AS f,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='reflect' THEN s END),0) FROM signals) AS r,
      (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='voice' THEN s END),0) FROM signals) AS v
  `;
  db.all(`SELECT text, ts FROM summaries WHERE kind='mirror' AND DATE(ts) BETWEEN DATE(?) AND DATE(?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [start, end], (e, rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    db.get(sql, [start,end,start,end], (e2, agg)=>{
      if(e2) return res.json({ok:false,error:e2.message});
      // harmony proxy from f/r/v balance
      const f=+agg.f||0, r=+agg.r||0, v=+agg.v||0;
      let avgHarmony=0; const tot=f+r+v;
      if(tot>0){ const m=tot/3, varc=((f-m)**2+(r-m)**2+(v-m)**2)/3; avgHarmony=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(100-Math.sqrt(varc)*300))); }
      const text = craftWeeklyParagraph(rows||[], {avgHarmony, days:+agg.days||0, mirrors:+agg.mirrors||0});
      const stamp = `${start} → ${end}`;
      db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind, text, ts) VALUES(?,?, datetime('now'))`, ['weekly_mirror', `(${stamp})\n${text}`], ()=>{
        res.json({ok:true, range:stamp, text});
      });
    });
  });
});

// Latest weekly summary
app.get("/api/mirror/weekly_latest", (req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT text, ts FROM summaries WHERE kind='weekly_mirror' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,row)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, text: row?.text||null, ts: row?.ts||null});
  });
});

// Auto every Sunday 09:15
cron.schedule("15 9 * * 0", ()=>{ 
  // speak optional: reuse system TTS if you like
  fetch("http://localhost:8080/api/mirror/weekly_generate").catch(()=>{});
});
```

## `server.js` (config + scheduler)
```js
// Config table (if not already present)
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config(k TEXT PRIMARY KEY, v TEXT)`);

// helpers
function cfgGet(k, def, cb){
  db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k=?`,[k],(e,row)=> cb(row?row.v:def));
}
function cfgSet(k, v){ db.run(`INSERT INTO config(k,v) VALUES(?,?) ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v`,[k,String(v)]) }

// default flags
cfgSet('reminders_enabled','1');            // master toggle
cfgSet('rem_2100_enabled','1');             // 21:00 daily check-in
cfgSet('rem_2105_enabled','1');             // 21:05 voice prompt

// routes to read/update flags
app.get("/api/reminders/status",(req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT k,v FROM config WHERE k LIKE 'rem_%' OR k='reminders_enabled'`,[],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    const map={}; rows.forEach(r=>map[r.k]=r.v); res.json({ok:true, ...map});
  });
});
app.post("/api/reminders/toggle", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { key, on } = req.body||{};
  if(!key) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing key'});
  cfgSet(key, on?'1':'0'); res.json({ok:true});
});

// fire functions
function fire2100(){
  db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES(?,?,datetime('now'))`,
    ['reminder', '21:00 — Write one-line Progress (moved/pending)']);
  console.log('🔔 21:00 reminder logged');
}
function fire2105(){
  db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES(?,?,datetime('now'))`,
    ['reminder', '21:05 — Drop 10-sec Voice (mood tag)']);
  console.log('🔔 21:05 reminder logged');
}

// cron schedules (local server time)
cron.schedule('0 21 * * *', ()=> cfgGet('reminders_enabled','1',m=>{
  if(m!=='1') return;
  cfgGet('rem_2100_enabled','1',v=>{ if(v==='1') fire2100(); });
}));
cron.schedule('5 21 * * *', ()=> cfgGet('reminders_enabled','1',m=>{
  if(m!=='1') return;
  cfgGet('rem_2105_enabled','1',v=>{ if(v==='1') fire2105(); });
}));
```

```json
  ]

```

## `sw.js` (very small offline cache)
```js
const CACHE='aumnity-v1';
const ASSETS=[
  '/aum_dashboard.html','/manifest.json','/sw.js'
];
self.addEventListener('install',e=>{
  e.waitUntil(caches.open(CACHE).then(c=>c.addAll(ASSETS)));
});
self.addEventListener('fetch',e=>{
  e.respondWith(
    caches.match(e.request).then(r=> r || fetch(e.request).then(res=>{
      const copy=res.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(c=>c.put(e.request,copy)); return res;
    }))
  );
});
```

## Add to `<head>` of `aum_dashboard.html`
```html
<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#66e6a8">
<script>
if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
  window.addEventListener('load', ()=> navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js'));
}
</script>
```

> After serving your dashboard (e.g., http://localhost:8080/aum_dashboard.html), open it on your phone → menu → “Install app” / “Add to Home screen”.

## 4) Wire **streak** rules (hours + threshold) into a simple streak checker

### Add a small API to `server.js`
```js
function getCfgNumber(key, def){
  return new Promise(ok => db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k=?`, [key], (e,row)=>{
    const n = Number(row?.v); ok(Number.isFinite(n) ? n : def);
  }));
}

app.get("/api/streak/status", async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const hours = await getCfgNumber('streak_hours', 3);
    const need  = await getCfgNumber('streak_threshold', 70);
    const since = `-${hours} hours`;

    db.all(`SELECT kind, SUM(amount) s FROM reward_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY kind`,
      [since], (e,rows)=>{
        if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
        const f=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='focus')?.s||0),
              r=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='reflect')?.s||0),
              v=+(rows.find(r=>r.kind==='voice')?.s||0);
        const tot=f+r+v;
        let harmony=0; if(tot>0){ const m=tot/3; const varc=((f-m)**2+(r-m)**2+(v-m)**2)/3;
          harmony=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(100 - Math.sqrt(varc)*300)));
        }
        res.json({ok:true, hours, need, harmony, pass: harmony>=need});
    });
  }catch(err){ res.json({ok:false,error:err.message}); }
});
```

```js
async function craftMirrorLine({tone, health, signals}){
  // read live config
  const gMin   = await getCfgNumber('harmony_green_min', 80);
  const yMin   = await getCfgNumber('harmony_yellow_min', 60);
  const flowMin= await getCfgNumber('mirror_flow_min',    0.70);
  const stressH= await getCfgNumber('mirror_stress_high', 0.35);

  const h = health.harmony||0, overall = health.overall||0;
  const calm = tone.calm||0, stress=tone.stress||0, grat=tone.grateful||0, conn=tone.connected||0;
  const flow = (grat+conn)/2, tension = stress;

  let msgCore = "steady and aware";
  if(h>=gMin && flow>flowMin)          msgCore = "in sync — clarity is flowing";
  else if(h<yMin && tension>stressH)   msgCore = "a little strained — softness will help";
  else if(h>=yMin && h<gMin)           msgCore = flow>tension ? "rebalancing — gentle momentum"
                                                              : "rebalancing — ease first";

  const acts  = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='focus').length;
  const refl  = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='reflect').length;
  const voice = signals.filter(r=>r.kind==='voice').length;

  return `Human Mirror — Today you and AUMNITY feel ${msgCore}. `
       + `Harmony ${h.toFixed(0)}%, System ${overall}%. `
       + `Signals: focus ${acts}, reflect ${refl}, voice ${voice}.`;
}
```

```js
  share_reflection INTEGER DEFAULT 1,

)`);
```

### b) CRUD + defaults
```js
app.post("/api/partners/add", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {name, role='human'} = req.body||{};
  if(!name) return res.json({ok:false,error:'name required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partners(name,role) VALUES(?,?)`,[name,role], e=>{
    if(e && !String(e.message).includes('UNIQUE')) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});
app.get("/api/partners/list", (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM partners ORDER BY id ASC`,[],(e,rows)=> res.json({ok:!e, rows}));
});
app.post("/api/partners/set", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {id, key, value} = req.body||{};
  if(!id || !key) return res.json({ok:false,error:'bad args'});
  db.run(`UPDATE partners SET ${key}=? WHERE id=?`,[value, id], e=> res.json({ok:!e}));
});

// seed (safe to call anytime)
app.post("/api/partners/seed", (_req,res)=>{
  const seed = [
    ['You','human'], ['Text Brother','text'], ['Voice Sister','voice']
  ];
  seed.forEach(([n,r])=> db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO partners(name,role) VALUES(?,?)`,[n,r]));
  res.json({ok:true});
});
```

### c) Share Pack generator (respects toggles)
```js
function buildDailyForWindow(startISO, endISO, cb){
  // pull minimal slices respecting time window
  db.all(`SELECT ts,kind,amount,note FROM reward_log WHERE ts BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY ts ASC`,
    [startISO, endISO], (e,rows)=>{
      if(e) return cb(e);
      const f = rows.filter(r=>r.kind==='focus');
      const r = rows.filter(r=>r.kind==='reflect');
      const v = rows.filter(r=>r.kind==='voice');
      // tiny stats
      const tot = f.length + r.length + v.length;
      cb(null, {f, r, v, tot});
  });
}

function redact(text){ return (text||'').replace(/\b(\w{2})\w{2,}(\w{2})\b/g,'$1***$2'); } // light privacy

app.post("/api/share/generate", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, kind='daily' } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false,error:'partner_id required'});

  db.get(`SELECT * FROM partners WHERE id=?`,[partner_id], (e,p)=>{
    if(e||!p) return res.json({ok:false,error:'partner not found'});

    // window = today
    const start = new Date(); start.setUTCHours(0,0,0,0);
    const end = new Date();   end.setUTCHours(23,59,59,999);
    const startISO = start.toISOString().slice(0,19);
    const endISO   = end.toISOString().slice(0,19);

    buildDailyForWindow(startISO, endISO, (e2,data)=>{
      if(e2) return res.json({ok:false,error:e2.message});
      const lines = [];
      lines.push(`# AUMNITY Share Pack — ${kind} (${startISO.slice(0,10)})`);
      lines.push(`Partner: ${p.name} (${p.role})`);

      if(p.share_stats) {
        lines.push(`\n## Stats\n• Focus: ${data.f.length}\n• Reflect: ${data.r.length}\n• Voice: ${data.v.length}`);
      }
      if(p.share_progress){
        const prog = data.f.slice(-3).map(x=>`- ${x.note||'focus'}`).join('\n') || '- (none)';
        lines.push(`\n## Progress (last items)\n${prog}`);
      }
      if(p.share_reflection){
        const refl = data.r.slice(-3).map(x=>`- ${redact(x.note)||'—'}`).join('\n') || '- (none)';
        lines.push(`\n## Reflection (last items)\n${refl}`);
      }
      if(p.share_voice){
        const voc = data.v.slice(-2).map(x=>`- ${x.note||'voice'}`).join('\n') || '- (none)';
        lines.push(`\n## Voice Highlights\n${voc}`);
      }

      const text = lines.join('\n');
      db.run(`INSERT INTO share_logs(partner_id,kind,text) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[partner_id, kind, text], ()=>{
        res.json({ok:true, text});
      });
    });
  });
});

app.get("/api/share/history", (req,res)=>{
  const pid = req.query.partner_id;
  db.all(`SELECT id,kind,text,ts FROM share_logs WHERE partner_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10`,[pid],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```

### 🧩 1) Add this route in `server.js`
```js
app.post("/api/share/generate_weekly", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {partner_id} = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false,error:'partner_id required'});

  const now = new Date();
  const end = new Date(); end.setUTCHours(23,59,59,999);
  const start = new Date(now - 7*86400e3); start.setUTCHours(0,0,0,0);
  const sISO=start.toISOString().slice(0,19), eISO=end.toISOString().slice(0,19);

  db.get(`SELECT * FROM partners WHERE id=?`,[partner_id], (e,p)=>{
    if(e||!p) return res.json({ok:false,error:'partner not found'});

    db.all(`SELECT * FROM reward_log WHERE ts BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY ts ASC`,[sISO,eISO], (e2,rows)=>{
      if(e2) return res.json({ok:false,error:e2.message});

      const byType = t => rows.filter(r=>r.kind===t);
      const f=byType('focus'), r=byType('reflect'), v=byType('voice');

      let out = [`# AUMNITY Weekly Share Pack (${sISO.slice(0,10)} → ${eISO.slice(0,10)})`,
                 `Partner: ${p.name} (${p.role})`];

      if(p.share_stats) out.push(`\n## Summary\nFocus: ${f.length}\nReflect: ${r.length}\nVoice: ${v.length}`);
      if(p.share_progress) out.push(`\n## Highlights\n${f.slice(-5).map(x=>`- ${x.note||'focus'}`).join('\n')||'– (none)'}`);
      if(p.share_reflection) out.push(`\n## Reflections\n${r.slice(-5).map(x=>`- ${x.note||'—'}`).join('\n')||'– (none)'}`);
      if(p.share_voice) out.push(`\n## Voice Moments\n${v.slice(-3).map(x=>`- ${x.note||'voice'}`).join('\n')||'– (none)'}`);

      const text=out.join('\n');
      db.run(`INSERT INTO share_logs(partner_id,kind,text)VALUES(?,?,?)`,[partner_id,'weekly',text],()=>res.json({ok:true,text}));
    });
  });
});
```

# 1) `server.js` — backend for tags & search

## a) Tables
```js
// Tags + link to reward_log entries (notes/progress/voice)
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reward_log_tags(
  entry_id INTEGER,
  tag_id INTEGER,
  UNIQUE(entry_id, tag_id)
)`);
```

## b) Tag helpers
```js
function ensureTag(name){
  return new Promise((ok)=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO tags(name) VALUES(?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING`,[name],()=>{
      db.get(`SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name=?`,[name],(e,row)=> ok(row?.id||null));
    });
  });
}
function linkTag(entryId, tagId){
  return new Promise(ok=>{
    db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reward_log_tags(entry_id, tag_id) VALUES(?,?)`,[entryId, tagId],()=> ok(true));
  });
}
```

## c) Add tags when capturing (patch your existing `/api/capture`)
Replace your current insert with this version that returns `entry_id` and applies tags sent as array:

```js
app.post("/api/capture", express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const { kind, note, amount, tags=[] } = req.body||{};
  if(!['focus','reflect','voice'].includes(kind)) return res.json({ok:false,error:'bad kind'});
  const amt = Number.isFinite(+amount) ? +amount : 0.25;

  db.run(
    `INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),?,?,?)`,
    [kind, amt, (note||'').slice(0,280)],
    async function(e){
      if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
      const entryId = this.lastID;

      // attach tags if provided
      if(Array.isArray(tags)){
        for(const t of tags){
          const id = await ensureTag(String(t).trim().toLowerCase());
          if(id) await linkTag(entryId, id);
        }
      }
      res.json({ok:true, entry_id:entryId});
    }
  );
});
```

## d) Auto-tag rules (tiny, config-driven)
```js
// Config: comma lists (edit in Config UI later if you wish)
cfgSet('autotag_focus',   'work,code,task,office');
cfgSet('autotag_reflect', 'gratitude,learned,insight,feeling');
cfgSet('autotag_voice',   'voice,walk,idea,record');

// Hook: when an entry is added (focus/reflect/voice), assign any matching tags
function words(s){ return (s||'').toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]+/g)||[]; }
async function autoTagEntry(entryId, kind, note){
  const listKey = kind==='focus'?'autotag_focus':(kind==='reflect'?'autotag_reflect':'autotag_voice');
  const kw = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k=?`,[listKey],(e,row)=>ok((row?.v||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean))));
  const w = new Set(words(note));
  for(const k of kw){ if(w.has(k)){ const id=await ensureTag(k); if(id) await linkTag(entryId,id); } }
}
// Patch capture to call it after insert:
```

## e) Search API
```js
app.get("/api/search", (req,res)=>{
  const q = (req.query.q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const since = req.query.since || ''; // ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD' optional
  const tag = (req.query.tag||'').trim().toLowerCase();

  // base filter
  const params = [];
  let where = '1=1';
  if(q){
    where += ` AND (LOWER(note) LIKE ? OR LOWER(kind) LIKE ?)`;
    params.push(`%${q}%`,`%${q}%`);
  }
  if(since){
    where += ` AND ts >= ?`;
    params.push(`${since}T00:00:00`);
  }

  const byTagJoin = tag ? `
    JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.entry_id = reward_log.id
    JOIN tags t ON t.id = rlt.tag_id AND LOWER(t.name)=?
  ` : '';
  if(tag) params.push(tag);

  const sql = `
    SELECT reward_log.id, ts, kind, amount, note,
           GROUP_CONCAT(t2.name, ',') AS tags
    FROM reward_log
    ${byTagJoin}
    LEFT JOIN reward_log_tags r2 ON r2.entry_id = reward_log.id
    LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON t2.id = r2.tag_id
    WHERE ${where}
    GROUP BY reward_log.id
    ORDER BY ts DESC
    LIMIT 200`;

  db.all(sql, params, (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});

app.get("/api/tags", (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT id,name FROM tags ORDER BY name ASC`,[],(e,rows)=> res.json({ok:!e, rows}));
});
```

```html
<section class="card span12">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🔎 Search</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <input id="sQuery" placeholder="text…" style="min-width:220px;flex:1">
    <input id="sSince" type="date">
    <select id="sTag" style="min-width:160px"><option value="">— tag —</option></select>

    <span id="sNote" class="mut">—</span>

</section>

<script>
async function sLoadTags(){
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/tags')).json();
  if(!js.ok) return;
  sTag.innerHTML = '<option value="">— tag —</option>' + (js.rows||[]).map(t=>`<option>${t.name}</option>`).join('');
}
async function sSearch(){
  sNote.textContent='…';
  const q = sQuery.value.trim();
  const since = sSince.value || '';
  const tag = sTag.value || '';
  const qs = new URLSearchParams({q, since, tag}).toString();
  const js = await (await fetch(`${UAPI}/search?${qs}`)).json();
  if(!js.ok){ sNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  const fmt = r => {
    const ts = new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString();
    const tg = r.tags? ` <span class="mut">[${r.tags}]</span>`:'';
    return `<div style="border-bottom:1px solid #223; padding:6px 2px">
      <b>${r.kind}</b> • ${ts}${tg}<br><span class="mut">${(r.note||'').replaceAll('<','&lt;')}</span>
    </div>`;
  };
  sRes.innerHTML = (js.rows||[]).map(fmt).join('') || '<i>No matches</i>';
  sNote.textContent = `Results: ${(js.rows||[]).length}`;
}
function sCopyAll(){
  const divs = Array.from(sRes.querySelectorAll('div'));
  const text = divs.map(d=>d.innerText).join('\n\n');
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  sNote.textContent='Copied ✓';
}
sGo.addEventListener('click', sSearch);
sCopy.addEventListener('click', sCopyAll);
window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{ sLoadTags(); });
</script>
```

```js
// ✅ single-key get
app.get("/api/config", (req, res) => {
  const k = req.query.k;
  if (!k) return res.json({ ok:false, error:"missing key" });
  db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k=?`, [k], (e,row)=>{
    if (e) return res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
    res.json({ ok:true, v: row?.v ?? "" });
  });
});

// ✅ single-key set
app.post("/api/config", express.json(), (req, res) => {
  const { k, v } = req.body || {};
  if (!k) return res.json({ ok:false, error:"missing key" });
  db.run(`INSERT INTO config(k,v) VALUES(?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v`, [k, String(v)], (e)=>{
    if (e) return res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
    res.json({ ok:true });
  });
});
```

# 🧩 `server.js` — add a batch reset endpoint

```js
// Reset core config keys to sensible defaults
app.post("/api/config/reset_defaults", (_req, res) => {
  const defaults = {
    // thresholds
    harmony_green_min:  "80",
    harmony_yellow_min: "60",
    streak_hours:       "3",
    streak_threshold:   "70",
    mirror_flow_min:    "0.70",
    mirror_stress_high: "0.35",
    // auto-tags
    autotag_focus:      "work,code,task,office",
    autotag_reflect:    "gratitude,learned,insight,feeling",
    autotag_voice:      "voice,walk,idea,record"
  };
  const stmt = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO config(k,v) VALUES(?,?)
                           ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v`);
  try{
    for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(defaults)) stmt.run(k, String(v));
    stmt.finalize();
    res.json({ ok:true, defaults });
  }catch(e){
    res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
  }
});
```

## b) Storage (place near other init)
```js
// --- Voice store
const VOICE_DIR = path.resolve('./voices');
if (!fs.existsSync(VOICE_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(VOICE_DIR, { recursive: true });

// multer for uploads
const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  destination: (_req, _file, cb)=> cb(null, VOICE_DIR),
  filename: (_req, file, cb)=>{
    const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-');
    const ext = path.extname(file.originalname||'') || '.webm';
    cb(null, `voice_${ts}${ext}`);
  }
});
const upload = multer({ storage });
```

```js
// Upload a voice clip
app.post('/api/voice/upload', upload.single('audio'), async (req,res)=>{
  if(!req.file) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no file'});
  const { path:filepath, filename } = req.file;
  const mode = await getCfgNumber('transcription_mode', NaN); // we'll read string below instead
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),'voice',0.25,?)`,
    [`[voice] ${filename}`], async function(e){
      if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
      const entry_id = this.lastID;
      res.json({ok:true, entry_id, file: filename});
    });
});

// List last N voice files
app.get('/api/voice/list',(req,res)=>{
  const files = fs.readdirSync(VOICE_DIR).filter(f=>f.startsWith('voice_')).sort().reverse().slice(0,50);
  res.json({ok:true, files});
});

// Transcribe a stored file (by filename)
app.post('/api/voice/transcribe', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const { file } = req.body||{};
  if(!file) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing file'});
  const mode = (await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='transcription_mode'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'none'))));
  try{
    const full = path.join(VOICE_DIR, file);
    let text = '';

    if(mode==='openai'){
      const apiKey = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_api_key'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'')));
      const model  = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_model'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'whisper-1')));
      if(!apiKey) return res.json({ok:false,error:'OPENAI key missing'});
      // minimal OpenAI transcription (needs node-fetch  or global fetch in Node 18+)
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('file', fs.createReadStream(full));
      form.append('model', model);
      const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions',{
        method:'POST',
        headers:{ 'Authorization':`Bearer ${apiKey}` },
        body: form
      });
      const j = await r.json();
      if(!j.text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'whisper failed', detail:j});
      text = j.text;
    } else if(mode==='offline'){
      // Hook to your local pipeline (e.g., whisper.cpp) — placeholder:
      // Example: run `./main -m models/ggml-base.en.bin -f voices/<file> -of tmp.txt`
      // Here we just mark as pending.
      text = '(pending offline transcription)';
    } else {
      text = '(transcription disabled)';
    }

    // Basic emotion from text (very light heuristic; you’ll refine later)
    const low = text.toLowerCase();
    const happy = /(grateful|calm|okay|good|relief|peace)/.test(low) ? 1:0;
    const stress= /(tired|stress|worry|angry|sad|overwhelm)/.test(low) ? 1:0;

    // Save as reflection + tags
    const note = text.slice(0, 500);
    db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),'reflect',0.25,?)`,
      [note], async function(err2){
        if(err2) return res.json({ok:false,error:err2.message});
        const entry_id = this.lastID;
        // auto-tags based on simple heuristics + filename
        const tags = ['voice'];
        if(happy) tags.push('gratitude','calm');
        if(stress) tags.push('stress');
        for(const t of tags){
          const id = await ensureTag(t); if(id) await linkTag(entry_id,id);
        }
        // Generate a Human Mirror line now (uses your existing craftMirrorLine)
        try{
          const tone = { calm: happy?0.7:0.3, stress: stress?0.6:0.2, grateful: happy?0.8:0.2, connected: 0.6 };
          const health = { harmony: 65, overall: 70 };
          const signals = [{kind:'voice'}]; // light touch; your real generator already aggregates
          const line = await craftMirrorLine({tone, health, signals});
          db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES('mirror',?,datetime('now'))`,[line]);
        }catch(_){ /* ignore */ }

        res.json({ok:true, text, tags});
      });

  }catch(e){
    res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
  }
});
```

Paste this card anywhere in your dashboard:

```html
<section class="card span12">
  <h3 style="margin:0 8px 8px 0">🎤 Voice</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button id="vStart">● Record</button>
    <button id="vStop" class="secondary" disabled>■ Stop</button>
    <button id="vListBtn" class="secondary">Refresh List</button>
    <label style="margin-left:12px">Mode:
      <select id="vMode">
        <option value="none">none</option>
        <option value="openai">openai</option>
        <option value="offline">offline</option>
      </select>
    </label>
    <span id="vNote" class="mut">—</span>
  </div>
  <div id="vLevel" style="height:6px;background:#333;border-radius:4px;margin-top:8px; overflow:hidden">
    <div id="vBar" style="height:100%;width:0%;background:var(--accent)"></div>
  </div>
  <div id="vFiles" class="mut" style="margin-top:8px;max-height:180px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid #222;border-radius:8px;padding:8px"></div>
</section>

<script>
let mediaRecorder, chunks=[], analyser, raf, audioCtx, source, vStream;

async function setTranscriptionMode(val){
  await fetch(UAPI+'/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
    body: JSON.stringify({k:'transcription_mode', v:val})});
  vNote.textContent = `mode: ${val}`;
}

async function vRefreshList(){
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/list')).json();
  vFiles.innerHTML = (js.files||[]).map(f=>`
    <div class="row" style="gap:8px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #223;padding:4px 0">
      <code style="flex:1">${f}</code>
      <button onclick="vTranscribe('${f}')">Transcribe</button>
    </div>`).join('') || '<i>No voice files yet</i>';
}

async function vTranscribe(file){
  vNote.textContent='transcribing…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/transcribe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({file})})).json();
  vNote.textContent = js.ok ? 'transcribed ✓' : 'failed';
  if(js.text){ alert('Transcript:\n\n'+js.text); }
}

function drawLevel(){
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(drawLevel);
  const data = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
  analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(data);
  let peak = 0; for(const v of data){ const d=Math.abs(v-128); if(d>peak) peak=d; }
  const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((peak/64)*100));
  vBar.style.width = pct+'%';
}

vStart.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  vNote.textContent = '…';
  chunks=[];
  vStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true });
  mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(vStream, { mimeType: 'audio/webm' });
  mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = e=> chunks.push(e.data);
  mediaRecorder.onstop = async ()=>{
    const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
    const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('audio', blob, 'voice.webm');
    vNote.textContent = 'uploading…';
    const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/upload',{method:'POST', body: fd})).json();
    vNote.textContent = js.ok ? 'uploaded ✓' : 'upload failed';
    vRefreshList();
  };
  mediaRecorder.start();

  // level meter
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(vStream);
  analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser(); analyser.fftSize=2048;
  source.connect(analyser);
  drawLevel();

  vStart.disabled = true; vStop.disabled = false;
  vNote.textContent = 'recording…';
});

vStop.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(mediaRecorder?.state==='recording') mediaRecorder.stop();
  vStream?.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
  audioCtx?.close(); cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  vStart.disabled = false; vStop.disabled = true;
  vNote.textContent = 'stopped';
});

vListBtn.addEventListener('click', vRefreshList);
vMode.addEventListener('change', e=> setTranscriptionMode(e.target.value));
window.addEventListener('load', async ()=>{
  await vRefreshList();
  // load current transcription mode
  const j = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/config?k=transcription_mode')).json();
  if(j.ok && j.v) vMode.value = j.v;
});
</script>
```

## 1) Factor a helper to transcribe & log
Place above your routes.
```js
async function transcribeFileAndLog(file){
  const mode = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='transcription_mode'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'none')));
  const full = path.join(VOICE_DIR, file);
  let text = '';

  if(mode==='openai'){
    const apiKey = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_api_key'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'')));
    const model  = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_model'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'whisper-1')));
    if(!apiKey) throw new Error('OPENAI key missing');
    const form = new FormData();
    form.append('file', fs.createReadStream(full));
    form.append('model', model);
    const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions',{
      method:'POST', headers:{ 'Authorization':`Bearer ${apiKey}` }, body: form
    });
    const j = await r.json();
    if(!j.text) throw new Error('whisper failed');
    text = j.text;
  } else if(mode==='offline'){
    text = '(pending offline transcription)'; // hook to your local engine later
  } else {
    text = '(transcription disabled)';
  }

  // heuristics → tone tags
  const low = (text||'').toLowerCase();
  const happy = /(grateful|calm|okay|good|relief|peace|thank)/.test(low) ? 1:0;
  const stress= /(tired|stress|worry|angry|sad|overwhelm|irritated)/.test(low) ? 1:0;

  // save as reflection
  const note = String(text||'').slice(0, 1000);
  const reflect_entry_id = await new Promise((ok,err)=>
    db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),'reflect',0.25,?)`,
      [note], function(e){ if(e) err(e); else ok(this.lastID); })
  );

  // tag reflection
  const tags = ['voice']; if(happy) tags.push('gratitude','calm'); if(stress) tags.push('stress');
  for(const t of tags){ const id = await ensureTag(t); if(id) await linkTag(reflect_entry_id,id); }

  // attach to voice_meta if exists
  db.run(`UPDATE voice_meta SET reflect_entry_id=? WHERE file=?`,[reflect_entry_id, file]);

  // generate Human Mirror line (uses your existing craftMirrorLine)
  try{
    const tone = { calm: happy?0.7:0.3, stress: stress?0.6:0.2, grateful: happy?0.8:0.2, connected: 0.6 };
    const health = { harmony: 65, overall: 70 };
    const signals = [{kind:'voice'}];
    const line = await craftMirrorLine({tone, health, signals});
    db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES('mirror',?,datetime('now'))`,[line]);
  }catch(_){}

  return { text, tags };
}
```

## 2) Auto-transcribe after upload + store energy/duration
Replace your `/api/voice/upload` route with this:
```js
app.post('/api/voice/upload', upload.single('audio'), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    if(!req.file) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no file'});
    const { filename } = req.file;
    const energy = Number(req.body.energy||0) || 0;
    const duration = Number(req.body.duration||0) || 0;

    // create a 'voice' log entry
    const entry_id = await new Promise((ok,err)=>
      db.run(`INSERT INTO reward_log(ts,kind,amount,note) VALUES(datetime('now'),'voice',0.25,?)`,
        [`[voice] ${filename}`], function(e){ if(e) err(e); else ok(this.lastID); })
    );

    db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_meta(file,entry_id,energy,duration) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
      [filename, entry_id, energy, duration]);

    const auto = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='auto_transcribe'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v==='1')));
    if(auto){
      const { text, tags } = await transcribeFileAndLog(filename);
      return res.json({ok:true, entry_id, file: filename, auto_transcribed:true, text, tags, energy, duration});
    }
    res.json({ok:true, entry_id, file: filename, auto_transcribed:false, energy, duration});
  }catch(e){
    res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
  }
});
```

## 4) Weekly/Daily voice summary endpoint
```js
app.get('/api/voice/summary', async (req,res)=>{
  const mode = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='summarizer_mode'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'local')));
  // last 24h reflections tagged 'voice'
  const sql = `
    SELECT rl.note FROM reward_log rl
    JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.entry_id=rl.id
    JOIN tags t ON t.id=rlt.tag_id AND t.name='voice'
    WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now','-1 day') AND rl.kind='reflect'
    ORDER BY rl.ts DESC LIMIT 50`;
  db.all(sql, [], async (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    const texts = (rows||[]).map(r=>r.note).filter(Boolean);
    if(!texts.length) return res.json({ok:true, summary:'(no recent voice reflections)'});

    let summary='';
    if(mode==='openai'){
      // optional: call OpenAI text model if you set API key
      const apiKey = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_api_key'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'')));
      const model  = await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='openai_text_model'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'gpt-4o-mini')));
      if(apiKey){
        const prompt = `Summarize these short reflections into 3 bullets (calm, stress, insights):\n\n${texts.join('\n- ')}`;
        const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',{
          method:'POST',
          headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${apiKey}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({model, messages:[{role:'user', content:prompt}], temperature:0.2})
        });
        const j = await r.json();
        summary = j?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || '';
      }
    }
    if(!summary){ // local fallback: naive extract
      const pool = texts.join(' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').split('. ').slice(0,6);
      summary = '• ' + pool.slice(0,3).join('.\n• ') + (pool.length?'.':'');
    }
    res.json({ok:true, summary});
  });
});
```

```html
<script>
let mediaRecorder, chunks=[], analyser, raf, audioCtx, source, vStream, startedAt=0;
let energyAccum=0, energyCount=0;

function energyTick(){
  const data = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
  analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(data);
  let peak = 0; for(const v of data){ const d=Math.abs(v-128); if(d>peak) peak=d; }
  const pct = Math.min(100, Math.round((peak/64)*100));
  energyAccum += pct; energyCount++;
  const avg = Math.round(energyAccum / Math.max(1,energyCount));
  vBar.style.width = pct+'%';
  const dur = (Date.now()-startedAt)/1000;
  vStats.textContent = `energy: ${avg} • duration: ${dur.toFixed(1)}s`;
  raf = requestAnimationFrame(energyTick);
}

async function setTranscriptionMode(val){
  await fetch(UAPI+'/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body: JSON.stringify({k:'transcription_mode', v:val})});
  vNote.textContent = `mode: ${val}`;
}
async function setAutoTranscribe(on){
  await fetch(UAPI+'/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body: JSON.stringify({k:'auto_transcribe', v: on?'1':'0'})});
}

async function vRefreshList(){
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/list')).json();

}

async function vTranscribe(file){
  vNote.textContent='transcribing…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/transcribe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({file})})).json();
  vNote.textContent = js.ok ? 'transcribed ✓' : 'failed';
  if(js.text){ alert('Transcript:\n\n'+js.text); }
}

vStart.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  chunks=[]; energyAccum=0; energyCount=0; startedAt=Date.now();
  vNote.textContent = '…';
  vStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true });
  mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(vStream, { mimeType: 'audio/webm' });
  mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = e=> chunks.push(e.data);
  mediaRecorder.onstop = async ()=>{
    const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
    const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('audio', blob, 'voice.webm');
    // attach prosody stats
    const dur = (Date.now()-startedAt)/1000;
    const avgEnergy = Math.round(energyAccum / Math.max(1,energyCount));
    fd.append('energy', String(avgEnergy));
    fd.append('duration', String(dur.toFixed(2)));

    vNote.textContent = 'uploading…';
    const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/upload',{method:'POST', body: fd})).json();
    if(js.ok){
      vNote.textContent = js.auto_transcribed ? 'uploaded + transcribed ✓' : 'uploaded ✓';
      if(js.text){ alert('Transcript:\n\n'+js.text); }
    }else{
      vNote.textContent = 'upload failed';
    }
    vRefreshList();
  };

  mediaRecorder.start();
  // level meter
  audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  source = audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(vStream);
  analyser = audioCtx.createAnalyser(); analyser.fftSize=2048;
  source.connect(analyser);
  energyTick();

  vStart.disabled = true; vStop.disabled = false;
  vNote.textContent = 'recording…';
});

vStop.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(mediaRecorder?.state==='recording') mediaRecorder.stop();
  vStream?.getTracks().forEach(t=>t.stop());
  audioCtx?.close(); cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  vStart.disabled = false; vStop.disabled = true;
  vNote.textContent = 'stopped';
});

vListBtn.addEventListener('click', vRefreshList);
vMode.addEventListener('change', e=> setTranscriptionMode(e.target.value));
vAuto.addEventListener('change', e=> setAutoTranscribe(e.target.checked));

vSumm.addEventListener('click', async ()=>{
  vNote.textContent='summarizing…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/summary')).json();
  vNote.textContent = js.ok ? 'summary ✓' : 'summary failed';
  if(js.summary){ alert('Daily Voice Summary:\n\n'+js.summary); }
});

window.addEventListener('load', async ()=>{
  await vRefreshList();
  // load current transcription mode + auto
  const jm = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/config?k=transcription_mode')).json();
  if(jm.ok && jm.v) vMode.value = jm.v;
  const ja = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/config?k=auto_transcribe')).json();
  vAuto.checked = (ja.ok && (ja.v==='1'));
});
</script>
```

## b) New endpoint: `/api/voice/energy_trend`
Add this route (anywhere with your other `app.get` endpoints):

```js
// Average energy per day for the last 14 days (0..100)
app.get('/api/voice/energy_trend', (_req,res)=>{
  const sql = `
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', COALESCE(rl.ts, vm.ts)) AS d,
           ROUND(AVG(vm.energy),0) AS avg_energy,
           COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM voice_meta vm
    LEFT JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id = vm.entry_id
    WHERE COALESCE(rl.ts, vm.ts) >= datetime('now','-14 days')
      AND vm.energy > 0
    GROUP BY d
    ORDER BY d ASC`;
  db.all(sql, [], (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```

## b) Add the **Energy Sparkline** card
Paste this new card anywhere on the dashboard (e.g., near the Voice section):

```html
<section class="card span6">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🔋 Voice Energy (14-day)</h3>
  <canvas id="spark" width="520" height="90" style="width:100%; height:90px; background:#0f1320; border-radius:8px"></canvas>
  <div id="sparkNote" class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">—</div>
</section>

<script>
async function drawSpark(){
  const c = document.getElementById('spark');
  if(!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/energy_trend')).json();
  if(!js.ok){ sparkNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  const rows = js.rows||[];
  sparkNote.textContent = rows.length ? 'avg energy per day' : 'no recent voice entries';

  // Prepare data
  const vals = rows.map(r=>Number(r.avg_energy||0));
  const labels = rows.map(r=>r.d);
  const W = c.width, H = c.height, pad=10;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  // axes (subtle)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#233'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad, H-pad); ctx.lineTo(W-pad, H-pad); ctx.stroke();

  if(!vals.length) return;

  // scale
  const min=0, max=100;
  const stepX = (W-2*pad)/Math.max(1, vals.length-1);
  const y = v => H-pad - ( (v-min)/(max-min) )*(H-2*pad);

  // line
  ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.strokeStyle = '#6cf';
  ctx.beginPath();
  vals.forEach((v,i)=>{
    const x = pad + i*stepX;
    const yy = y(v);
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,yy); else ctx.lineTo(x,yy);
  });
  ctx.stroke();

  // fill (soft)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(102,204,255,0.12)';
  ctx.lineTo(W-pad, H-pad); ctx.lineTo(pad, H-pad); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  // last point marker
  const lx = pad + (vals.length-1)*stepX, ly=y(vals[vals.length-1]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#6cf'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(lx,ly,3,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

  // label
  ctx.fillStyle = '#9fb'; ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`${labels[labels.length-1] || ''} • ${vals[vals.length-1]}%`, Math.max(pad, lx-40), Math.max(pad+12, ly-8));
}
window.addEventListener('load', drawSpark);
// also redraw after config loads (optional)
document.addEventListener('cfg:loaded', drawSpark);
</script>
```

> No external libraries; a simple canvas line with a soft fill and the last-day label.

# 🧩 `server.js` — extend `/api/search` with filters

Find your `/api/search` handler and replace just the **param handling + SQL** with this version (keeps your existing logic, adds filters):

```js
app.get("/api/search", (req,res)=>{
  const q      = (req.query.q||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const since  = req.query.since || '';          // YYYY-MM-DD
  const tag    = (req.query.tag||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  const vOnly  = req.query.voice_only === '1';   // show only entries tied to voice
  const minE   = Number(req.query.min_energy || 0);     // 0..100
  const minDur = Number(req.query.min_duration || 0);   // seconds

  const params = [];
  let where = '1=1';
  if(q){ where += ` AND (LOWER(reward_log.note) LIKE ? OR LOWER(reward_log.kind) LIKE ?)`; params.push(`%${q}%`,`%${q}%`); }
  if(since){ where += ` AND reward_log.ts >= ?`; params.push(`${since}T00:00:00`); }

  const byTagJoin = tag ? `
    JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.entry_id = reward_log.id
    JOIN tags t ON t.id = rlt.tag_id AND LOWER(t.name)=?
  ` : '';
  if(tag) params.push(tag);

  // We’ll filter energy/duration in WHERE via vm.* (voice_meta join)
  const voiceJoin = `
    LEFT JOIN voice_meta vm
      ON vm.entry_id = reward_log.id
      OR vm.reflect_entry_id = reward_log.id
  `;

  if(vOnly) where += ` AND vm.energy IS NOT NULL`;        // must be linked to a voice record
  if(minE > 0) where += ` AND (vm.energy IS NOT NULL AND vm.energy >= ${minE})`;
  if(minDur > 0) where += ` AND (vm.duration IS NOT NULL AND vm.duration >= ${minDur})`;

  const sql = `
    SELECT reward_log.id, reward_log.ts, reward_log.kind, reward_log.amount, reward_log.note,
           GROUP_CONCAT(t2.name, ',') AS tags,
           vm.energy AS voice_energy,
           vm.duration AS voice_duration
    FROM reward_log
    ${byTagJoin}
    LEFT JOIN reward_log_tags r2 ON r2.entry_id = reward_log.id
    LEFT JOIN tags t2 ON t2.id = r2.tag_id
    ${voiceJoin}
    WHERE ${where}
    GROUP BY reward_log.id
    ORDER BY reward_log.ts DESC
    LIMIT 200`;

  db.all(sql, params, (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```

## 1) Search Presets API
```js
// Save/overwrite preset
app.post("/api/search/preset/save", express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { name, params } = req.body||{};
  if(!name || !params) return res.json({ok:false,error:"name & params required"});
  const s = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO search_presets(name,params,ts) VALUES(?,?,datetime('now'))
                        ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET params=excluded.params, ts=excluded.ts`);
  s.run(name, JSON.stringify(params), e=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});

// List presets
app.get("/api/search/preset/list", (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT id,name,params,ts FROM search_presets ORDER BY name ASC`,[],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});

// Delete preset
app.delete("/api/search/preset/:id", (req,res)=>{
  db.run(`DELETE FROM search_presets WHERE id=?`,[req.params.id], e=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});
```

## 2) Dual trend endpoint (energy + duration) + tone counts
```js
// 14-day averages for voice energy & duration + calm/stress counts
app.get('/api/voice/energy_duration_trend', (_req,res)=>{
  const sql = `
  WITH v AS (
    SELECT date(COALESCE(rl.ts, vm.ts)) AS d, vm.energy e, vm.duration t
    FROM voice_meta vm LEFT JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=vm.entry_id
    WHERE COALESCE(rl.ts, vm.ts) >= date('now','-14 day') AND vm.energy IS NOT NULL
  ),
  r AS (
    SELECT date(rl.ts) AS d,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rl.note) REGEXP '(grateful|calm|relief|peace|thank)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS calm,
           SUM(CASE WHEN lower(rl.note) REGEXP '(tired|stress|worry|angry|sad|overwhelm|irritat)' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stress
    FROM reward_log rl
    JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.entry_id=rl.id
    JOIN tags t ON t.id=rlt.tag_id AND t.name='voice'
    WHERE rl.ts >= date('now','-14 day')
    GROUP BY 1
  )
  SELECT d.d AS day,
         ROUND(AVG(d.e),0) AS avg_energy,
         ROUND(AVG(d.t),1) AS avg_duration,
         COALESCE(r.calm,0) AS calm,
         COALESCE(r.stress,0) AS stress
  FROM (SELECT date FROM (SELECT date('now','-13 day') AS date
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-12 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-11 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-10 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-9 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-8 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-7 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-6 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-5 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-4 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-3 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-2 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now','-1 day')
        UNION ALL SELECT date('now'))) AS cal(day)
  LEFT JOIN v d ON d.d = cal.day
  LEFT JOIN r ON r.d = cal.day
  GROUP BY cal.day
  ORDER BY cal.day ASC`;
  // NOTE: SQLite default lacks REGEXP; if unavailable, replace REGEXP with LIKE patterns.
  db.all(sql, [], (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```
> If your SQLite lacks `REGEXP`, replace those two `REGEXP` checks with chained `LIKE` clauses (e.g., `LOWER(rl.note) LIKE '%calm%' OR ...`).

## 3) Partner Pulse Share snapshot
```js
app.get('/api/partner/pulse', (req,res)=>{
  const partner_id = req.query.partner_id || 1;
  const sql1 = `SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 day') AND kind='focus'`;
  const sql2 = `SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 day') AND kind='reflect'`;
  const sql3 = `SELECT ROUND(AVG(vm.energy),0) e FROM voice_meta vm
                LEFT JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=vm.entry_id
                WHERE COALESCE(rl.ts, vm.ts) >= datetime('now','-7 day') AND vm.energy IS NOT NULL`;
  const sql4 = `SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) c FROM tags t
                JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
                JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
                WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now','-7 day')
                GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5`;
  db.get(sql1,[],(e1,r1)=>{
    db.get(sql2,[],(e2,r2)=>{
      db.get(sql3,[],(e3,r3)=>{
        db.all(sql4,[],(e4,r4)=>{
          if(e1||e2||e3||e4) return res.json({ok:false,error:(e1||e2||e3||e4).message});
          const topTags = (r4||[]).map(x=>`${x.name}(${x.c})`).join(', ');
          const text = [
            `# Partner Pulse (7-day)`,
            `Focus: ${r1?.c||0} • Reflections: ${r2?.c||0}`,
            `Avg voice energy: ${r3?.e ?? '—'}`,
            `Top tags: ${topTags || '—'}`
          ].join('\n');
          res.json({ok:true, text});
        });
      });
    });
  });
});
```

## 5) Dual Trend + Tone Overlay (replace your sparkline card)
Swap your old spark card with this:

```html
<section class="card span12">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">📈 Voice Trend (14-day): Energy, Duration & Tone</h3>
  <canvas id="spark2" width="920" height="140" style="width:100%;height:140px;background:#0f1320;border-radius:8px"></canvas>
  <div id="spark2Note" class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">—</div>
</section>

<script>
async function drawTrend(){
  const c = document.getElementById('spark2'); if(!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/energy_duration_trend')).json();
  if(!js.ok){ spark2Note.textContent='trend error'; return; }
  const rows = js.rows||[];
  spark2Note.textContent = rows.length ? 'energy (line) • duration (dashed) • tone dots (calm=green, stress=amber)' : 'no data';

  const W=c.width, H=c.height, pad=16;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);

  if(!rows.length) return;
  const xStep = (W-2*pad)/Math.max(1,rows.length-1);
  const xPos = i => pad + i*xStep;
  const yE = v => H-pad - (Math.max(0,Math.min(100, v||0))/100)*(H-2*pad);             // energy 0..100
  const maxDur = Math.max(30, ...rows.map(r=> Number(r.avg_duration||0)));              // scale duration to same canvas
  const yD = v => H-pad - ((v||0)/maxDur)*(H-2*pad);

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='#223'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad,H-pad); ctx.lineTo(W-pad,H-pad); ctx.stroke();

  // energy line
  ctx.strokeStyle='#6cf'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath();
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const y=yE(Number(r.avg_energy||0)); const x=xPos(i); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
  ctx.stroke();

  // duration dashed
  ctx.setLineDash([5,4]); ctx.strokeStyle='#9f9'; ctx.beginPath();
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const y=yD(Number(r.avg_duration||0)); const x=xPos(i); if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y); });
  ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // tone dots
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const x = xPos(i);
    const calm = Number(r.calm||0), stress=Number(r.stress||0);
    if(calm>0){ ctx.fillStyle='#42f56c'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, yE(95), 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
    if(stress>0){ ctx.fillStyle='#f5c542'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, yE(85), 3, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill(); }
  });

  // last labels
  const last = rows[rows.length-1];
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb'; ctx.font='12px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText(`E:${last?.avg_energy ?? '—'}%`, W-80, pad+14);
  ctx.fillText(`t:${(last?.avg_duration??0).toFixed?.(1)||last?.avg_duration||'0'}s`, W-80, pad+28);
}
window.addEventListener('load', drawTrend);
document.addEventListener('cfg:loaded', drawTrend);
</script>
```

## 🪶 1️⃣ Add these to `server.js`

Paste below your existing imports (keeps the DB upgrade + nightly cron + export):

```js
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import cron from 'node-cron';
import express from 'express';
import sqlite3 from 'sqlite3';
const app = express();
const db  = new sqlite3.Database('aum_data.db');

// ---------- TABLES ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS search_presets(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  params TEXT NOT NULL,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS day_tone(
  d TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  calm INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  stress INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);

// ---------- PRESETS API ----------
app.post('/api/search/preset/save', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {name,params}=req.body||{};
  if(!name||!params) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO search_presets(name,params,ts)
          VALUES(?,?,datetime('now'))
          ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET params=excluded.params,ts=excluded.ts`,
          [name,JSON.stringify(params)], e=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});
app.get('/api/search/preset/list',(_q,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT id,name,params,ts FROM search_presets ORDER BY name`,[],(e,r)=>
    res.json(e?{ok:false,error:e.message}:{ok:true,rows:r}));
});
app.delete('/api/search/preset/:id',(req,res)=>{
  db.run(`DELETE FROM search_presets WHERE id=?`,[req.params.id],e=>
    res.json(e?{ok:false,error:e.message}:{ok:true}));
});

// ---------- NIGHTLY TONE CACHE ----------
cron.schedule('5 0 * * *',()=>{
  const sql=`INSERT INTO day_tone(d,calm,stress,updated)
             SELECT date(ts),
               SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(note) LIKE '%calm%' OR LOWER(note) LIKE '%grateful%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
               SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(note) LIKE '%stress%' OR LOWER(note) LIKE '%angry%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
               datetime('now')
             FROM reward_log
             WHERE ts>=date('now','-14 day')
             GROUP BY date(ts)
             ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET calm=excluded.calm,stress=excluded.stress,updated=datetime('now')`;
  db.run(sql);
  console.log('Tone cache updated');
});

// ---------- SHARE LOG ----------
app.post('/api/sharelog/save', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const text=(req.body||{}).text||'';
  const fn='share_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.txt';
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join('share_logs',fn),text);
  res.json({ok:true,file:fn});
});
app.use('/share_logs',express.static('share_logs'));
```

# 1) `server.js` — Backup ZIP endpoint

Paste near other endpoints:

```js
import archiver from 'archiver'; // npm i archiver

app.get('/api/backup/zip', (req, res) => {
  try {
    const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-').slice(0,19);
    const zipName = `aumnity_backup_${ts}.zip`;
    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename="${zipName}"`);

    const archive = archiver('zip', { zlib: { level: 9 } });
    archive.on('error', err => { throw err; });
    archive.pipe(res);

    // include main storage
    if (fs.existsSync('aum_data.db')) archive.file('aum_data.db', { name:'aum_data.db' });
    if (fs.existsSync('voices')) archive.directory('voices', 'voices');
    if (fs.existsSync('share_logs')) archive.directory('share_logs', 'share_logs');

    // include config table as JSON
    archive.append(JSON.stringify(awaitDumpConfig(), null, 2), { name:'config.json' });

    archive.finalize();
  } catch (e) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok:false, error: e.message });
  }
});

// helper: dump config table
function awaitDumpConfig(){
  return new Promise((ok) => {
    db.all(`SELECT k,v FROM config ORDER BY k`, [], (_e, rows) => {
      const cfg = {}; (rows||[]).forEach(r => cfg[r.k]=r.v);
      ok(cfg);
    });
  });
}
```

> This streams a ZIP to the browser containing `aum_data.db`, `voices/`, `share_logs/`, and `config.json`.
