```js
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import archiver from 'archiver';
import multer from 'multer';
import cron from 'node-cron';
import unzipper from 'unzipper';   // npm i unzipper

// Ensure folders
const VOICE_DIR = path.resolve('./voices');
const SHARE_DIR = path.resolve('./share_logs');
const BACKUP_DIR = path.resolve('./share_logs/backups');
const RESTORE_DIR = path.resolve('./restores');
for (const d of [VOICE_DIR, SHARE_DIR, BACKUP_DIR, RESTORE_DIR]) {
  if (!fs.existsSync(d)) fs.mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true });
}

// Multer for uploads (reuse if you already created one)
const upload = multer({ dest: path.join(RESTORE_DIR, 'tmp') });

// Helper: dump config
function dumpConfig() {
  return new Promise(ok => {
    db.all(`SELECT k,v FROM config ORDER BY k`, [], (_e, rows) => {
      const cfg = {}; (rows||[]).forEach(r => cfg[r.k]=r.v);
      ok(cfg);
    });
  });
}
```

## 1) Weekly auto-backup ZIP (local)
Create a scheduled backup every **Sunday 02:00** into `share_logs/backups/`.

```js
cron.schedule('0 2 * * 0', async ()=>{
  const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-').slice(0,19);
  const out = fs.createWriteStream(path.join(BACKUP_DIR, `aumnity_backup_${ts}.zip`));
  const archive = archiver('zip', { zlib: { level: 9 } });
  archive.pipe(out);
  if (fs.existsSync('aum_data.db')) archive.file('aum_data.db',{name:'aum_data.db'});
  if (fs.existsSync('voices')) archive.directory('voices','voices');
  if (fs.existsSync('share_logs')) archive.directory('share_logs','share_logs');
  archive.append(JSON.stringify(await dumpConfig(), null, 2), { name:'config.json' });
  await archive.finalize();
  console.log('[backup] weekly ZIP created');
});
```

## 2) Manual “Backup Now” (download ZIP)
(If you already added this, keep yours; else include.)

```js
app.get('/api/backup/zip', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const ts = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-').slice(0,19);
    res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/zip');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition',`attachment; filename="aumnity_backup_${ts}.zip"`);
    const archive = archiver('zip',{zlib:{level:9}});
    archive.on('error', e=>{ throw e; });
    archive.pipe(res);
    if (fs.existsSync('aum_data.db')) archive.file('aum_data.db',{name:'aum_data.db'});
    if (fs.existsSync('voices')) archive.directory('voices','voices');
    if (fs.existsSync('share_logs')) archive.directory('share_logs','share_logs');
    archive.append(JSON.stringify(await dumpConfig(), null, 2), { name:'config.json' });
    await archive.finalize();
  }catch(e){ res.status(500).json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

## 3) Restore flow: upload ZIP → extract → (optional) DB swap
Safe by default: we **extract** into `restores/<stamp>/`.  
Voices & share logs can be merged immediately; **DB swap** is explicit and reversible (auto-backup first).

```js
// Upload a backup ZIP
app.post('/api/restore/upload', upload.single('zip'), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    if(!req.file) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no file'});
    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-').slice(0,19);
    const targetDir = path.join(RESTORE_DIR, stamp);
    fs.mkdirSync(targetDir, { recursive:true });

    // Unzip
    await fs.createReadStream(req.file.path).pipe(unzipper.Extract({ path: targetDir })).promise();
    fs.unlinkSync(req.file.path);

    // Detect contents
    const hasDB = fs.existsSync(path.join(targetDir,'aum_data.db'));
    const hasVoices = fs.existsSync(path.join(targetDir,'voices'));
    const hasShare = fs.existsSync(path.join(targetDir,'share_logs'));

    res.json({ ok:true, stamp, hasDB, hasVoices, hasShare, path: targetDir });
  }catch(e){
    res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
  }
});

// Merge voices & share logs from a given restore stamp
app.post('/api/restore/merge', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const { stamp, mergeVoices=true, mergeShare=true } = req.body||{};
    if(!stamp) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing stamp'});
    const src = path.join(RESTORE_DIR, stamp);
    if(!fs.existsSync(src)) return res.json({ok:false,error:'invalid stamp'});

    if(mergeVoices && fs.existsSync(path.join(src,'voices'))){
      fs.cpSync(path.join(src,'voices'), VOICE_DIR, { recursive:true, force:false });
    }
    if(mergeShare && fs.existsSync(path.join(src,'share_logs'))){
      fs.cpSync(path.join(src,'share_logs'), SHARE_DIR, { recursive:true, force:false });
    }
    res.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});

// Apply DB file from restore (auto-backup current, hot-swap)
app.post('/api/restore/apply_db', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { stamp } = req.body||{};
  if(!stamp) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing stamp'});
  const dbSrc = path.join(RESTORE_DIR, stamp, 'aum_data.db');
  if(!fs.existsSync(dbSrc)) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no aum_data.db in restore'});

  const doSwap = ()=>{
    try{
      const now = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g,'-').slice(0,19);
      const bak = path.join(BACKUP_DIR, `PRE_RESTORE_${now}.db`);
      if (fs.existsSync('aum_data.db')) fs.copyFileSync('aum_data.db', bak);
      fs.copyFileSync(dbSrc, 'aum_data.db');  // replace
      // reopen DB
      global.db = new sqlite3.Database('aum_data.db');
      res.json({ok:true, backup: bak});
    }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
  };

  // Close current DB connection, then swap
  try{
    db.close(err=>{
      if(err) return res.json({ok:false,error:'db close failed: '+err.message});
      doSwap();
    });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

## 4) Habit Nudges — config, insert, and recent list
We’ll create small **nudges** whenever a voice entry looks stressed *and* energetic enough (cooldown protects from spam).

```js
// Config keys (defaults)
cfgSet('nudge_energy_min','55');      // prosody energy >= 55
cfgSet('nudge_cooldown_min','60');    // at least 60 min between nudges

// Simple nudge writer (stores as a 'nudge' in summaries)
function writeNudge(text){
  return new Promise((ok,err)=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text,ts) VALUES('nudge',?,datetime('now'))`,
      [text], function(e){ if(e) err(e); else ok(this.lastID); });
  });
}

// Last nudge ts helper
function getLastNudgeMinutesAgo(){
  return new Promise(ok=>{
    db.get(`SELECT (strftime('%s','now') - strftime('%s',ts))/60 AS mins
            FROM summaries WHERE kind='nudge' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(_e,row)=>{
      ok(row?.mins ?? 1e9);
    });
  });
}

// Generate a friendly suggestion
function buildNudge({energy, text}){
  const ideas = [
    '2-minute box-breathing',
    'sip water + shoulder roll',
    '60-second eyes-closed reset',
    '3 slow steps near a window',
    'write 1 calm line in 🌿 Reflection'
  ];
  const pick = ideas[Math.floor(Math.random()*ideas.length)];
  const hint = (text && text.length>0) ? ` — “${text.slice(0,60)}…”` : '';
  return `Gentle nudge: try ${pick}${hint}`;
}

// Hook into your transcription flow (call from transcribeFileAndLog)
async function maybeTriggerNudge({energy, stressWordHit, text}){
  try{
    const minE = Number(await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='nudge_energy_min'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'55'))));
    const cool = Number(await new Promise(ok=> db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='nudge_cooldown_min'`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.v||'60'))));
    const minsAgo = await getLastNudgeMinutesAgo();
    if(stressWordHit && energy >= minE && minsAgo >= cool){
      const line = buildNudge({energy, text});
      await writeNudge(line);
    }
  }catch(_){}
}

// Recent nudges (for UI)
app.get('/api/nudges/recent', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT ts, text FROM summaries WHERE kind='nudge' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```

```js
// --- Alerts: latest 'mirror' & 'nudge' since a timestamp ---
app.get('/api/alerts', (req, res) => {
  const since = req.query.since || '1970-01-01T00:00:00';
  const sql = `
    SELECT ts, 'mirror' AS kind, text FROM summaries
      WHERE kind='mirror' AND ts > ?
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ts, 'nudge'  AS kind, text FROM summaries
      WHERE kind='nudge'  AND ts > ?
    ORDER BY ts ASC
    LIMIT 50`;
  db.all(sql, [since, since], (e, rows) => {
    if (e) return res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
    res.json({ ok:true, rows });
  });
});

cfgSet('alerts_poll_sec','30'); // client poll cadence in seconds
```

## 3) Add the notifier script (auto-poll + toasts)

```html
<script>
let ALERTS_LAST = localStorage.getItem('alerts_last') || new Date(Date.now()-5*60*1000).toISOString(); // start 5 min back
let ALERTS_TIMER = null;

function toastPush(kind, text, ts){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('toast');
  const div = document.createElement('div'); div.className = 'item '+kind;
  div.innerHTML = `<b>${kind==='nudge'?'🪶 Nudge':'🪞 Reflection'}</b><br>${escapeHtml(text)}
                   <div class="ts">${new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString()}</div>`;
  wrap.appendChild(div);
  if (alSound.checked) { document.getElementById('alPing').currentTime=0; document.getElementById('alPing').play().catch(()=>{}); }
  setTimeout(()=> div.remove(), 9000);
}
function escapeHtml(s){ return (s||'').replaceAll('&','&amp;').replaceAll('<','&lt;').replaceAll('>','&gt;'); }

async function alertsTick(){
  try{
    const en = alOn.checked ? '1':'0';
    if(en!=='1') return;
    const sec = Math.max(10, Number(alEvery.value||30));
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ since: ALERTS_LAST }).toString();
    const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/alerts?'+qs)).json();
    if(js.ok && (js.rows||[]).length){
      for(const r of js.rows){ toastPush(r.kind, r.text||'', r.ts); ALERTS_LAST = r.ts; }
      localStorage.setItem('alerts_last', ALERTS_LAST);
      alNote.textContent = `new: ${(js.rows||[]).length}`;
    } else {
      alNote.textContent = '—';
    }
  }catch(_){}
}
function alertsStart(){
  if(ALERTS_TIMER) clearInterval(ALERTS_TIMER);
  const sec = Math.max(10, Number(alEvery.value||30));
  ALERTS_TIMER = setInterval(alertsTick, sec*1000);
}

// init from server config
window.addEventListener('load', async ()=>{
  try{
    const jm = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/config?k=alerts_enabled')).json();
    alOn.checked = jm.ok ? jm.v==='1' : true;
    const jp = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/config?k=alerts_poll_sec')).json();
    if(jp.ok && jp.v) alEvery.value = jp.v;
  }catch(_){}
  alertsStart();
  alertsTick();
});
// react to user changes
alOn.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ alertsStart(); });
alEvery.addEventListener('change', ()=>{ alertsStart(); });
</script>
```

> Behavior: every **N** seconds (default 30), the dashboard asks the server for any new **mirror** or **nudge** entries since the last seen timestamp. New ones **pop as toasts** (with optional ping sound) and auto-clear.

```js
  db.all(`
    SELECT ts, kind, REPLACE(REPLACE(text, CHAR(13), ' '), CHAR(10), ' ') AS text
    FROM summaries
    WHERE kind IN ('mirror','nudge')
    ORDER BY ts DESC
    LIMIT ?`, [limit],
    (e,rows)=>{
      if(e) return res.status(500).send('error');
      const head = 'ts,kind,text\n';
      const body = (rows||[]).map(r=>{
        const t = (r.text||'').replace(/"/g,'""');
        return `"${r.ts}","${r.kind}","${t}"`;
      }).join('\n');
      res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition','attachment; filename="aumnity_alerts.csv"');
      res.send(head+body);
    }
  );
});
```

### 2) Script — add filtering logic (append to the same `<script>` block)
```html
<script>
let _AL_ROWS_CACHE = []; // keep last fetch for client-side filtering
function norm(s){ return String(s||'').toLowerCase(); }

// override table render to accept a rows array
function renderAlertsRows(rows){
  const q = norm(alFind.value);
  const k = (alKind.value||'').trim();

  const filtered = rows.filter(r=>{
    const okKind = !k || r.kind===k;
    const okText = !q || norm(r.text).includes(q) || norm(r.ts).includes(q);
    return okKind && okText;
  });

  const hi = (s)=> {
    if(!q) return esc(s);
    const re = new RegExp(`(${q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&')})`, 'gi');
    return esc(s).replace(re,'<mark>$1</mark>');
  };

  const tbody = document.querySelector('#alTable tbody');
  tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(r=>{
    const kindClass = r.kind==='nudge' ? 'kind-nudge' : 'kind-mirror';
    const unread = r.ts > LAST_SEEN_ALERT ? 'unread' : '';
    return `
      <tr class="${kindClass} ${unread}">
        <td style="padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #223">${hi(fmtTime(r.ts))}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #223">${hi(r.kind)}</td>
        <td style="padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid #223">${hi(r.text)}</td>
      </tr>`;
  }).join('') || '<tr><td colspan="3" style="padding:10px">No matches</td></tr>';

  // badges based on filtered-unread
  const unreadAll   = filtered.filter(r=> r.ts > LAST_SEEN_ALERT).length;
  const unreadNudge = filtered.filter(r=> r.ts > LAST_SEEN_ALERT && r.kind==='nudge').length;

  const bA = document.getElementById('badgeAlerts');
  const bN = document.getElementById('badgeNudges');
  if(unreadAll>0){ bA.style.display='inline-block'; bA.textContent=unreadAll; } else { bA.style.display='none'; }
  if(unreadNudge>0){ bN.style.display='inline-block'; bN.textContent=unreadNudge; } else { bN.style.display='none'; }

  alListNote.textContent = `rows: ${filtered.length}/${rows.length}`;
}

async function refreshAlertsTable(){
  alListNote.textContent='…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/alerts/recent?limit=300')).json();
  if(!js.ok){ alListNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  _AL_ROWS_CACHE = js.rows||[];
  renderAlertsRows(_AL_ROWS_CACHE);
  // mark most recent as seen baseline
  if(_AL_ROWS_CACHE.length){ LAST_SEEN_ALERT = _AL_ROWS_CACHE[0].ts; localStorage.setItem('last_seen_alert_ts', LAST_SEEN_ALERT); }
}

// live filter (debounced)
let _alTimer=null;
function alFilterNow(){
  if(!_AL_ROWS_CACHE.length) return;
  renderAlertsRows(_AL_ROWS_CACHE);
}
alFind.addEventListener('input', ()=>{ clearTimeout(_alTimer); _alTimer=setTimeout(alFilterNow,150); });
alKind.addEventListener('change', alFilterNow);
</script>
```

```js
app.get('/api/weekly/summary', async (_req, res)=>{
  try{
    const since = `datetime('now','-7 day')`;
    const q = (sql,params=[])=> new Promise((ok,err)=> db.all(sql,params,(e,r)=> e?err(e):ok(r)));

    const prog = await q(`SELECT ts,note FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const refl = await q(`SELECT ts,note FROM reward_log WHERE kind='reflect' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const vagg = await q(`
      SELECT date(COALESCE(rl.ts,vm.ts)) d,
             ROUND(AVG(vm.energy),0) e,
             ROUND(AVG(vm.duration),1) t
      FROM voice_meta vm LEFT JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=vm.entry_id
      WHERE COALESCE(rl.ts,vm.ts) >= ${since} AND vm.energy IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY d ORDER BY d ASC`);
    const nudg = await q(`SELECT ts,text FROM summaries WHERE kind='nudge' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const tags = await q(`
      SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) c
      FROM tags t
      JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
      JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id AND rl.ts >= ${since}
      GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 8`);

    const fmt = (s)=> (s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    const line = (r)=> `- ${new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString()} — ${fmt(r.note||r.text||'')}`;
    const trend = vagg.map(r=> `  - ${r.d}: E ${r.e??'—'}% · t ${(r.t??0)}s`).join('\n');

    const md = [
`# 🗓️ Weekly Summary (last 7 days)

**Range:** ${new Date(Date.now()-6*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10)} → ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}

## 📌 Progress (focus)
${prog.length? prog.map(line).join('\n') : '_—_'}

## 🌿 Reflections
${refl.length? refl.map(line).join('\n') : '_—_'}

## 🎙️ Voice Trend
${vagg.length? trend : '_no voice data_'}

## 🪶 Nudges
${nudg.length? nudg.map(line).join('\n') : '_none_'}

## 🏷️ Top Tags
${tags.length? tags.map(t=> `\`${t.name}\` (${t.c})`).join(', ') : '_—_'}
`].join('\n');

    // save to share_logs
    const fs = (await import('fs')).default;
    const path = (await import('path')).default;
    const fn = `weekly_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.md`;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join('share_logs', fn), md, 'utf8');

    res.json({ok:true, filename: fn, markdown: md});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

# 🧩 `server.js` — Auto-Tagging + Monthly Summary

## A) Auto-tagging rules (CRUD + apply on insert)
Paste near other endpoints/helpers:

```js
// --- AUTOTAG RULES (stored in config as JSON) ---
async function getAutoTagRules(){
  return await new Promise(ok=>{
    db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='autotag_rules'`,[],(_e,row)=>{
      try{ ok(row?.v ? JSON.parse(row.v) : []); }catch{ ok([]); }
    });
  });
}
function saveAutoTagRules(rules){
  return new Promise((ok,err)=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO config(k,v) VALUES('autotag_rules',?)
            ON CONFLICT(k) DO UPDATE SET v=excluded.v`,[JSON.stringify(rules)], e=>{
      if(e) err(e); else ok(true);
    });
  });
}
// APIs
app.get('/api/autotag/list', async (_req,res)=>{
  res.json({ok:true, rules: await getAutoTagRules()});
});
app.post('/api/autotag/save', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const rules = Array.isArray(req.body?.rules) ? req.body.rules : [];
    await saveAutoTagRules(rules);
    res.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});

// Helper: apply rules → returns array of tag names
async function autoTagsFor(text){
  const rules = await getAutoTagRules();
  const s = (text||'').toLowerCase();
  const hits = new Set();
  for(const r of rules){
    const tag = String(r.tag||'').trim();
    if(!tag) continue;
    // rule types: 'any' = any keyword match, 'regex' = JS regex
    if(r.type==='regex'){
      try{ if(new RegExp(r.pattern,'i').test(text||'')) hits.add(tag); }catch{}
    }else{
      const kws = (r.keywords||[]).map(k=>String(k).toLowerCase());
      if(kws.some(k=> k && s.includes(k))) hits.add(tag);
    }
  }
  return [...hits];
}

// Call this from wherever you already insert reward_log / summaries
async function attachTagsToEntry(entryId, tagNames){
  if(!entryId || !tagNames?.length) return;
  for(const name of tagNames){
    await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.run(`INSERT INTO tags(name) VALUES(?) ON CONFLICT(name) DO NOTHING`,[name],()=>ok());
    });
    await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.get(`SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name=?`,[name],(_e,row)=>{
        if(!row) return ok();
        db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reward_log_tags(entry_id,tag_id) VALUES(?,?)`,[entryId,row.id],()=>ok());
      });
    });
  }
}
```

### Hook it in (two lines each time you add a log)
After you insert into `reward_log` (focus/reflect/voice-linked), do:

```js
const autoTags = await autoTagsFor(noteText);
await attachTagsToEntry(newEntryId, autoTags);
```

Do the same for any other place you create entries from transcripts/summaries.

```js
  try{
    const since = `datetime('now','-30 day')`;
    const q = (sql,params=[])=> new Promise((ok,err)=> db.all(sql,params,(e,r)=> e?err(e):ok(r)));

    const prog = await q(`SELECT ts,note FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const refl = await q(`SELECT ts,note FROM reward_log WHERE kind='reflect' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const vagg = await q(`
      SELECT date(COALESCE(rl.ts,vm.ts)) d,
             ROUND(AVG(vm.energy),0) e,
             ROUND(AVG(vm.duration),1) t
      FROM voice_meta vm LEFT JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=vm.entry_id
      WHERE COALESCE(rl.ts,vm.ts) >= ${since} AND vm.energy IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY d ORDER BY d ASC`);
    const nudg = await q(`SELECT ts,text FROM summaries WHERE kind='nudge' AND ts >= ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const tags = await q(`
      SELECT t.name, COUNT(*) c
      FROM tags t
      JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
      JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id AND rl.ts >= ${since}
      GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 12`);

    const fmt = s => (s||'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    const line = r => `- ${new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString()} — ${fmt(r.note||r.text||'')}`;
    const trend = vagg.map(r=> `  - ${r.d}: E ${r.e??'—'}% · t ${(r.t??0)}s`).join('\n');

    const md = `
# 📅 Monthly Summary (last 30 days)
**Range:** ${new Date(Date.now()-29*864e5).toISOString().slice(0,10)} → ${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}

## 📌 Progress
${prog.length? prog.map(line).join('\n') : '_—_'}

## 🌿 Reflections
${refl.length? refl.map(line).join('\n') : '_—_'}

## 🎙️ Voice Trend (daily averages)
${vagg.length? trend : '_no voice data_'}

## 🪶 Nudges
${nudg.length? nudg.map(line).join('\n') : '_none_'}

## 🏷️ Top Tags
${tags.length? tags.map(t=> `\`${t.name}\` (${t.c})`).join(', ') : '_—_'}
`.trim();

    const fs = (await import('fs')).default;
    const path = (await import('path')).default;
    const fn = `monthly_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.md`;
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join('share_logs', fn), md, 'utf8');

    res.json({ok:true, filename: fn, markdown: md});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

```html
<section class="card span12">
```

```html
<script>
async function testAutoTags(){
  const txt = ttText.value.trim();
  if(!txt){ ttOut.textContent='(enter text first)'; return; }
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/autotag/list')).json();
  if(!js.ok){ ttOut.textContent='error loading rules'; return; }
  const rules = js.rules||[];
  const hits = new Set();
  const s = txt.toLowerCase();
  for(const r of rules){
    const tag = String(r.tag||'').trim();
    if(!tag) continue;
    if(r.type==='regex'){
      try{ if(new RegExp(r.pattern,'i').test(txt)) hits.add(tag); }catch{}
    }else{
      const kws = (r.keywords||[]).map(k=>String(k).toLowerCase());
      if(kws.some(k=> k && s.includes(k))) hits.add(tag);
    }
  }
  ttOut.textContent = hits.size
    ? '→ ' + Array.from(hits).map(t=>'#'+t).join('  ')
    : '(no tags matched)';
}
ttRun.addEventListener('click', testAutoTags);
</script>
```

# 🧩 `server.js` — add two endpoints

Paste near your other endpoints:

```js
// ---- Tag stats (pie) ----
app.get('/api/tags/month_stats', (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||30));
  const sql = `
    SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM tags t
    JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
    JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
    WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
    GROUP BY t.name
    ORDER BY c DESC`;
  db.all(sql, [`-${days} day`], (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    const total = (rows||[]).reduce((s,r)=>s+Number(r.c||0),0);
    res.json({ok:true, days, total, rows});
  });
});

// ---- Emotion radar (configurable axes) ----
// Config key 'emotion_axes' may define something like:
// [{"axis":"Calm","tags":["calm","gratitude"]},{"axis":"Stress","tags":["stress","angry","tired"]}, ...]
async function getEmotionAxes(){
  return await new Promise(ok=>{
    db.get(`SELECT v FROM config WHERE k='emotion_axes'`,[],(_e,row)=>{
      try {
        const j = row?.v ? JSON.parse(row.v) : null;
        if (Array.isArray(j) && j.length) return ok(j);
      } catch {}
      // default axes
      ok([
        { axis: "Calm",     tags: ["calm","gratitude","peace"] },
        { axis: "Stress",   tags: ["stress","angry","worry","overwhelm","irritated","tired","sad"] },
        { axis: "Focus",    tags: ["focus","done","progress"] },
        { axis: "Learning", tags: ["learn","study","python","nlp"] },
        { axis: "Voice",    tags: ["voice","audio","reflection"] }
      ]);
    });
  });
}
app.get('/api/emotion/radar', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const days = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||30));
    const axes = await getEmotionAxes();
    // build counts per tag in window
    const sql = `
      SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS c
      FROM tags t
      JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
      JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
      WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
      GROUP BY t.name`;
    db.all(sql, [`-${days} day`], (e,rows)=>{
      if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
      const map = new Map((rows||[]).map(r=>[String(r.tag).toLowerCase(), Number(r.c||0)]));
      const series = axes.map(a=>{
        const sum = (a.tags||[]).reduce((s,t)=> s + (map.get(String(t).toLowerCase())||0), 0);
        return { axis: a.axis, value: sum };
      });
      // normalize 0..100 scale (optional)
      const max = Math.max(1, ...series.map(s=>s.value));
      const pct = series.map(s=> ({ axis:s.axis, value:s.value, pct: Math.round(100*s.value/max) }));
      res.json({ok:true, days, axes, series: pct});
    });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

> Optional: you can set a custom axes mapping by saving JSON under config key **`emotion_axes`**.

## 1) Auto-Tag Stats (Pie)

```html
<section class="card span6">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🏷️ Tag Stats (pie)</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <label>days <input id="tsDays" type="number" min="7" max="365" value="30" style="width:80px"></label>
    <button id="tsRun" class="secondary">Refresh</button>
    <span id="tsNote" class="mut">—</span>
  </div>
  <canvas id="tsPie" width="380" height="240" style="width:100%;height:240px;background:#0f1320;border-radius:10px;margin-top:8px"></canvas>
  <div id="tsLegend" style="font-size:12px;margin-top:6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px"></div>
</section>

<script>
async function drawPie(){
  tsNote.textContent='…';
  const days = Math.max(7, Math.min(365, Number(tsDays.value||30)));
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/tags/month_stats?days='+days)).json();
  if(!js.ok){ tsNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  const rows = (js.rows||[]).slice(0,12); // top 12 for clarity
  const total = rows.reduce((s,r)=> s+Number(r.c||0), 0) || 1;
  const cvs = document.getElementById('tsPie');
  const ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const cx=cvs.width/2, cy=cvs.height/2, r=Math.min(cx,cy)-8;

  // colors (auto)
  const col = i => `hsl(${(i*47)%360} 70% 55%)`;

  let start = -Math.PI/2;
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const frac = Number(r.c||0)/total;
    const end = start + frac*2*Math.PI;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);
    ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,start,end);
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = col(i); ctx.fill();
    start = end;
  });
  // outline
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1f2942'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.stroke();

  // legend
  tsLegend.innerHTML = rows.map((r,i)=>`<span>
    <span style="display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;background:${col(i)};border-radius:2px;margin-right:6px"></span>
    ${r.tag} (${r.c})
  </span>`).join('') || '<i>No tags yet</i>';

  tsNote.textContent = `top ${rows.length} • total ${js.total}`;
}
tsRun.addEventListener('click', drawPie);
window.addEventListener('load', drawPie);
</script>
```

## 2) Emotion Radar (Spider)

```html
<section class="card span6">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🎯 Emotion Radar</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <label>days <input id="erDays" type="number" min="7" max="365" value="30" style="width:80px"></label>
    <button id="erRun" class="secondary">Refresh</button>
    <span id="erNote" class="mut">—</span>
  </div>
  <canvas id="erChart" width="380" height="300" style="width:100%;height:300px;background:#0f1320;border-radius:10px;margin-top:8px"></canvas>
</section>

<script>
async function drawRadar(){
  erNote.textContent='…';
  const days = Math.max(7, Math.min(365, Number(erDays.value||30)));
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/emotion/radar?days='+days)).json();
  if(!js.ok){ erNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  const rows = js.series||[]; // [{axis, pct, value}]
  const cvs = document.getElementById('erChart'), ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const cx=cvs.width/2, cy=cvs.height/2, R=Math.min(cx,cy)-16;

  const N = rows.length || 1;
  const angle = i => -Math.PI/2 + i*(2*Math.PI/N);
  // grid rings
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1f2942'; ctx.lineWidth=1;
  [0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(k=>{
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*k,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
  });
  // axes + labels
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb'; ctx.font='12px system-ui, sans-serif';
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const a = angle(i);
    const x = cx + Math.cos(a)*R;
    const y = cy + Math.sin(a)*R;
    ctx.strokeStyle='#223'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy); ctx.lineTo(x,y); ctx.stroke();
    // label
    const lx = cx + Math.cos(a)*(R+10);
    const ly = cy + Math.sin(a)*(R+10);
    ctx.textAlign = (Math.cos(a)>0.3)?'left':(Math.cos(a)<-0.3)?'right':'center';
    ctx.fillText(r.axis, lx, ly);
  });
  // polygon
  ctx.beginPath();
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const a = angle(i), rad = R * (Number(r.pct||0)/100);
    const x = cx + Math.cos(a)*rad, y = cy + Math.sin(a)*rad;
    if(i===0) ctx.moveTo(x,y); else ctx.lineTo(x,y);
  });
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(108,207,255,.22)'; ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#6cf'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();

  erNote.textContent = `axes: ${rows.length} • window: ${js.days}d`;
}
erRun.addEventListener('click', drawRadar);
window.addEventListener('load', drawRadar);
</script>
```

# 🧩 `server.js` – compare endpoint (drop in near the radar API)

```js
// Compare two consecutive windows for the same axes
app.get('/api/emotion/radar_compare', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const days = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||7));   // default 7-day weeks
    const axes = await getEmotionAxes();

    const q = (since) => new Promise((ok,err)=>{
      db.all(`
        SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM tags t
        JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
        JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
        WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now', ?) AND rl.ts < datetime('now', ?)
        GROUP BY t.name`,
        [since, since.replace('-', `-${days*2} `) ? '-0 day':'-0 day'], // placeholder to satisfy param count
        (e,rows)=> e?err(e):ok(rows||[])
      );
    });

    // window A: now → now- days
    const rowsA = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
      db.all(`
        SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM tags t
        JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
        JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
        WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
          AND rl.ts <  datetime('now')
        GROUP BY t.name`, [`-${days} day`], (e,r)=> e?err(e):ok(r||[])
      );
    });
    // window B: previous period (days*2 → days)
    const rowsB = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
      db.all(`
        SELECT t.name AS tag, COUNT(*) AS c
        FROM tags t
        JOIN reward_log_tags rlt ON rlt.tag_id=t.id
        JOIN reward_log rl ON rl.id=rlt.entry_id
        WHERE rl.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
          AND rl.ts <  datetime('now', ?)
        GROUP BY t.name`, [`-${days*2} day`, `-${days} day`], (e,r)=> e?err(e):ok(r||[])
      );
    });

    const toMap = rows => new Map(rows.map(r=>[String(r.tag).toLowerCase(), Number(r.c||0)]));

    const mA = toMap(rowsA), mB = toMap(rowsB);
    const seriesA = axes.map(a => ({ axis:a.axis, value:(a.tags||[]).reduce((s,t)=>s+(mA.get(String(t).toLowerCase())||0),0) }));
    const seriesB = axes.map(a => ({ axis:a.axis, value:(a.tags||[]).reduce((s,t)=>s+(mB.get(String(t).toLowerCase())||0),0) }));

    const maxVal = Math.max(1, ...seriesA.map(s=>s.value), ...seriesB.map(s=>s.value));
    const pctA = seriesA.map(s=>({axis:s.axis, value:s.value, pct:Math.round(100*s.value/maxVal)}));
    const pctB = seriesB.map(s=>({axis:s.axis, value:s.value, pct:Math.round(100*s.value/maxVal)}));

    res.json({ ok:true, days, axes, now:pctA, prev:pctB });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

```html
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const cx=cvs.width/2, cy=cvs.height/2, R=Math.min(cx,cy)-16, N=rows.length||1;
  const ang=i=>-Math.PI/2+i*(2*Math.PI/N);

  // grid
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1f2942'; [0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(k=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*k,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();});
  // axes + labels

  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const a=ang(i); const x=cx+Math.cos(a)*R, y=cy+Math.sin(a)*R;
    ctx.strokeStyle='#223'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy); ctx.lineTo(x,y); ctx.stroke();
    const lx=cx+Math.cos(a)*(R+10), ly=cy+Math.sin(a)*(R+10);
    ctx.textAlign = (Math.cos(a)>0.3)?'left':(Math.cos(a)<-0.3)?'right':'center';
    ctx.fillText(r.axis, lx, ly);
  });
  // polygon
  ctx.beginPath();
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const a=ang(i), rad=R*(Number(r.pct||0)/100); const x=cx+Math.cos(a)*rad, y=cy+Math.sin(a)*rad; i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);});
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(108,207,255,.22)'; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle='#6cf'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();

  erNote.textContent = `axes: ${rows.length} • window: ${js.days}d`;
}

function renderRadarCompare(js){
  const A = js.now||[], B = js.prev||[];
  const cvs = document.getElementById('erChart'), ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const cx=cvs.width/2, cy=cvs.height/2, R=Math.min(cx,cy)-16, N=(A.length||B.length||1);
  const ang=i=>-Math.PI/2+i*(2*Math.PI/N);

  // grid + axes (from A or B labels)
  const rows = A.length?A:B;
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1f2942'; [0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(k=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*k,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();});
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb'; ctx.font='12px system-ui, sans-serif';
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const a=ang(i); const x=cx+Math.cos(a)*R, y=cy+Math.sin(a)*R;
    ctx.strokeStyle='#223'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy); ctx.lineTo(x,y); ctx.stroke();
    const lx=cx+Math.cos(a)*(R+10), ly=cy+Math.sin(a)*(R+10);
    ctx.textAlign = (Math.cos(a)>0.3)?'left':(Math.cos(a)<-0.3)?'right':'center';
    ctx.fillText(r.axis, lx, ly);
  });

  // helper
  function poly(rows, fill, stroke){
    ctx.beginPath();
    rows.forEach((r,i)=>{ const a=ang(i), rad=R*(Number(r.pct||0)/100); const x=cx+Math.cos(a)*rad, y=cy+Math.sin(a)*rad; i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);});
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle=fill; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle=stroke; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
  }

  // draw B (last week) first, then A (this week) on top
  poly(B, 'rgba(245,197,66,.18)', '#f5c542');   // amber
  poly(A, 'rgba(108,207,255,.22)', '#6cf');     // blue

  erNote.textContent = `axes: ${rows.length} • window: ${js.days}d • blue=this • amber=prev`;
}

// react to toggle
erCmp.addEventListener('change', drawRadar);
</script>
```

```js
    [partner_id,scope,granted],
```

```js
  const q = req.query||{};
  const where = [];
  const args = [];
  if(q.partner_id){ where.push('partner_id=?'); args.push(q.partner_id); }
  if(q.since){ where.push('ts>=?'); args.push(q.since); }
  if(q.until){ where.push('ts<?'); args.push(q.until); }
  const sql = `SELECT c.*, p.name AS partner
               FROM contrib c LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=c.partner_id
               ${where.length?'WHERE '+where.join(' AND '):''}
               ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 500`;
  db.all(sql,args,(e,rows)=> e?res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}):res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});
```

## 4) Split rules + compute split

```js
// set rules
app.post('/api/split/rule', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { kind=null, weight=1.0, active=1 } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO split_rules(kind,weight,active) VALUES(?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING`,[kind,weight,active],
          (e)=> e?res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}):res.json({ok:true}));
});

// compute & persist a pool
app.post('/api/split/run', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { ts_start, ts_end, pool_amount=0, note='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!ts_start || !ts_end) return res.json({ok:false,error:'ts_start/ts_end required'});

  db.all(`SELECT kind, units, partner_id FROM contrib WHERE ts>=? AND ts<?`, [ts_start, ts_end], (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    // load weights
    db.all(`SELECT kind,weight FROM split_rules WHERE active=1`,[],(er,rr)=>{
      if(er) return res.json({ok:false,error:er.message});
      const wmap = new Map(rr.map(r=>[r.kind||'__default__', Number(r.weight||1)]));
      const wdef = wmap.get('__default__') ?? 1;

      // score = units * weight(kind)
      const byPartner = new Map();
      for(const r of (rows||[])){
        const k = (r.kind||'__default__');
        const w = wmap.get(k) ?? wdef;
        const score = Number(r.units||0) * Number(w);
        if(!byPartner.get(r.partner_id)) byPartner.set(r.partner_id, { units:0, score:0 });
        byPartner.get(r.partner_id).units += Number(r.units||0);
        byPartner.get(r.partner_id).score += score;
      }
      const totalScore = Array.from(byPartner.values()).reduce((s,x)=>s+x.score,0) || 1;

      // create pool
      db.run(`INSERT INTO split_pool(ts_start,ts_end,pool_amount,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
        [ts_start,ts_end,pool_amount,note],
        function(e2){
          if(e2) return res.json({ok:false,error:e2.message});
          const pool_id = this.lastID;

          // write results
          const stmt = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO split_result(pool_id,partner_id,units,weight,score,pct,amount) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`);
          for(const [pid,agg] of byPartner){
            const pct = agg.score/totalScore;
            const amount = Number(pool_amount||0) * pct;
            stmt.run([pool_id,pid,agg.units,1,agg.score,pct,amount]);
          }
          stmt.finalize(()=>{
            db.all(`SELECT sr.*, p.name FROM split_result sr LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=sr.partner_id WHERE pool_id=? ORDER BY amount DESC`,[pool_id],(e3,rows3)=>{
              if(e3) return res.json({ok:false,error:e3.message});
              res.json({ok:true,pool_id,rows:rows3,total_score:totalScore});
            });
          });
        });
    });
  });
});

// export split as CSV
app.get('/api/split/export.csv', (req,res)=>{
  const pool_id = Number(req.query.pool_id||0);
  db.all(`SELECT sr.*, p.name, p.email FROM split_result sr LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=sr.partner_id WHERE pool_id=? ORDER BY amount DESC`,[pool_id],(e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.status(500).send('error');
    const head = 'partner,units,score,pct,amount,email\n';
    const body = (rows||[]).map(r=>[
      (r.name||'').replace(/"/g,'""'),
      r.units,
      r.score,
      (r.pct*100).toFixed(2)+'%',
      r.amount.toFixed(2),
      (r.email||'').replace(/"/g,'""')
    ].map(x=>`"${x}"`).join(',')).join('\n');
    res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/csv; charset=utf-8');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition','attachment; filename="aumnity_split_${pool_id}.csv"');
    res.send(head+body);
  });
});
```

```js
// ===== Partner View (read-only via ?token=) =====
import path from 'path';
import fs from 'fs';

// helper: load partner by token
function getPartnerByToken(token){
  return new Promise((ok,err)=>{
    db.get(`SELECT * FROM partners WHERE token=?`, [token], (e,row)=> e?err(e):ok(row||null));
  });
}
// helper: consents map
function getConsents(partner_id){
  return new Promise((ok,err)=>{
    db.all(`SELECT scope, granted FROM consents WHERE partner_id=?`, [partner_id], (e,rows)=>{
      if(e) return err(e);
      const map = {};
      for(const r of (rows||[])) map[r.scope] = !!r.granted;
      ok(map);
    });
  });
}

app.get('/api/partner_view', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const token = (req.query.token||'').trim();
    const days  = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||30));
    if(!token) return res.json({ok:false, error:'missing token'});

    const partner = await getPartnerByToken(token);
    if(!partner) return res.json({ok:false, error:'invalid token'});

    const cons = await getConsents(partner.id);
    const sinceExpr = `datetime('now','-${days} day')`;

    // always: own contributions (last N days)
    const contrib = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
      db.all(
        `SELECT ts, kind, units, note
         FROM contrib
         WHERE partner_id=? AND ts >= ${sinceExpr}
         ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 300`,
        [partner.id], (e,rows)=> e?err(e):ok(rows||[])
      );
    });

    // latest split pool and this partner's slice (if exists)
    const latestSplit = await new Promise((ok)=>{
      db.get(`SELECT id, ts_start, ts_end, pool_amount FROM split_pool ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`, [], (_e,row)=>{
        if(!row) return ok(null);
        db.get(
          `SELECT sr.*, p.name
           FROM split_result sr
           LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=sr.partner_id
           WHERE pool_id=? AND partner_id=?`,
           [row.id, partner.id],
           (_e2, row2)=> ok({ pool: row, mine: row2 || null })
        );
      });
    });

    // optional sections by consent
    const sections = {};
    if(cons.see_progress){
      sections.progress = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
        db.all(
          `SELECT ts, note
           FROM reward_log
           WHERE kind='focus' AND ts >= ${sinceExpr}
           ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100`,
          [], (e,rows)=> e?err(e):ok(rows||[])
        );
      });
    }
    if(cons.see_reflection){
      sections.reflections = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
        db.all(
          `SELECT ts, note
           FROM reward_log
           WHERE kind='reflect' AND ts >= ${sinceExpr}
           ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100`,
          [], (e,rows)=> e?err(e):ok(rows||[])
        );
      });
    }
    if(cons.see_voice){
      sections.voice = await new Promise((ok,err)=>{
        db.all(
          `SELECT ts, text
           FROM summaries
           WHERE kind='mirror' AND ts >= ${sinceExpr}
           ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100`,
          [], (e,rows)=> e?err(e):ok(rows||[])
        );
      });
    }

    res.json({
      ok:true,
      days,
      partner: { id:partner.id, name:partner.name, email:partner.email, role:partner.role, created_at:partner.created_at },
      consents: cons,
      contrib,
      split: latestSplit,   // { pool:{...}, mine:{...} } or null
      sections
    });
  }catch(e){
    res.json({ok:false, error:e.message});
  }
});

// (optional) serve partner.html if you don’t already serve static files
app.get('/partner.html', (_req,res)=>{
  try{
    const file = path.join(process.cwd(), 'partner.html');
    if(fs.existsSync(file)) return res.sendFile(file);
    res.status(404).send('partner.html not found — place it beside server.js');
  }catch{
    res.status(500).send('error');
  }
});
```

# 1) Partner Radar (per-partner balance view)

## 🔧 `server.js` — endpoint (counts their contributions by kind and maps to axes)
```js
// --- Partner radar by token (contrib-based) ---
app.get('/api/partner/radar', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const token = String(req.query.token||'').trim();
    const days  = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||30));
    if(!token) return res.json({ok:false,error:'missing token'});

    const partner = await new Promise((ok,err)=>db.get(
      `SELECT * FROM partners WHERE token=?`,[token],(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r)
    ));
    if(!partner) return res.json({ok:false,error:'invalid token'});

    const since = `datetime('now','-${days} day')`;
    const rows = await new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(
      `SELECT kind, COUNT(*) c FROM contrib
       WHERE partner_id=? AND ts >= ${since}
       GROUP BY kind`, [partner.id], (e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])
    ));
    // default axes mapping
    const axes = [
      { axis:'Focus',    kinds:['code','research','ops'] },
      { axis:'Voice',    kinds:['voice'] },
      { axis:'Design',   kinds:['design'] },
      { axis:'Learning', kinds:['learning'] }
    ];
    const m = new Map(rows.map(r=>[String(r.kind||'').toLowerCase(), Number(r.c||0)]));
    const series = axes.map(a=>({ axis:a.axis, value:(a.kinds||[]).reduce((s,k)=>s+(m.get(k)||0),0) }));
    const max = Math.max(1, ...series.map(s=>s.value));
    const pct = series.map(s=>({ axis:s.axis, value:s.value, pct: Math.round(100*s.value/max) }));
    res.json({ok:true, days, series:pct});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

```html
<div class="card">
  <h3>🎯 My Balance (last <span id="pvRDays">30</span>d)</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:10px">
    <label>days <input id="pvRWin" type="number" min="7" max="365" value="30" style="width:80px"></label>
    <button id="pvRRun" class="pill">Refresh</button>
    <span id="pvRNote" class="mut">—</span>
  </div>
  <canvas id="pvRadar" width="420" height="300" style="width:100%;height:300px;background:#0f1320;border-radius:10px;margin-top:8px"></canvas>
</div>

<script>
async function drawPvRadar(){
  const token = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('token')||'';
  const days  = Math.max(7, Math.min(365, Number(pvRWin.value||30)));
  pvRDays.textContent = days;
  pvRNote.textContent='…';
  const js = await (await fetch(location.origin+'/api/partner/radar?token='+encodeURIComponent(token)+'&days='+days)).json();
  if(!js.ok){ pvRNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  const rows = js.series||[];
  const cvs = document.getElementById('pvRadar'), ctx = cvs.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const cx=cvs.width/2, cy=cvs.height/2, R=Math.min(cx,cy)-16, N=rows.length||1, ang=i=>-Math.PI/2+i*(2*Math.PI/N);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#1f2942'; [0.25,0.5,0.75,1].forEach(k=>{ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx,cy,R*k,0,2*Math.PI);ctx.stroke();});
  ctx.fillStyle='#9fb'; ctx.font='12px system-ui,sans-serif';
  rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const a=ang(i),x=cx+Math.cos(a)*R,y=cy+Math.sin(a)*R;ctx.strokeStyle='#223';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(x,y);ctx.stroke();
    const lx=cx+Math.cos(a)*(R+10), ly=cy+Math.sin(a)*(R+10); ctx.textAlign=(Math.cos(a)>0.3)?'left':(Math.cos(a)<-0.3)?'right':'center'; ctx.fillText(r.axis,lx,ly);});
  ctx.beginPath(); rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const a=ang(i),rad=R*(Number(r.pct||0)/100),x=cx+Math.cos(a)*rad,y=cy+Math.sin(a)*rad; i?ctx.lineTo(x,y):ctx.moveTo(x,y);});
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle='rgba(108,207,255,.22)'; ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle='#6cf'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.stroke();
  pvRNote.textContent=`axes:${rows.length}`;
}
pvRRun?.addEventListener('click', drawPvRadar);
window.addEventListener('load', ()=> setTimeout(drawPvRadar, 50));
</script>
```

# 2) Voice Sister Sync (record → upload → auto-mirror)

## 🔧 `server.js` — accept audio upload, store file, auto-mirror summary
```js
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
app.use('/voices', express.static(path.join(process.cwd(),'voices')));

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_meta(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  filename TEXT,
  duration REAL,
  energy INTEGER,
  entry_id INTEGER
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS summaries(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  kind TEXT,   -- 'mirror'|'nudge'|...
  text TEXT
)`);

// helper: quick mirror summary by auto-tags (local heuristic)
async function mirrorFrom(text){
  const s = String(text||'').trim();
  if(!s) return 'Voice received.';
  const low = s.toLowerCase();
  const feels = [];
  if(/grateful|thank|bless/.test(low)) feels.push('gratitude');
  if(/tired|stress|angry|overwhelm|sad/.test(low)) feels.push('strain');
  return `I heard: ${s.slice(0,160)}${s.length>160?'…':''}\nSense: ${feels.join(', ')||'neutral'}.`;
}

// upload (base64 dataURL) → /voices/voice_*.webm
app.post('/api/voice/upload', express.json({limit:'30mb'}), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const { dataUrl, duration=0, energy=0, note='' } = req.body||{};
    if(!dataUrl?.startsWith('data:audio/webm;base64,')) return res.json({ok:false,error:'expect audio/webm dataUrl'});
    const b64 = dataUrl.split(',')[1]; const buf = Buffer.from(b64,'base64');
    if(!fs.existsSync('voices')) fs.mkdirSync('voices');
    const fn = 'voice_'+Date.now()+'.webm'; fs.writeFileSync(path.join('voices',fn), buf);
    // store meta
    const vId = await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.run(`INSERT INTO voice_meta(filename,duration,energy) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[fn,Number(duration)||0,Number(energy)||0],
        function(){ ok(this.lastID); });
    });
    // auto-mirror summary (using note text as proxy; in a real setup use STT)
    const mirror = await mirrorFrom(note||'');
    await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.run(`INSERT INTO summaries(kind,text) VALUES('mirror',?)`,[mirror], function(){ ok(this.lastID); });
    });
    res.json({ok:true, file:'/voices/'+fn, id:vId});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

## 🖥️ `aum_dashboard.html` — Voice Capture card (record → upload)
Paste this card:

```html
<section class="card span12">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🎤 Voice Sister — Capture</h3>
  <div class="row" style="gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">
    <button id="vcStart">Start</button>
    <button id="vcStop" class="secondary" disabled>Stop</button>
    <input id="vcNote" placeholder="optional note (what you said / topic)" style="min-width:260px">
    <span id="vcMsg" class="mut">—</span>
  </div>
  <audio id="vcPlay" controls style="margin-top:8px;display:none"></audio>
</section>

<script>
let _rec, _chunks=[];
async function vcStartRec(){
  vcMsg.textContent='…';
  const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true});
  _chunks=[]; _rec = new MediaRecorder(stream,{mimeType:'audio/webm'});
  _rec.ondataavailable = e=>{ if(e.data.size) _chunks.push(e.data); };
  _rec.onstop = async ()=>{
    const blob = new Blob(_chunks,{type:'audio/webm'}), url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    vcPlay.src = url; vcPlay.style.display='block';
    // read to dataURL
    const b64 = await new Promise(r=>{ const fr=new FileReader(); fr.onload=()=>r(fr.result); fr.readAsDataURL(blob); });
    // crude energy estimate
    const energy = Math.min(100, Math.round(blob.size/1024)); // proxy
    // no duration easily; leave 0 or estimate
    const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/upload',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({dataUrl:b64, duration:0, energy, note:vcNote.value||''})})).json();
    vcMsg.textContent = js.ok ? 'uploaded ✓' : 'upload error';
  };
  _rec.start(); vcStart.disabled=true; vcStop.disabled=false; vcMsg.textContent='recording…';
}
function vcStopRec(){
  if(_rec && _rec.state!=='inactive'){ _rec.stop(); }
  vcStart.disabled=false; vcStop.disabled=true;
}
vcStart.addEventListener('click', vcStartRec);
vcStop.addEventListener('click', vcStopRec);
</script>
```

This gives you a working local **record → upload → auto-mirror** loop, with files saved under `/voices`.

# 3) Cloud Bridge (optional sync: export/push/pull JSON)

## 🔧 `server.js` — export & import
```js
// --- Sync: export compact JSON for selected tables ---
app.get('/api/sync/export', (req,res)=>{
  const since = req.query.since ? `WHERE ts >= ?` : '';
  const arg = req.query.since ? [req.query.since] : [];
  const grab = (sql,args=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,args,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
  (async()=>{
    const reward = await grab(`SELECT * FROM reward_log ${since} ORDER BY ts ASC`, arg);
    const voice  = await grab(`SELECT * FROM voice_meta ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const sums   = await grab(`SELECT * FROM summaries ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    const parts  = await grab(`SELECT * FROM partners ORDER BY id ASC`);
    const cons   = await grab(`SELECT * FROM consents ORDER BY updated_at ASC`);
    const cont   = await grab(`SELECT * FROM contrib ORDER BY ts ASC`);
    res.json({ok:true, payload:{ reward, voice, sums, parts, cons, cont }});
  })().catch(e=>res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}));
});

// --- Sync: import (merge) ---
app.post('/api/sync/import', express.json({limit:'10mb'}), (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const p = req.body?.payload||{};
    const tx = db; // simple upserts
    const ins = (sql,vals)=>new Promise(ok=>tx.run(sql,vals,()=>ok()));
    (async()=>{
      for(const r of (p.reward||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reward_log(id,ts,kind,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,[r.id,r.ts,r.kind,r.note]);
      for(const v of (p.voice||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_meta(id,ts,filename,duration,energy,entry_id) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
                  [v.id,v.ts,v.filename,v.duration,v.energy,v.entry_id]);
      for(const s of (p.sums||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO summaries(id,ts,kind,text) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,[s.id,s.ts,s.kind,s.text]);
      for(const a of (p.parts||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO partners(id,name,email,role,token,created_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
                  [a.id,a.name,a.email,a.role,a.token,a.created_at]);
      for(const c of (p.cons||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO consents(id,partner_id,scope,granted,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,
                  [c.id,c.partner_id,c.scope,c.granted,c.updated_at]);
      for(const k of (p.cont||[]))
        await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO contrib(id,ts,partner_id,kind,units,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
                  [k.id,k.ts,k.partner_id,k.kind,k.units,k.note]);
      res.json({ok:true});
    })();
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

```html
async function syncExport(){
  syncNote.textContent='…';

  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/sync/export'+qs)).json();
  if(!js.ok){ syncNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  await navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(js.payload,null,2));

}
async function syncPush(){
  if(!syncUrl.value) return syncNote.textContent='set remote URL';
  const exp = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/sync/export')).json();
  const js = await (await fetch(syncUrl.value.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/api/sync/import',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({payload:exp.payload})})).json();
  syncNote.textContent = js.ok ? 'pushed ✓' : 'push error';
}
async function syncPull(){
  if(!syncUrl.value) return syncNote.textContent='set remote URL';
  const js = await (await fetch(syncUrl.value.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/api/sync/export')).json();
  if(!js.ok) return syncNote.textContent='pull error';
  const imp = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/sync/import',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({payload:js.payload})})).json();
  syncNote.textContent = imp.ok ? 'pulled ✓' : 'import error';
}
syncExport.addEventListener('click', syncExport);
syncPush.addEventListener('click', syncPush);
syncPull.addEventListener('click', syncPull);
</script>
```

# 🧩 1) `server.js` — DB upgrades + APIs

### A) Tables (add near your DB init)
```js
// Store transcript text separately (one row per voice)
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_text(
  voice_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  transcript TEXT
)`);

// Generic tag table (if you don't already have it)
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tags(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT UNIQUE
)`);

// Map tags to voice notes
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_tag_map(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  voice_id INTEGER,
  tag_id INTEGER,
  UNIQUE(voice_id, tag_id)
)`);
```

### B) Helper functions
```js
function upsertTag(name){
  return new Promise((ok,err)=>{
    db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO tags(name) VALUES(?)`, [name], e=>{
      if(e) return err(e);
      db.get(`SELECT id FROM tags WHERE name=?`, [name], (e2,row)=>{
        if(e2) return err(e2);
        ok(row?.id);
      });
    });
  });
}
```

### C) Emotion rules (simple, transparent, local)
```js
function analyzeEmotion({ text='', energy=0, duration=0 }){
  const t = String(text||'').toLowerCase();
  const tags = new Set();

  // text cues
  if (/\b(grateful|gratitude|thank|bless|peace|calm)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('gratitude').add('calm');
  if (/\b(tired|exhaust|fatigue|sleepy)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('tired');
  if (/\b(stress|overwhelm|worry|anxious|pressure)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('stress');
  if (/\b(angry|irritated|frustrat)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('irritated');
  if (/\b(focus|progress|done|ship)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('focus');
  if (/\b(learn|study|practice|python|nlp)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('learning');
  if (/\b(voice|audio|speak|talk)\b/.test(t)) tags.add('voice');

  // prosody proxies
  if (energy > 70) tags.add('high_energy');
  if (energy < 20) tags.add('low_energy');
  if (duration >= 60) tags.add('long_form');

  if (!tags.size) tags.add('neutral');
  return Array.from(tags);
}
```

### D) API: analyze text → tags (no DB write)
```js
app.post('/api/voice/analyze', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const { text='', energy=0, duration=0 } = req.body||{};
    const tags = analyzeEmotion({ text, energy:Number(energy)||0, duration:Number(duration)||0 });
    res.json({ ok:true, tags });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message }); }
});
```

### E) API: save transcript + tags to a voice item
```js
app.post('/api/voice/save', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const { voice_id, transcript='', tags=[] } = req.body||{};
    if(!voice_id) return res.json({ok:false,error:'voice_id required'});

    // upsert transcript
    await new Promise(ok=>{
      db.run(`INSERT INTO voice_text(voice_id,transcript) VALUES(?,?)
              ON CONFLICT(voice_id) DO UPDATE SET transcript=excluded.transcript`,
              [voice_id, transcript], ()=>ok());
    });

    // map tags
    for(const tag of (tags||[])){
      const tid = await upsertTag(String(tag).trim());
      await new Promise(ok=>{
        db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_tag_map(voice_id,tag_id) VALUES(?,?)`, [voice_id, tid], ()=>ok());
      });
    }
    res.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});
```

### F) API: list recent voice items with tags for UI
```js
app.get('/api/voice/list', (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(365, Number(req.query.days||14));
  const sql = `
    SELECT v.id, v.ts, v.filename, v.duration, v.energy,
           vt.transcript,
           GROUP_CONCAT(t.name, ',') AS tags
    FROM voice_meta v
    LEFT JOIN voice_text vt ON vt.voice_id=v.id
    LEFT JOIN voice_tag_map vtm ON vtm.voice_id=v.id
    LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id=vtm.tag_id
    WHERE v.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
    GROUP BY v.id
    ORDER BY v.ts DESC
    LIMIT 200`;
  db.all(sql, [`-${days} day`], (e,rows)=>{
    if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
    res.json({ok:true, rows});
  });
});
```

> Your existing `/api/voice/upload` stays the same — it returns `{ ok:true, file, id }`. We’ll extend the UI to attach transcript+tags after upload.

```html
// Optional live transcription via Web Speech API (if available)
function makeSpeechRecognizer(targetEl){
  const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
  if(!SR) return null;
  const r = new SR();
  r.lang = 'en-US';
  r.continuous = false;
  r.interimResults = true;
  let buf = '';
  r.onresult = (ev)=>{
    buf = '';
    for(let i=0;i<ev.results.length;i++){
      buf += ev.results[i][0].transcript + ' ';
    }
    targetEl.value = buf.trim();
  };
  r.onerror = ()=>{};
  return r;
}

async function loadVoices(){
  vtNote.textContent='…';
  const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(365, Number(vtDays.value||14)));

  if(!js.ok){ vtNote.textContent='error'; return; }
  vtList.innerHTML = (js.rows||[]).map(r=>{
    const audioUrl = r.filename ? (location.origin + '/voices/' + r.filename) : '';
    const tags = (r.tags||'').split(',').filter(Boolean);
    return `
      <div style="padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #223">
        <div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between">
          <div><b>#${r.id}</b> <span class="mut">${new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString()}</span></div>
          <div class="mut">dur: ${Math.round(r.duration||0)}s • energy: ${r.energy||0}</div>
        </div>
        ${audioUrl ? `<audio src="${audioUrl}" controls style="width:100%;margin-top:6px"></audio>`:''}
        <textarea id="vtText_${r.id}" rows="3" style="margin-top:6px;width:100%;background:#0b1424;color:#e8f2ff;border:1px solid #223;border-radius:8px;padding:8px" placeholder="Transcript (type or use mic)…">${(r.transcript||'')}</textarea>
        <div class="row" style="gap:6px;margin-top:6px">
          <button class="secondary" onclick="vtMic(${r.id})">🎙️ mic</button>
          <button onclick="vtAnalyze(${r.id}, ${r.energy||0}, ${r.duration||0})">Analyze</button>
          <button class="secondary" onclick="vtSave(${r.id})">Save</button>
          <span id="vtMsg_${r.id}" class="mut">—</span>
        </div>
        <div id="vtTags_${r.id}" style="margin-top:6px">${tags.map(t=>`<span class="pill">#${t}</span>`).join(' ')}</div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('') || '<i>No voice notes in window</i>';
  vtNote.textContent = `items: ${(js.rows||[]).length}`;
}

let _recognizers = {};
function vtMic(id){
  const ta = document.getElementById('vtText_'+id);
  if(!ta) return;
  if(!_recognizers[id]){
    const r = makeSpeechRecognizer(ta);
    if(!r){ alert('SpeechRecognition not available in this browser. Type manually.'); return; }
    _recognizers[id] = r;
  }
  const r = _recognizers[id];
  try{ r.start(); document.getElementById('vtMsg_'+id).textContent='listening…'; }
  catch{ /* already started */ }
}

async function vtAnalyze(id, energy, duration){
  const ta = document.getElementById('vtText_'+id);
  const msg = document.getElementById('vtMsg_'+id);
  msg.textContent='…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/analyze',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({ text: ta.value||'', energy, duration })})).json();
  if(!js.ok){ msg.textContent='error'; return; }
  document.getElementById('vtTags_'+id).innerHTML = js.tags.map(t=>`<span class="pill">#${t}</span>`).join(' ');
  msg.textContent='analyzed ✓';
}

async function vtSave(id){
  const ta = document.getElementById('vtText_'+id);
  const tags = Array.from(document.getElementById('vtTags_'+id).querySelectorAll('.pill')).map(x=>x.textContent.replace('#','').trim());
  const msg = document.getElementById('vtMsg_'+id);
  msg.textContent='…';
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/voice/save',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({ voice_id:id, transcript: ta.value||'', tags })})).json();
  msg.textContent = js.ok ? 'saved ✓' : 'save error';
}

vtRefresh.addEventListener('click', loadVoices);
window.addEventListener('load', loadVoices);
</script>
```

# 📊 3) (Optional) Tiny Emotion Heatline (last 7 days)

Add this **mini canvas** anywhere to see daily tag counts quickly:

```html
<section class="card span12">
  <h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">🌡️ Emotion Heatline (7d)</h3>
  <canvas id="eh7" width="920" height="120" style="width:100%;height:120px;background:#0f1320;border-radius:10px"></canvas>
</section>

<script>
async function drawHeatline(){
  const js = await (await fetch(UAPI+'/tags/month_stats?days=7')).json();
  if(!js.ok) return;
  const rows = js.rows||[];
  const top = rows.slice(0,6); // top 6 tags
  const cvs = document.getElementById('eh7'), ctx=cvs.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,cvs.width,cvs.height);
  const W=cvs.width, H=cvs.height, lane=H/(top.length||1);
  const col = i => `hsl(${(i*47)%360} 70% 55%)`;
  top.forEach((r,i)=>{
    const y=i*lane, w = Math.max(6, (Number(r.c||0)/Math.max(1,js.total))*W);
    ctx.fillStyle=col(i); ctx.fillRect(0,y+6,w,lane-12);
    ctx.fillStyle='#9fb'; ctx.font='12px system-ui,sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`${r.tag} (${r.c})`, 8, y+lane/2+4);
  });
}
window.addEventListener('load', drawHeatline);
</script>
```

# 🧩 D) `server.js` — PulseNet Bridge (push / pull / import)

We’ll keep it simple and private: **shared secret** + compact JSON.  
(Optional) set `process.env.AUMNITY_SECRET` (falls back to `'aumnity'`).

```js
import crypto from 'crypto';
const PULSE_SECRET = process.env.AUMNITY_SECRET || 'aumnity';

function pnSeal(obj){
  const json = JSON.stringify(obj);
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(12);
  const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(PULSE_SECRET).digest();
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  const enc = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(json,'utf8'), cipher.final()]);
  const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();
  return Buffer.concat([iv, tag, enc]).toString('base64');
}
function pnOpen(b64){
  const buf = Buffer.from(b64, 'base64');
  const iv = buf.slice(0,12);
  const tag = buf.slice(12,28);
  const enc = buf.slice(28);
  const key = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(PULSE_SECRET).digest();
  const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  decipher.setAuthTag(tag);
  const dec = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(enc), decipher.final()]).toString('utf8');
  return JSON.parse(dec);
}

// Compose compact state for the last N days
async function pnSnapshot(days=3){
  const grab = (sql, args=[]) => new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,args,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
  const since = `-${days} day`;
  const reward = await grab(`SELECT ts,kind,note FROM reward_log WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [since]);
  const voice  = await grab(`SELECT id,ts,filename,duration,energy FROM voice_meta WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [since]);
  const sums   = await grab(`SELECT ts,kind,text FROM summaries WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [since]);
  const contrib= await grab(`SELECT ts,partner_id,kind,units,note FROM contrib WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [since]);
  const karma  = await grab(`SELECT ts,action,points,note FROM karma_log WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY ts ASC`, [since]);
  return { meta:{ node:'AUMNITY', days }, reward, voice, sums, contrib, karma };
}

// Export sealed
app.get('/api/pulsenet/push', async (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.query.days||3));
  const payload = await pnSnapshot(days);
  const sealed = pnSeal(payload);
  res.json({ ok:true, sealed, size: sealed.length });
});

// Import sealed
app.post('/api/pulsenet/import', express.json({limit:'5mb'}), (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const sealed = String(req.body?.sealed||'');
    if(!sealed) return res.json({ ok:false, error:'sealed required' });
    const obj = pnOpen(sealed);
    const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(sealed, 'base64');
    db.run(`INSERT INTO pulsenet_inbox(source,status,bytes,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
      [obj?.meta?.node||'node', 'stored', bytes, `days:${obj?.meta?.days||'?'}`]);

    // merge (conflict-safe inserts)
    const ins = (sql,vals)=>new Promise(ok=>db.run(sql,vals,()=>ok()));
    for(const r of (obj.reward||[]))
      await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reward_log(ts,kind,note) VALUES(?,?,?)`, [r.ts,r.kind,r.note]);
    for(const s of (obj.sums||[]))
      await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO summaries(ts,kind,text) VALUES(?,?,?)`, [s.ts,s.kind,s.text]);
    for(const v of (obj.voice||[]))
      await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_meta(id,ts,filename,duration,energy) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,
                [v.id,v.ts,v.filename,v.duration,v.energy]);
    for(const k of (obj.karma||[]))
      await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO karma_log(ts,action,points,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
                [k.ts,k.action,k.points,k.note]);
    for(const c of (obj.contrib||[]))
      await ins(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO contrib(ts,partner_id,kind,units,note) VALUES(?,?,?, ?,?)`,
                [c.ts, c.partner_id, c.kind, c.units, c.note]);

    res.json({ ok:true, imported:true });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message }); }
});
```

# 🧩 E) `server.js` — Harmony Engine (daily insight)

It reads your recent rhythm (reward_log, voice tags, karma) and returns **one actionable suggestion**.

```js
app.get('/api/harmony/insight', async (_req,res)=>{
  try{
    const grab = (sql,args=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,args,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
    const focus = await grab(`SELECT strftime('%H',ts) AS hh, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY hh`);
    const refl  = await grab(`SELECT strftime('%H',ts) AS hh, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE kind='reflect' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY hh`);
    const karma = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC`);
    const voice = await grab(`SELECT vt.transcript t, v.energy e FROM voice_text vt JOIN voice_meta v ON v.id=vt.voice_id WHERE v.ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') ORDER BY v.ts DESC LIMIT 30`);

    // find hour with best focus density
    let bestHour='21', bestC=0; for(const r of focus){ if(Number(r.c)>bestC){bestC=Number(r.c);bestHour=r.hh;} }
    // detect late-night strain: reflections after 23 correlated with low karma next day
    const lateRef = refl.some(r=> Number(r.hh)>=23 );
    const lowStreak = karma.slice(0,3).filter(k=> Number(k.p||0) < 5 ).length >= 2;

    let tip;
    if(lateRef && lowStreak){
      tip = `Shift reflections to ${bestHour}:00–${(Number(bestHour)+1)%24}:00 for the next 3 days; your late-night entries correlate with low next-day energy.`;
    }else if(bestC>=2){
      tip = `Protect your high-focus hour at ${bestHour}:00 — set Do-Not-Disturb for a 45-minute build block.`;
    }else if(voice.some(v=>(v.e||0)>=80)){
      tip = `Channel the high voice energy into a 20-minute “ship” task today (tiny feature or cleanup).`;
    }else{
      tip = `Keep it gentle: one line in Progress and one voice note before 21:30 — consistency beats volume.`;
    }
    res.json({ ok:true, tip, bestHour, stats:{focus, refl, karma:karma.slice(0,7)} });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message }); }
});
```

### C) API: **build split from karma** (creates `split_pool` + `split_result`)
```js
app.post('/api/split/from_karma', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { amount=0, days=14, you_maps_to=null, min_floor=0 } = req.body||{};
  const window = Math.min(365, Number(days||14));
  const poolAmount = Math.max(0, Number(amount||0));
  const floor = Math.max(0, Number(min_floor||0)); // optional minimum units floor

  db.serialize(()=>{
    // 1) aggregate karma
    db.all(
      `SELECT COALESCE(partner_id, -1) AS partner_id, SUM(points) AS pts
       FROM karma_log
       WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)
       GROUP BY COALESCE(partner_id, -1)`,
      [`-${window} day`],
      (e,rows)=>{
        if(e) return res.json({ok:false,error:e.message});
        if(!rows || !rows.length) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no karma in window'});

        // map 'you' (-1) to a real partner if provided
        const mapped = rows.map(r=>{
          const pid = (r.partner_id === -1 && you_maps_to) ? Number(you_maps_to) : r.partner_id;
          return { partner_id: pid, pts: Number(r.pts||0) };
        }).filter(r=> r.partner_id !== null && r.partner_id !== undefined);

        const sum = mapped.reduce((s,r)=> s + r.pts, 0);
        if(sum <= 0) return res.json({ok:false,error:'sum(karma)=0'});

        // 2) create pool
        db.run(`INSERT INTO split_pool(ts_start, ts_end, pool_amount) VALUES(datetime('now','-${window} day'), datetime('now'), ?)`,
          [poolAmount],
          function(err){
            if(err) return res.json({ok:false,error:err.message});
            const pool_id = this.lastID;

            // 3) insert results
            const stmt = db.prepare(`INSERT INTO split_result(pool_id, partner_id, units, score, pct, amount)
                                     VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`);
            mapped.forEach(r=>{
              const pct = r.pts / sum;
              const amt = poolAmount * pct;
              const units = Math.max(floor, r.pts);
              stmt.run([pool_id, r.partner_id, units, r.pts, pct, amt]);
            });
            stmt.finalize(()=>{
              res.json({ ok:true, pool_id, window, total_points: sum, participants: mapped.length });
            });
          });
      });
  });
});
```

# 🧠 3) Smarter Harmony Rules (trend-aware daily tip)

Replace your existing `/api/harmony/insight` with this upgraded version:

```js
app.get('/api/harmony/insight', async (_req,res)=>{
  try{
    const grab = (sql,args=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,args,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));

    // 14d focus/reflection distribution by hour
    const focus = await grab(`SELECT strftime('%H',ts) hh, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY hh`);
    const refl  = await grab(`SELECT strftime('%H',ts) hh, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE kind='reflect' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY hh`);
    // 14d karma trend
    const karma = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY d ORDER BY d ASC`);
    // emotion tags (if present)
    const tags  = await grab(`SELECT t.name tag, COUNT(*) c
                              FROM voice_tag_map vtm
                              JOIN tags t ON t.id=vtm.tag_id
                              JOIN voice_meta v ON vtm.voice_id=v.id
                              WHERE v.ts>=datetime('now','-14 day')
                              GROUP BY t.name
                              ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 8`);

    const bestHour = focus.reduce((m,r)=> Number(r.c)>(m.c||0)?{h:r.hh,c:Number(r.c)}:m, {}).h || '21';
    const lateRef  = refl.some(r=> Number(r.hh)>=23);
    // simple trend: last 3 vs previous 3 days
    const last3 = karma.slice(-3).reduce((s,k)=>s+Number(k.p||0),0);
    const prev3 = karma.slice(-6,-3).reduce((s,k)=>s+Number(k.p||0),0);
    const trend = (last3 - prev3);

    let tip='', why=[];
    if(lateRef && trend < 0){
      tip = `Shift reflections earlier (by 45 min). Try ${bestHour}:00 for the next 3 days.`;
      why.push('late-night reflections correlate with lower next-day energy');
    } else if(trend < 0){
      tip = `Do a “light day”: 1 tiny ship (≤15 min) + 1 gratitude voice note before 21:30.`;
      why.push('karma momentum dipped last 3 days');
    } else if((tags.find(t=>t.tag==='stress')?.c||0) > (tags.find(t=>t.tag==='calm')?.c||0)){
      tip = `Start with calm → 90 seconds breath, then one micro-task (≤10 min).`;
      why.push('stress > calm in recent voice tags');
    } else {
      tip = `Protect your high-focus hour at ${bestHour}:00 — 45-minute build block.`;
      why.push('focus density highest at that hour');
    }

    res.json({ ok:true, tip, because: why, stats:{ focus, refl, karma, tags }});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message }); }
});
```

## 2) Weekly split export + email drafts

### A) Latest split JSON + CSV
```js
app.get('/api/split/latest', (req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM split_pool ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,p)=>{
    if(e||!p) return res.json({ ok:false, error:'no split pool' });
    db.all(`SELECT sr.*, p.name, p.email
            FROM split_result sr
            LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=sr.partner_id
            WHERE sr.pool_id=? ORDER BY amount DESC`, [p.id], (e2,rows)=>{
      if(e2) return res.json({ ok:false, error:e2.message });
      res.json({ ok:true, pool:p, results: rows||[] });
    });
  });
});

app.get('/api/split/latest_csv', (req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM split_pool ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,p)=>{
    if(e||!p) return res.status(404).send('no split pool');
    db.all(`SELECT sr.*, p.name, p.email
            FROM split_result sr LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id=sr.partner_id
            WHERE sr.pool_id=? ORDER BY amount DESC`, [p.id], (e2,rows)=>{
      if(e2) return res.status(500).send('error');
      const header = ['partner_id','name','email','units','score','pct','amount'];
      const lines = [header.join(',')].concat(
        (rows||[]).map(r=>[
          r.partner_id,
          JSON.stringify(r.name||''),
          JSON.stringify(r.email||''),
          r.units, r.score,
          (Number(r.pct||0)).toFixed(6),
          (Number(r.amount||0)).toFixed(2)
        ].join(','))
      );
      res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/csv; charset=utf-8');
      res.setHeader('Content-Disposition','attachment; filename="split_latest.csv"');
      res.send(lines.join('\n'));
    });
  });
});
```

```js
— AUMNITY Core`;
```

# 1) 🧠 Cognitive Graph (Mind Map Engine)

### `server.js` — tables
```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS graph_node(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  kind TEXT,     -- 'voice'|'reflect'|'pulse'|'karma'
  ref_id INTEGER,
  label TEXT
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS graph_edge(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  a INTEGER, b INTEGER, rel TEXT, weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0
)`);
```

### `server.js` — build last N days from existing data
```js
async function gAddNode(kind, ref_id, ts, label){
  return await new Promise(ok=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO graph_node(kind,ref_id,ts,label) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
      [kind, ref_id, ts, label], function(){ ok(this.lastID); });
  });
}
function gAddEdge(a,b,rel,w=1){ db.run(`INSERT INTO graph_edge(a,b,rel,weight) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,[a,b,rel,w]); }

app.post('/api/graph/build', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.body?.days||7));
    const grab = (sql,args=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,args,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
    const since = `-${days} day`;
    const voice = await grab(`SELECT id,ts,energy FROM voice_meta WHERE ts>=datetime('now',?)`,[since]);
    const refl  = await grab(`SELECT ts,kind,text FROM summaries WHERE ts>=datetime('now',?)`,[since]);
    const focus = await grab(`SELECT ts,kind,note FROM reward_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now',?)`,[since]);
    const karma = await grab(`SELECT rowid id,ts,action,points FROM karma_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now',?)`,[since]);

    const idMap = { voice:new Map(), reflect:new Map(), pulse:new Map(), karma:new Map() };

    for(const v of voice){ idMap.voice.set(v.id, await gAddNode('voice', v.id, v.ts, `voice e${v.energy}`)); }
    for(const s of refl){ const nid = await gAddNode('reflect', null, s.ts, (s.text||'').slice(0,60)); idMap.reflect.set(nid, nid); }
    for(const f of focus){ const nid = await gAddNode('pulse', null, f.ts, f.kind||'focus'); idMap.pulse.set(nid,nid); }
    for(const k of karma){ idMap.karma.set(k.id, await gAddNode('karma', k.id, k.ts, `+${k.points} ${k.action}`)); }

    // simple relations
    // voice -> reflect (same day)
    await new Promise(ok=>db.all(`SELECT n1.id a, n2.id b FROM graph_node n1, graph_node n2
      WHERE n1.kind='voice' AND n2.kind='reflect' AND date(n1.ts)=date(n2.ts)`,[],(e,rows)=>{ rows?.forEach(r=>gAddEdge(r.a,r.b,'emotion_to_reflect',1)); ok();}));
    // reflect -> pulse (same day)
    await new Promise(ok=>db.all(`SELECT n1.id a, n2.id b FROM graph_node n1, graph_node n2
      WHERE n1.kind='reflect' AND n2.kind='pulse' AND date(n1.ts)=date(n2.ts)`,[],(e,rows)=>{ rows?.forEach(r=>gAddEdge(r.a,r.b,'reflect_to_focus',1)); ok();}));
    // pulse -> karma (same day)
    await new Promise(ok=>db.all(`SELECT n1.id a, n2.id b FROM graph_node n1, graph_node n2
      WHERE n1.kind='pulse' AND n2.kind='karma' AND date(n1.ts)=date(n2.ts)`,[],(e,rows)=>{ rows?.forEach(r=>gAddEdge(r.a,r.b,'action_to_reward',1)); ok();}));

    res.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});

app.get('/api/graph/motifs', (req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT rel, COUNT(*) c FROM graph_edge GROUP BY rel ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10`,[],(e,rows)=>{
    res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]});
  });
});
```
