# 3) 🔊 Voice Understanding (local NLP upgrade)

(You already have transcript + tags.) Add **intensity** + **valence** scoring.

### `server.js` — analyzer
```js
function scoreEmotion(text='', energy=0){
  const t = String(text||'').toLowerCase();
  let pos=0, neg=0;
  ['grateful','calm','hope','proud','peace','love','progress'].forEach(w=>{ if(t.includes(w)) pos+=1; });
  ['tired','stress','angry','sad','overwhelm','worry','stuck'].forEach(w=>{ if(t.includes(w)) neg+=1; });
  const valence = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (pos-neg)/3));          // -1..1
  const intensity = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, energy + 10*Math.abs(pos-neg)));
  return { valence, intensity };
}
app.post('/api/voice/annotate', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { text='', energy=0 } = req.body||{};
  const { valence, intensity } = scoreEmotion(text, Number(energy)||0);
  res.json({ ok:true, valence, intensity });
});
```

```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mesh_peer(
```

# 5) 📅 Flow Director (auto-plan & re-time)

### `server.js` — table + planner API
```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS flow_plan(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  when_hour INTEGER,     -- suggested hour 0-23
  task TEXT,             -- 'progress_line'|'voice_note'|'ship_15m'
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'planned'  -- 'planned'|'done'|'skipped'
)`);

app.post('/api/flow/plan', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const horizon = Math.min(7, Number(req.body?.days||1));
    // simple heuristic: use Harmony bestHour for a 45m build + 15m ship earlier
    const foc = await new Promise(ok=>db.all(`SELECT strftime('%H',ts) hh, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY hh`,[],(_e,r)=>ok(r||[])));
    let best='21', bestC=0; for(const r of foc) if(+r.c>bestC){bestC=+r.c; best=r.hh;}
    const shipHour = (Number(best)-1+24)%24;
    const items = [
      { when_hour: shipHour, task:'ship_15m' },
      { when_hour: Number(best), task:'progress_line' },
      { when_hour: (Number(best)+0)%24, task:'voice_note' }
    ];
    for(const it of items){
      db.run(`INSERT INTO flow_plan(when_hour,task) VALUES(?,?)`,[it.when_hour,it.task]);
    }
    res.json({ok:true, planned:items.length, bestHour:best});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false,error:e.message}); }
});

app.post('/api/flow/mark', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { id, status='done' } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE flow_plan SET status=? WHERE id=?`,[status,id],()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.get('/api/flow/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM flow_plan WHERE date(ts)=date('now') ORDER BY when_hour ASC`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 1) 🎧 Voice Emotion Engine (trend over days)

## `server.js` — tables + rollup API
```js
// 1) Emotion trend table
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emotion_trend(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT,                -- YYYY-MM-DD
  valence_avg REAL,      -- -1..1
  intensity_avg REAL     -- 0..100
)`);
db.run(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_emotion_trend_d ON emotion_trend(d)`);

// 2) Roll up last N days using your voice_meta + voice_text + /api/voice/annotate logic
app.post('/api/emotion/rollup', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(60, Number(req.body?.days||14));
  const grab = (sql,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(sql,a,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
  try{
    const rows = await grab(`
      SELECT date(v.ts) AS d, vt.transcript AS t, v.energy AS e
      FROM voice_meta v
      LEFT JOIN voice_text vt ON vt.voice_id = v.id
      WHERE v.ts >= datetime('now', ?)
    `,[`-${days} day`]);

    // simple inline scorer (same as your /voice/annotate)
    const score = (text='', energy=0)=>{
      const t = String(text||'').toLowerCase();
      let pos=0, neg=0;
      ['grateful','calm','hope','proud','peace','love','progress'].forEach(w=>t.includes(w)&&pos++);
      ['tired','stress','angry','sad','overwhelm','worry','stuck'].forEach(w=>t.includes(w)&&neg++);
      const val = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (pos-neg)/3));
      const inten = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Number(energy)||0) + 10*Math.abs(pos-neg)));
      return {val,inten};
    };

    // group by day
    const map = new Map();
    for(const r of rows){
      const {val,inten} = score(r.t||'', r.e||0);
      const k=r.d; const m = map.get(k)||{n:0, v:0, i:0};
      m.n++; m.v+=val; m.i+=inten; map.set(k,m);
    }
    db.serialize(()=>{
      for(const [d,m] of map.entries()){
        db.run(`INSERT INTO emotion_trend(d,valence_avg,intensity_avg)
                VALUES(?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET valence_avg=excluded.valence_avg, intensity_avg=excluded.intensity_avg`,
          [d, m.n?m.v/m.n:0, m.n?m.i/m.n:0]);
      }
    });
    res.json({ok:true, days_processed: map.size});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false, error:e.message}); }
});

app.get('/api/emotion/weekly', async (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 14`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 2) 🫀 Energy Sync Core (hourly energy curve)

## `server.js`
```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS energy_curve(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT,              -- day
  h INTEGER,           -- hour 0..23
  score REAL           -- 0..100
)`);
db.run(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_energy_dh ON energy_curve(d,h)`);

app.post('/api/energy/compute', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.body?.days||7));
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
  try{
    // focus actions and voice intensity by hour
    const focus = await grab(`
      SELECT date(ts) d, CAST(strftime('%H',ts) AS INT) h, COUNT(*) c
      FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY d,h`,[`-${days} day`]);
    const voice = await grab(`
      SELECT date(v.ts) d, CAST(strftime('%H',v.ts) AS INT) h, AVG(v.energy) e
      FROM voice_meta v WHERE v.ts>=datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY d,h`,[`-${days} day`]);

    const key=(d,h)=>`${d}_${h}`;
    const map=new Map();
    for(const r of focus){ const k=key(r.d,r.h); const m=map.get(k)||{f:0,e:0}; m.f+=Number(r.c||0); map.set(k,m);}
    for(const r of voice){ const k=key(r.d,r.h); const m=map.get(k)||{f:0,e:0}; m.e=Math.max(m.e, Number(r.e||0)); map.set(k,m);}

    db.serialize(()=>{
      for(const [k,m] of map.entries()){
        const [d,h]=k.split('_'); const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (m.f*20)+(m.e*0.5)));
        db.run(`INSERT INTO energy_curve(d,h,score) VALUES(?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(d,h) DO UPDATE SET score=excluded.score`,[d,Number(h),score]);
      }
    });
    res.json({ok:true, points: map.size});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false, error:e.message}); }
});

app.get('/api/energy/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now') ORDER BY h ASC`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 3) 🔮 Insight Engine (pattern → tip)

## `server.js`
```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS insight_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  insight TEXT,
  because TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/insight/run', async (_req,res)=>{
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,err)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?err(e):ok(r||[])));
  try{
    const emo = await grab(`SELECT * FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
    const en  = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
    const k7  = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);

    const avg = arr=>arr.length?arr.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x),0)/arr.length:0;
    const vAvg = avg(emo.map(x=>x.valence_avg));
    const iAvg = avg(emo.map(x=>x.intensity_avg));
    const eAvg = avg(en.map(x=>x.s||0));
    const kAvg = avg(k7.map(x=>x.p||0));

    let insight, because=[];
    if(vAvg>0.2 && eAvg>50){ insight='Calm positivity is fueling output — protect the current routine.'; because.push('valence > 0.2','energy > 50'); }
    else if(iAvg>70 && kAvg<5){ insight='High emotional intensity with low rewards — channel into a 15-min ship task now.'; because.push('intensity > 70','karma < 5'); }
    else if(eAvg<30){ insight='Energy is low — move reflection earlier and cut scope to one micro-task.'; because.push('energy < 30'); }
    else { insight='Stable state — keep the heartbeat (progress + reflection) and one tiny ship.'; because.push('no risk flags'); }

    db.run(`INSERT INTO insight_log(insight,because) VALUES(?,?)`,[insight, because.join('; ')]);
    res.json({ok:true, insight, because});
  }catch(e){ res.json({ok:false, error:e.message}); }
});

});
```

# 4) 🌬 Auto-Breathe / Reset Mode (detect → nudge → bonus)

## `server.js`
```js
// Configurable thresholds (can move to .env later)
const BREATH_MIN_GAP_MIN = 90;   // don't nudge more often than this
const BREATH_INTENSITY_TH = 75;  // voice intensity threshold
const BREATH_ENERGY_TH    = 25;  // low energy threshold
let lastBreathAt = 0;

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS breathe_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  reason TEXT,   -- 'high_intensity' | 'low_energy'
  acknowledged INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)`);

// Check if we should prompt a reset
app.get('/api/breathe/check', async (_req,res)=>{
  const now = Date.now();
  if(now - lastBreathAt < BREATH_MIN_GAP_MIN*60000) return res.json({ok:true, suggest:false});

  // recent intensity?
  db.get(`SELECT intensity_avg FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(e,row)=>{
    const intens = Number(row?.intensity_avg||0);
    db.get(`SELECT AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`,[],(e2,row2)=>{
      const energy = Number(row2?.s||0);
      let reason=null;
      if(intens>=BREATH_INTENSITY_TH) reason='high_intensity';
      else if(energy && energy <= BREATH_ENERGY_TH) reason='low_energy';

      if(!reason) return res.json({ok:true, suggest:false});
      lastBreathAt = now;
      db.run(`INSERT INTO breathe_log(reason) VALUES(?)`,[reason]);
      res.json({ok:true, suggest:true, reason, tip:'2-minute breathe: 4-in / 4-hold / 6-out × 6 cycles'});
    });
  });
});

// Acknowledge (award karma)
app.post('/api/breathe/ack', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { reason='', note='' } = req.body||{};
  karmaAdd({ action:'breathe', points:5, note: note || reason });
  db.run(`UPDATE breathe_log SET acknowledged=1 WHERE id=(SELECT id FROM breathe_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)`);
  res.json({ok:true, bonus:5});
});
```

```js
app.get('/api/mirror/weekly', async (_req,res)=>{

});
```

## 2) Helper: create plan items from a text insight
```js
function planFromInsightText(insight){
  // minimal mapping: turns an insight into 1–3 micro tasks
  const tasks = [];
  if(/earlier/i.test(insight) || /low energy/i.test(insight)){
    tasks.push({ when_shift:-1, task:'ship_10m', bonus:6 });
    tasks.push({ when_shift:0,  task:'progress_line', bonus:3 });
  } else if(/protect.*hour/i.test(insight) || /high-focus/i.test(insight)){
    tasks.push({ when_shift:0,  task:'build_45m', bonus:8 });
    tasks.push({ when_shift:0,  task:'voice_note', bonus:4 });
  } else if(/intensity.*low rewards/i.test(insight)){
    tasks.push({ when_shift:-1, task:'ship_15m', bonus:8 });
  } else {
    tasks.push({ when_shift:0,  task:'progress_line', bonus:3 });
  }
  return tasks;
}
```

## 3) API: **Generate today’s plan from latest insight**
```js
app.post('/api/flow/plan_from_insight', express.json(), async (_req,res)=>{
  try{
    // 1) get or create an insight
    let lastInsight = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT insight FROM insight_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row?.insight||null)));
    if(!lastInsight){
      // run the engine once if empty
      await new Promise(ok=>db.run(`INSERT INTO insight_log(insight,because) VALUES(?,?)`,
        ['Stable state — keep the heartbeat (progress + reflection) and one tiny ship.','bootstrap'], ()=>ok()));
      lastInsight = 'Stable state — keep the heartbeat (progress + reflection) and one tiny ship.';
    }

    // 2) find best focus hour (from earlier logic)
    const foc = await new Promise(ok=>db.all(
      `SELECT strftime('%H',ts) hh, COUNT(*) c
       FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day')
       GROUP BY hh`,[],(_e,rows)=>ok(rows||[])));
    let best='21', bestC=0; for(const r of foc){ if(+r.c>bestC){bestC=+r.c; best=r.hh;} }
    const bestHour = Number(best);

    // 3) map insight → tasks
    const items = planFromInsightText(lastInsight);

    // 4) insert today’s tasks
    const ids=[];
    for(const it of items){
      const H = (bestHour + (it.when_shift||0) + 24) % 24;
      await new Promise(ok=>db.run(
        `INSERT INTO flow_plan(when_hour,task,status,source,bonus_points)
         VALUES(?,?, 'planned', ?, ?)`,
        [H, it.task, `insight:${lastInsight}`, it.bonus||0],
        function(){ ids.push(this.lastID); ok(); }
      ));
    }
    res.json({ ok:true, planned: ids.length, bestHour, insight: lastInsight, ids });
  }catch(e){ res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message }); }
});
```

```js
app.post('/api/flow/mark', express.json(), (req,res)=>{

    db.run(`UPDATE flow_plan SET status=? WHERE id=?`,[status,id], ()=>{
      if(status==='done' && row && Number(row.bonus_points)>0){
        karmaAdd({ action:'flow', points:Number(row.bonus_points), note:`${row.task} • ${row.source||''}` });
      }
      res.json({ ok:true, bonus: (status==='done' ? Number(row?.bonus_points||0) : 0) });
    });
  });
});
```

# 1) 🫶 Partner Node Hub (safe summary sync)

## `server.js` — tables + export/import
```js
// --- Partner Node Hub (summary-only sync) ---
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collective_sync(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  from_name TEXT, from_url TEXT,
  scope TEXT,        -- e.g., 'weekly_summary'
  payload TEXT       -- JSON (anonymised)
)`);

// helper: pack anonymised summary (no raw text/audio)
function packSummary(days=7, cb){
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
  (async ()=>{
    const emo = await grab(`SELECT d,valence_avg,intensity_avg FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
    const eng = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
    const ins = await grab(`SELECT ts, substr(insight,1,64) insight FROM insight_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5`);
    const kma = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
    cb({ emo, eng, ins, kma });
  })();
}

app.get('/api/sync/export', (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.query.days||7));
  packSummary(days, (summary)=> res.json({ ok:true, scope:'weekly_summary', days, summary }));
});

app.post('/api/sync/import', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { from_name='', from_url='', scope='weekly_summary', summary=null } = req.body||{};
  if(!summary) return res.json({ ok:false, error:'missing summary' });
  db.run(`INSERT INTO collective_sync(from_name,from_url,scope,payload) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
    [from_name, from_url, scope, JSON.stringify(summary)], ()=> res.json({ ok:true }));
});
```

# 2) 🔐 Consent & Privacy Ledger

## `server.js`
```js
// --- Consent Ledger ---
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS consent_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  peer_name TEXT, peer_url TEXT,
  scope TEXT,         -- 'weekly_summary'
  expires TEXT,       -- ISO
  consent_token TEXT, -- random
  accepted INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)`);

function randToken(){ return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2); }

app.post('/api/consent/create', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { peer_name='', peer_url='', scope='weekly_summary', days_valid=7 } = req.body||{};
  const token = randToken();
  db.run(`INSERT INTO consent_log(peer_name,peer_url,scope,expires,consent_token,accepted)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,0)`,
    [peer_name, peer_url, scope, new Date(Date.now()+days_valid*864e5).toISOString(), token],
    function(){ res.json({ ok:true, consent_id:this.lastID, token }); });
});

app.post('/api/consent/accept', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { consent_id, token } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE consent_log SET accepted=1 WHERE id=? AND consent_token=?`,[consent_id, token],
    function(){ res.json({ ok: this.changes>0 }); });
});

app.get('/api/consent/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM consent_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ ok:true, rows:rows||[] }));
});
```

# 3) 🪙 Value / Reward Loop (Harmony Credits)

## `server.js`
```js
// --- Harmony Credits ---
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harmony_credits(
  partner_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  balance REAL DEFAULT 0
)`);
function creditsAdd(pid, amt){ db.run(`INSERT INTO harmony_credits(partner_id,balance) VALUES(?,?)
  ON CONFLICT(partner_id) DO UPDATE SET balance=balance+excluded.balance`, [pid||1, Number(amt)||0]); }

app.post('/api/credits/mint_from_karma', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { days=7, rate=0.10, partner_id=1 } = req.body||{};
  db.get(`SELECT SUM(points) s FROM karma_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?)`,[`-${Math.min(days,60)} day`],
    (_e,row)=>{ const pts = Number(row?.s||0); const cr = +(pts*Number(rate)).toFixed(2); creditsAdd(partner_id, cr); res.json({ ok:true, minted:cr, from_points:pts }); });
});

app.get('/api/credits/balance', (req,res)=>{
  const pid = Number(req.query.partner_id||1);
  db.get(`SELECT balance FROM harmony_credits WHERE partner_id=?`,[pid],(_e,row)=>res.json({ ok:true, balance:Number(row?.balance||0) }));
});

app.post('/api/credits/transfer', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { from_id=1, to_id, amount } = req.body||{};
  const amt = Math.max(0, Number(amount||0));
  if(!to_id || !amt) return res.json({ ok:false, error:'to_id/amount' });
  db.serialize(()=>{
    db.run(`UPDATE harmony_credits SET balance=balance-? WHERE partner_id=?`,[amt,from_id]);
    creditsAdd(to_id, amt);
    res.json({ ok:true });
  });
});
```

# 4) 🧠 Collective Insight Engine (from synced summaries)

## `server.js`
```js
// --- Collective insights (aggregate anonymised sync payloads) ---
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collective_insight(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  peers INTEGER, days INTEGER,
  valence_avg REAL, intensity_avg REAL, energy_avg REAL,
  note TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/collective/compute', async (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT payload FROM collective_sync ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    if(!rows?.length) return res.json({ ok:false, error:'no sync data' });
    let peers=0, days=0, v=[], i=[], e=[];
    for(const r of rows){
      try{
        const pl = JSON.parse(r.payload||'{}'); 
        if(pl.emo?.length) { v = v.concat(pl.emo.map(x=>+x.valence_avg||0)); i = i.concat(pl.emo.map(x=>+x.intensity_avg||0)); days=Math.max(days, pl.emo.length); }
        if(pl.eng?.length) { e = e.concat(pl.eng.map(x=>+x.s||0)); }
        peers++;
      }catch{}
    }
    const avg=a=>a.length?a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/a.length:0;
    const row = { peers, days, vA:avg(v), iA:avg(i), eA:avg(e) };
    db.run(`INSERT INTO collective_insight(peers,days,valence_avg,intensity_avg,energy_avg,note)
            VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,[row.peers,row.days,row.vA,row.iA,row.eA,'rollup'], ()=> res.json({ ok:true, summary:row }));
  });
});

app.get('/api/collective/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM collective_insight ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ ok:true, rows:rows||[] }));
});
```

# 🧩 `server.js` — Weekly Ritual endpoint

```js
// --- Weekly Ritual: rollup → energy → insight → credits → export (+ optional send) ---
app.post('/api/ritual/weekly', express.json(), async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const opts = req.body || {};
    const days = Math.min(30, Number(opts.days || 7));
    const mintRate = Number(opts.credit_rate ?? 0.10); // credits per karma point (default 10%)
    const peerUrl = (opts.peer_url || '').trim().replace(/\/$/, '');
    const peerName = (opts.peer_name || '').trim();

    // 1) emotion rollup
    await new Promise((ok, er) => db.all(
      `SELECT 1`, [], (e)=> e ? er(e) : ok()
    ));
    // call our rollup logic inline:
    const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
    const rows = await grab(`
      SELECT date(v.ts) AS d, vt.transcript AS t, v.energy AS e
      FROM voice_meta v LEFT JOIN voice_text vt ON vt.voice_id=v.id
      WHERE v.ts >= datetime('now', ?)`, [`-${days} day`]);
    const score = (text='', energy=0)=>{
      const t = String(text||'').toLowerCase();
      let pos=0, neg=0;
      ['grateful','calm','hope','proud','peace','love','progress'].forEach(w=>t.includes(w)&&pos++);
      ['tired','stress','angry','sad','overwhelm','worry','stuck'].forEach(w=>t.includes(w)&&neg++);
      const val = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (pos-neg)/3));
      const inten = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Number(energy)||0) + 10*Math.abs(pos-neg)));
      return {val,inten};
    };
    const map = new Map();
    for(const r of rows){
      const {val,inten} = score(r.t||'', r.e||0);
      const m = map.get(r.d)||{n:0,v:0,i:0}; m.n++; m.v+=val; m.i+=inten; map.set(r.d,m);
    }
    db.serialize(()=>{
      for(const [d,m] of map.entries()){
        db.run(`INSERT INTO emotion_trend(d,valence_avg,intensity_avg)
                VALUES(?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET valence_avg=excluded.valence_avg, intensity_avg=excluded.intensity_avg`,
          [d, m.n?m.v/m.n:0, m.n?m.i/m.n:0]);
      }
    });

    // 2) energy curve (last 7d)
    const focus = await grab(`
      SELECT date(ts) d, CAST(strftime('%H',ts) AS INT) h, COUNT(*) c
      FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-7 day') GROUP BY d,h`);
    const voice = await grab(`
      SELECT date(v.ts) d, CAST(strftime('%H',v.ts) AS INT) h, AVG(v.energy) e
      FROM voice_meta v WHERE v.ts>=datetime('now','-7 day') GROUP BY d,h`);
    const key=(d,h)=>`${d}_${h}`; const eMap=new Map();
    for(const r of focus){ const k=key(r.d,r.h); const m=eMap.get(k)||{f:0,e:0}; m.f+=Number(r.c||0); eMap.set(k,m); }
    for(const r of voice){ const k=key(r.d,r.h); const m=eMap.get(k)||{f:0,e:0}; m.e=Math.max(m.e, Number(r.e||0)); eMap.set(k,m); }
    db.serialize(()=>{
      for(const [k,m] of eMap.entries()){
        const [d,h]=k.split('_');
        const score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (m.f*20)+(m.e*0.5)));
        db.run(`INSERT INTO energy_curve(d,h,score) VALUES(?,?,?)
                ON CONFLICT(d,h) DO UPDATE SET score=excluded.score`,[d,Number(h),score]);
      }
    });

    // 3) insight (reuse simple rules)
    const emo7 = await grab(`SELECT * FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
    const en7  = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
    const k7   = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
    const avg = a=>a.length?a.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x),0)/a.length:0;
    const vAvg = avg(emo7.map(x=>x.valence_avg));
    const iAvg = avg(emo7.map(x=>x.intensity_avg));
    const eAvg = avg(en7.map(x=>x.s||0));
    const kAvg = avg(k7.map(x=>x.p||0));
    let insight, because=[];
    if(vAvg>0.2 && eAvg>50){ insight='Calm positivity is fueling output — protect the current routine.'; because=['valence>0.2','energy>50']; }
    else if(iAvg>70 && kAvg<5){ insight='High emotional intensity with low rewards — do one 15-min ship now.'; because=['intensity>70','karma<5']; }
    else if(eAvg<30){ insight='Energy low — move reflection earlier and cut to one micro-task.'; because=['energy<30']; }
    else { insight='Stable — keep heartbeat (progress + reflection) and one tiny ship.'; because=['no risk']; }
    await new Promise(ok=>db.run(`INSERT INTO insight_log(insight,because) VALUES(?,?)`,[insight, because.join(';')],()=>ok()));

    // 4) credits from karma (last N days)
    const kr = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT SUM(points) s FROM karma_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?)`,
      [`-${days} day`],(_e,row)=>ok(Number(row?.s||0))));
    const minted = +(kr * mintRate).toFixed(2);
    await new Promise(ok=>db.run(`INSERT INTO harmony_credits(partner_id,balance) VALUES(1,?)
      ON CONFLICT(partner_id) DO UPDATE SET balance=balance+excluded.balance`,[minted],()=>ok()));

    // 5) export weekly summary
    const packSummary=(days)=>new Promise(async (ok)=>{
      const emo = await grab(`SELECT d,valence_avg,intensity_avg FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
      const eng = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
      const ins = await grab(`SELECT ts, substr(insight,1,64) insight FROM insight_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5`);
      const kma = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
      ok({ emo, eng, ins, kma });
    });
    const summary = await packSummary(days);

    // 6) optional: send to peer (summary-only)
    let sent=false;
    if(peerUrl){
      try{
        const js = await (await fetch(peerUrl+'/api/sync/import',{
          method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},
          body: JSON.stringify({ from_name: peerName||'peer', from_url:'local', scope:'weekly_summary', summary })
        })).json();
        sent = !!js.ok;
      }catch{ sent=false; }
    }

    // 7) overview snapshot
    const balance = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT balance FROM harmony_credits WHERE partner_id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(Number(row?.balance||0))));
    res.json({ ok:true, steps:{rolled:[...map.keys()].length, energy:eMap.size, insight, minted, sent}, balance, summary_days:days });
  } catch (e) {
    res.json({ ok:false, error:e.message });
  }
});
```

```js
/* ========= PHASE-5: CONSCIOUS LAYER =========
   1) Perception Engine
   2) Resonance Graph
   3) Learning Cortex (focus-hour predictor)
   4) Dialogue Memory (weekly compression)
   5) Inner Voice Interface (reflection text, optional TTS handoff)
============================================= */

// ---------- 1) Perception Engine ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS perception_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  source TEXT,            -- 'voice','reflection','note'
  text   TEXT,
  emotion TEXT,           -- joy/calm/strain/sad/angry/neutral
  intent  TEXT,           -- goal/doubt/gratitude/fatigue/reflect/none
  score REAL,             -- -1..1
  tags  TEXT              -- comma words
)`);

// tiny lexicons (local, heuristic)
const LEX = {
  pos:['grateful','thank','calm','peace','love','hope','progress','gentle','flow','clear'],
  neg:['tired','fatigue','stress','overwhelm','angry','sad','worry','stuck','pressure','panic'],
  joy:['grateful','love','joy','proud','excited','glad'],
  calm:['calm','peace','steady','balance','grounded'],
  strain:['stress','overwhelm','tense','pressure','rush'],
  sad:['sad','down','low','upset'],
  angry:['angry','irritated','annoyed','frustrated'],
  intent_goal:['goal','plan','finish','ship','deliver','target'],
  intent_doubt:['doubt','confused','unsure','clueless','why'],
  intent_grat:['grateful','thank','gratitude','bless'],
  intent_fatigue:['tired','fatigue','exhaust','sleep','rest'],
  intent_reflect:['realise','understand','learn','notice','reflect']
};

function analyseText(s=''){
  const t=(s||'').toLowerCase();
  const has = w=>t.includes(w);
  const count = arr => arr.reduce((n,w)=>n+(has(w)?1:0),0);
  const pos = count(LEX.pos), neg=count(LEX.neg);
  const score = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1,(pos-neg)/5));
  // emotion
  const emScores = [
    ['joy',count(LEX.joy)],
    ['calm',count(LEX.calm)],
    ['strain',count(LEX.strain)],
    ['sad',count(LEX.sad)],
    ['angry',count(LEX.angry)]
  ].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  const emotion = (emScores[0][1]>0?emScores[0][0]:'neutral');
  // intent
  const intents = [
    ['goal',count(LEX.intent_goal)],
    ['doubt',count(LEX.intent_doubt)],
    ['gratitude',count(LEX.intent_grat)],
    ['fatigue',count(LEX.intent_fatigue)],
    ['reflect',count(LEX.intent_reflect)]
  ].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
  const intent = (intents[0][1]>0?intents[0][0]:'none');
  // tags = top words present
  const bag = [...new Set([...LEX.pos,...LEX.neg])].filter(has).slice(0,8);
  return {emotion,intent,score,tags:bag.join(',')};
}

app.post('/api/perception/analyze', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { source='note', text='' } = req.body||{};
  const a = analyseText(text||'');
  db.run(`INSERT INTO perception_log(source,text,emotion,intent,score,tags) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [source,text,a.emotion,a.intent,a.score,a.tags], ()=>res.json({ok:true, ...a}));
});

// scan recent voice transcripts into perception
app.post('/api/perception/scan_voice', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.body?.days||7));
  db.all(`SELECT vt.transcript t FROM voice_text vt
          JOIN voice_meta v ON v.id=vt.voice_id
          WHERE v.ts >= datetime('now', ?)`,[`-${days} day`],(_e,rows)=>{
    if(!rows?.length) return res.json({ok:true, added:0});
    let added=0; db.serialize(()=>{
      for(const r of rows){
        const a = analyseText(r.t||''); added++;
        db.run(`INSERT INTO perception_log(source,text,emotion,intent,score,tags)
                VALUES('voice',?,?,?,?,?)`,[r.t||'',a.emotion,a.intent,a.score,a.tags]);
      }
      res.json({ok:true, added});
    });
  });
});

app.get('/api/perception/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM perception_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 2) Resonance Graph ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resonance_edge(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  src_type TEXT, src_key TEXT,   -- e.g. 'emotion','joy'
  dst_type TEXT, dst_key TEXT,   -- e.g. 'reward','focus'
  weight REAL                    -- strength
)`);
db.run(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_res_pair ON resonance_edge(src_type,src_key,dst_type,dst_key)`);

app.post('/api/resonance/compute', async (_req,res)=>{
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));

  // last 14d perception → emotions; rewards by kind per day
  const P = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, emotion FROM perception_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-14 day')`);
  const R = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, kind, COUNT(*) c FROM reward_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY d,kind`);

  // build day→emotion counts
  const emoDay = new Map();
  for(const p of P){
    const k=p.d; const m = emoDay.get(k)||{};
    m[p.emotion]=(m[p.emotion]||0)+1; emoDay.set(k,m);
  }
  const rewDay = new Map();
  for(const r of R){
    const k=r.d; const m = rewDay.get(k)||{};
    m[r.kind]=(m[r.kind]||0)+Number(r.c||0); rewDay.set(k,m);
  }

  // compute simple correlations (emotion ↔ reward kind)
  const emos = ['joy','calm','strain','sad','angry','neutral'];
  const kinds = ['focus','breathe','ship','learn','progress'];
  const pairs = [];
  for(const e of emos){
    for(const k of kinds){
      const xs=[], ys=[];
      for(const d of new Set([...emoDay.keys(),...rewDay.keys()])){
        xs.push((emoDay.get(d)||{})[e]||0);
        ys.push((rewDay.get(d)||{})[k]||0);
      }
      // Pearson-ish (safe for short)
      const n=xs.length; if(!n) continue;
      const mx=xs.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/n, my=ys.reduce((s,y)=>s+y,0)/n;
      let num=0, dx=0, dy=0;
      for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ const vx=xs[i]-mx, vy=ys[i]-my; num+=vx*vy; dx+=vx*vx; dy+=vy*vy; }
      const corr = (dx&&dy)?(num/Math.sqrt(dx*dy)):0;
      if(Math.abs(corr)>0.05) pairs.push({e:k?e:e, k, w:corr});
    }
  }

  db.serialize(()=>{
    for(const p of pairs){
      db.run(`INSERT INTO resonance_edge(src_type,src_key,dst_type,dst_key,weight)
              VALUES('emotion',?, 'reward', ?, ?)
              ON CONFLICT(src_type,src_key,dst_type,dst_key)
              DO UPDATE SET weight=excluded.weight`,[p.e,p.k,p.w]);
    }
  });
  res.json({ok:true, edges:pairs.length});
});

app.get('/api/resonance/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM resonance_edge ORDER BY ABS(weight) DESC LIMIT 30`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 3) Learning Cortex (focus-hour predictor) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_model(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id=1),
  w0 REAL DEFAULT 0,   -- bias
  w1 REAL DEFAULT 0,   -- valence
  w2 REAL DEFAULT 0,   -- intensity
  w3 REAL DEFAULT 0,   -- energy
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learning_model(id,w0,w1,w2,w3) VALUES(1,0,0,0,0)`);

function linPred(w, x){ return w.w0 + w.w1*x.v + w.w2*x.i + w.w3*x.e; }

app.post('/api/learn/update', async (_req,res)=>{
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
  const emo = await grab(`SELECT d,valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 14`);
  const en  = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) e FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 14`);
  const foc = await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, COUNT(*) y FROM reward_log WHERE kind='focus' AND ts>=datetime('now','-14 day') GROUP BY date(ts)`);
  if(!emo.length || !en.length){ return res.json({ok:false, error:'not enough data'}); }

  const joinMap = new Map(); emo.forEach(r=>joinMap.set(r.d,{v:+r.v||0,i:+r.i||0,e:null,y:0}));
  en.forEach(r=>{ const m=joinMap.get(r.d)||{v:0,i:0,e:null,y:0}; m.e=+r.e||0; joinMap.set(r.d,m); });
  foc.forEach(r=>{ const m=joinMap.get(r.d)||{v:0,i:0,e:0,y:0}; m.y=+r.y||0; joinMap.set(r.d,m); });
  const rows = [...joinMap.values()].filter(r=>r.e!=null);

  // SGD
  let w = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT * FROM learning_model WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  let {w0,w1,w2,w3} = w;
  const lr = 0.0005;
  for(let epoch=0; epoch<200; epoch++){
    for(const r of rows){
      const yhat = w0 + w1*r.v + w2*r.i + w3*r.e;
      const err = (r.y - yhat);
      w0 += lr * err * 1;
      w1 += lr * err * r.v;
      w2 += lr * err * r.i;
      w3 += lr * err * r.e;
    }
  }
  db.run(`UPDATE learning_model SET w0=?,w1=?,w2=?,w3=?,updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
    [w0,w1,w2,w3], ()=>res.json({ok:true, w:{w0,w1,w2,w3}, samples:rows.length}));
});

app.get('/api/learn/predict_best_hour', async (_req,res)=>{
  // choose hour with highest current energy score; adjust by model’s valence/intensity today
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
  const todayE = await grab(`SELECT h,score e FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const emoToday = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend WHERE d=date('now')`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row||{v:0,i:0})));
  const w = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT * FROM learning_model WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row||{w0:0,w1:0,w2:0,w3:0})));
  if(!todayE.length) return res.json({ok:false, error:'no energy_curve today'});
  let bestH=0, bestScore=-1e9;
  for(const r of todayE){
    const pred = linPred(w,{v:+emoToday.v||0,i:+emoToday.i||0,e:+r.e||0});
    if(pred>bestScore){ bestScore=pred; bestH=r.h; }
  }
  res.json({ok:true, best_hour:bestH, score:bestScore});
});


// ---------- 4) Dialogue Memory (weekly compression) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dialogue_story(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  week TEXT,              -- ISO week like 2025-W45
  topics TEXT,            -- comma keywords
  summary TEXT
)`);
db.run(`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ux_story_week ON dialogue_story(week)`);

function isoWeekStr(d=new Date()){
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  const dayNum = date.getUTCDay() || 7; date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
  const weekNo = Math.ceil((((date - yearStart)/86400000)+1)/7);
  return `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-W${String(weekNo).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}

app.post('/api/dialogue/compress_week', async (_req,res)=>{
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
  const rows = await grab(`SELECT text FROM perception_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-7 day') AND length(text)>0`);
  if(!rows.length){ return res.json({ok:false, error:'no perception text'}); }
  const txt = rows.map(r=>(r.text||'').toLowerCase()).join(' ');
  const kw = [...new Set(txt.match(/\b[a-z]{4,}\b/g)||[])]
    .filter(w=>!['with','that','this','have','from','into','about','your','just','will','then','there','were','been','like','very','much','when','they','them','also','what','which'].includes(w))
    .slice(0,20);
  const topics = kw.slice(0,8).join(', ');
  const summary = `Week focus around: ${topics}. Tone trended ${analyseText(txt).emotion}; intent leaned ${analyseText(txt).intent}.`;
  const week = isoWeekStr(new Date());
  db.run(`INSERT INTO dialogue_story(week,topics,summary)
          VALUES(?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(week) DO UPDATE SET topics=excluded.topics, summary=excluded.summary`,
    [week, topics, summary], ()=>res.json({ok:true, week, topics, summary}));
});

app.get('/api/dialogue/stories', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM dialogue_story ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 5) Inner Voice Interface ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reflect_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  text TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/inner/reflect', async (_req,res)=>{
  // build a soft weekly reflection
  const one = (sql)=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(sql,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  const emo = await one(`SELECT valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1`);
  const ins = await one(`SELECT insight FROM insight_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`);
  const en  = await one(`SELECT AVG(score) e FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const v = Number(emo?.v||0).toFixed(2), i = Math.round(Number(emo?.i||0)), e = Math.round(Number(en?.e||0));
  const line = `I’m sensing a ${v>=0? 'positive' : 'heavy'} tone (valence ${v}, intensity ${i}), with energy near ${e}. ${ins?.insight || 'Keep the heartbeat and one tiny ship.'}`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reflect_log(text) VALUES(?)`,[line], ()=>res.json({ok:true, text:line}));
});

app.get('/api/inner/reflect/history', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM reflect_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js`

```js
/* ====== Perception → Reminder Tone ====== */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminder_template(
  tone TEXT PRIMARY KEY,      -- 'gentle','crisp','celebrate','steady'
  p21 TEXT,                   -- 21:00 message
  p2105 TEXT                  -- 21:05 message
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reminder_template(tone,p21,p2105) VALUES
 ('gentle','🌿 Soft check-in: one line on what moved & one feeling.','🌿 If it helps, whisper a gratitude line.'),
 ('crisp','⏱️ 60s check-in: moved/pending (bullet).','⏱️ Add 1 micro-task for tomorrow.'),
 ('celebrate','✨ Win scan: note 1 concrete progress.','✨ Lock it in: tiny reward or thank-you line.'),
 ('steady','🧭 Routine check-in: progress + pending (1 line).','🧭 Optional: Voice Sister 10s reflection.')`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminder_tone_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT UNIQUE,              -- date('now')
  tone TEXT,
  p21 TEXT, p2105 TEXT,
  basis TEXT,                 -- short reason
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);

function pickTone(v,i,e,intent){
  // v: valence (-1..1), i: intensity (0..100), e: energy (0..100)
  if(v > 0.3 && e > 55) return {tone:'celebrate', because:'valence>0.3 & energy>55'};
  if(i > 70 && (intent==='fatigue' || intent==='doubt')) return {tone:'gentle', because:'high intensity + fatigue/doubt'};
  if(e < 35 || v < -0.1) return {tone:'gentle', because:'low energy or heavy tone'};
  if(intent==='goal' || e >= 50) return {tone:'crisp', because:'goal mode / solid energy'};
  return {tone:'steady', because:'baseline'};
}

app.post('/api/reminders/compute_tone', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one = (sql)=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(sql,[],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  const emo = await one(`SELECT valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const en  = await one(`SELECT AVG(score) e FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const per = await one(`SELECT intent FROM perception_log WHERE date(ts)=date('now') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`);
  const v = Number(emo?.v??0), i = Number(emo?.i??0), e = Number(en?.e??0), intent = per?.intent||'none';
  const sel = pickTone(v,i,e,intent);

  // fetch templates
  const tpl = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT * FROM reminder_template WHERE tone=?`,[sel.tone],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  const p21 = tpl?.p21 || '🧭 Routine check-in.';
  const p2105 = tpl?.p2105 || '🧭 Optional reflection.';

  db.run(`INSERT INTO reminder_tone_log(d,tone,p21,p2105,basis)
          VALUES(date('now'),?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET tone=excluded.tone,p21=excluded.p21,p2105=excluded.p2105,basis=excluded.basis`,
    [sel.tone,p21,p2105,`${sel.because}; v=${v.toFixed(2)}, i=${Math.round(i)}, e=${Math.round(e)}, intent=${intent}`],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, tone:sel.tone, p21, p2105, because:sel.because, stats:{v,i,e,intent}}));
});

app.get('/api/reminders/preview', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM reminder_tone_log WHERE d=date('now')`,[],(_e,row)=>{
    if(!row) return res.json({ok:false, error:'no tone computed yet'});
    res.json({ok:true, tone:row.tone, p21:row.p21, p2105:row.p2105, basis:row.basis});
  });
});

app.post('/api/reminders/override', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const { tone } = req.body||{};
  if(!tone) return res.json({ok:false, error:'tone required'});
  const tpl = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT * FROM reminder_template WHERE tone=?`,[tone],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  if(!tpl) return res.json({ok:false, error:'unknown tone'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reminder_tone_log(d,tone,p21,p2105,basis)
          VALUES(date('now'),?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET tone=excluded.tone,p21=excluded.p21,p2105=excluded.p2105,basis=excluded.basis`,
    [tone,tpl.p21,tpl.p2105,`manual override`],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, tone, p21:tpl.p21, p2105:tpl.p2105}));
});

app.get('/api/reminders/templates', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT tone,p21,p2105 FROM reminder_template ORDER BY tone`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

app.post('/api/reminders/templates/save', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { tone, p21, p2105 } = req.body||{};
  if(!tone || !p21 || !p2105) return res.json({ok:false, error:'tone/p21/p2105 required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reminder_template(tone,p21,p2105) VALUES(?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(tone) DO UPDATE SET p21=excluded.p21, p2105=excluded.p2105`,
    [tone,p21,p2105], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` (paste all)

```js
/* ========= PHASE-6: META-COGNITION =========
   1) System Mirror (self-diagnostics)
   2) Emotional Climate Engine (from partner summaries)
   3) Harmony Index (AI health meter)
   4) Coherence Synthesizer (weekly story)
   5) Intent Evolution Tracker (long-term shifts)
============================================= */

// ---------- 1) System Mirror ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS meta_scan_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  scope TEXT,        -- 'daily','weekly'
  issue TEXT,        -- short code
  detail TEXT,       -- human message
  severity INTEGER   -- 1..5
)`);

app.post('/api/meta/scan', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.min(30, Number(req.body?.days || 7));
  const grab=(s,a=[])=>new Promise((ok,er)=>db.all(s,a,(e,r)=>e?er(e):ok(r||[])));
  const one=(s,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(s,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r)));

  const emo = await grab(`SELECT d,valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
  const en  = await grab(`SELECT d, AVG(score) e FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);
  const plan= await grab(`SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM flow_plan WHERE date(ts)=date('now') GROUP BY status`);
  const tone= await one(`SELECT tone FROM reminder_tone_log WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const karma= await grab(`SELECT date(ts) d, SUM(points) p FROM karma_log GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT ?`,[days]);

  const vAvg = emo.length ? emo.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.v||0),0)/emo.length : 0;
  const eAvg = en.length  ? en .reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.s||x.e||0),0)/en.length : 0;
  const done = plan.find(x=>x.status==='done')?.c||0;
  const planned = (plan.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.c||0),0))||0;
  const ratio = planned? (done/planned) : 0;

  const issues = [];
  if(eAvg < 35) issues.push({issue:'low_energy', detail:`Avg energy ${Math.round(eAvg)} < 35`, severity:4});
  if(vAvg < -0.05) issues.push({issue:'heavy_tone', detail:`Avg valence ${vAvg.toFixed(2)} < -0.05`, severity:4});
  if(planned > 0 && ratio < 0.3) issues.push({issue:'plan_slippage', detail:`Plan done ${done}/${planned}`, severity:3});
  if(!tone) issues.push({issue:'no_tone', detail:`Reminder tone not computed today`, severity:2});
  if(!(await grab(`SELECT 1 FROM insight_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-7 day') LIMIT 1`)).length)
    issues.push({issue:'no_insight', detail:`No insights in last 7d`, severity:2});

  if(!issues.length) issues.push({issue:'ok', detail:'No critical issues; system stable', severity:1});

  db.serialize(()=>{
    for(const it of issues){
      db.run(`INSERT INTO meta_scan_log(scope,issue,detail,severity) VALUES('daily',?,?,?)`,
        [it.issue, it.detail, it.severity]);
    }
  });
  res.json({ok:true, added:issues.length, summary:{vAvg,eAvg,ratio}});
});

app.get('/api/meta/scan/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM meta_scan_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 2) Emotional Climate Engine (from collective summaries) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS climate_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  peers INTEGER,
  valence_avg REAL,
  intensity_avg REAL,
  note TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/climate/compute', async (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT payload FROM collective_sync ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    if(!rows?.length) return res.json({ok:false, error:'no collective_sync data'});
    let peers=0, v=[], i=[];
    for(const r of rows){
      try{
        const pl = JSON.parse(r.payload||'{}');
        if(pl.emo?.length){
          v = v.concat(pl.emo.map(x=>+x.valence_avg||0));
          i = i.concat(pl.emo.map(x=>+x.intensity_avg||0));
          peers++;
        }
      }catch{}
    }
    const avg=a=>a.length?a.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/a.length:0;
    const vA = avg(v), iA = avg(i);
    db.run(`INSERT INTO climate_log(peers,valence_avg,intensity_avg,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
      [peers, vA, iA, 'rollup'], ()=>res.json({ok:true, peers, valence:vA, intensity:iA}));
  });
});

app.get('/api/climate/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM climate_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 3) Harmony Index (AI health meter) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harmony_index(
  d TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                -- date
  score REAL,                        -- -1 .. +1
  comp_valence REAL,
  comp_energy REAL,
  comp_action REAL,                  -- plan completion
  comp_karma REAL,                   -- normalized karma
  detail TEXT                        -- JSON
)`);

app.post('/api/harmony/compute_today', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(s,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(s,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const all=(s,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.all(s,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||[])));

  const emo = await one(`SELECT valence_avg v FROM emotion_trend WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const en  = await all(`SELECT score FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const plan= await all(`SELECT status, COUNT(*) c FROM flow_plan WHERE date(ts)=date('now') GROUP BY status`);
  const kar = await one(`SELECT SUM(points) p FROM karma_log WHERE date(ts)=date('now')`);

  const v = Number(emo?.v||0);                 // already ~ -1..+1
  const e = en.length ? en.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.score||0),0)/en.length : 0;  // 0..100
  const eN = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, e/100));  // normalize
  const done = plan.find(x=>x.status==='done')?.c||0;
  const total= plan.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x.c||0),0);
  const aN = total? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, done/total)) : 0.0; // 0..1
  const k = Number(kar?.p||0);                 // points; simple cap
  const kN = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, k/20));   // 20 pts ~ 1.0 for day

  // weighted blend
  const score = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (0.4*v) + (0.3*(eN*2-1)) + (0.2*(aN*2-1)) + (0.1*(kN*2-1)) ));

  const detail = JSON.stringify({v,eN,aN,kN});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO harmony_index(d,score,comp_valence,comp_energy,comp_action,comp_karma,detail)
          VALUES(date('now'),?,?,?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET score=excluded.score, comp_valence=excluded.comp_valence,
          comp_energy=excluded.comp_energy, comp_action=excluded.comp_action, comp_karma=excluded.comp_karma, detail=excluded.detail`,
    [score, v, eN, aN, kN, detail], ()=>res.json({ok:true, score, components:{v,eN,aN,kN}}));
});

app.get('/api/harmony/line', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT d,score FROM harmony_index ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 30`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 4) Coherence Synthesizer (weekly story) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coherence_story(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  week TEXT UNIQUE,      -- 2025-W45
  title TEXT,
  body TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/coherence/synthesize', async (_req,res)=>{
  const week = (()=>{ const d=new Date(); const z=new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),d.getDate())); const n=z.getUTCDay()||7; z.setUTCDate(z.getUTCDate()+4-n); const y0=new Date(Date.UTC(z.getUTCFullYear(),0,1)); const w=Math.ceil((((z-y0)/86400000)+1)/7); return `${z.getUTCFullYear()}-W${String(w).padStart(2,'0')}`; })();

  const all=(s,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.all(s,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||[])));
  const emo7 = await all(`SELECT * FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
  const en7  = await all(`SELECT d, AVG(score) s FROM energy_curve GROUP BY d ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`);
  const ins5 = await all(`SELECT insight FROM insight_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5`);

  const avg = a=>a.length?a.reduce((s,x)=>s+Number(x),0)/a.length:0;
  const vAvg = avg(emo7.map(x=>x.valence_avg));
  const iAvg = avg(emo7.map(x=>x.intensity_avg));
  const eAvg = avg(en7.map(x=>x.s||0));

  const tone = vAvg>0.2 ? 'calm-positive' : vAvg<-0.1 ? 'heavy' : 'mixed';
  const thrust = eAvg>55 ? 'high-output' : eAvg<35 ? 'low-energy' : 'steady';
  const motif = iAvg>70 ? 'intense' : iAvg<40 ? 'soft' : 'balanced';
  const title = `Week ${week}: ${tone}, ${thrust}, ${motif}`;
  const body = [
    `Tone carried **${tone}** with average energy **${Math.round(eAvg)}** and intensity **${Math.round(iAvg)}**.`,
    `Notable insights: ${(ins5.map(x=>x.insight).slice(0,3).join(' · ')||'—')}.`,
    `Guidance: ${tone==='heavy' ? 'Lighten load; pick one tiny ship.' : thrust==='low-energy' ? 'Protect rest windows; keep the heartbeat.' : 'Consolidate gains; capture one reusable template.'}`
  ].join(' ');

  db.run(`INSERT INTO coherence_story(week,title,body)
          VALUES(?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(week) DO UPDATE SET title=excluded.title, body=excluded.body`,
    [week, title, body], ()=>res.json({ok:true, week, title, body}));
});

app.get('/api/coherence/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT week,title,body FROM coherence_story ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});


// ---------- 5) Intent Evolution Tracker ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intent_evolution(
  month TEXT PRIMARY KEY,    -- 2025-11
  goal INTEGER, doubt INTEGER, gratitude INTEGER, fatigue INTEGER, reflect INTEGER, none INTEGER
)`);

app.post('/api/intent/rollup', async (_req,res)=>{
  db.run(`DELETE FROM intent_evolution WHERE month IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m',ts) FROM perception_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-180 day')
  )`,[], async ()=>{
    db.all(`SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',ts) m, intent, COUNT(*) c
            FROM perception_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-180 day')
            GROUP BY m,intent`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
      const map=new Map();
      for(const r of rows){
        const m=r.m, i=r.intent||'none', c=Number(r.c||0);
        const obj = map.get(m)||{goal:0,doubt:0,gratitude:0,fatigue:0,reflect:0,none:0};
        if(obj[i]!=null) obj[i]+=c; else obj.none+=c;
        map.set(m,obj);
      }
      db.serialize(()=>{
        for(const [m,o] of map.entries()){
          db.run(`INSERT INTO intent_evolution(month,goal,doubt,gratitude,fatigue,reflect,none)
                  VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
            [m,o.goal,o.doubt,o.gratitude,o.fatigue,o.reflect,o.none]);
        }
      });
      res.json({ok:true, months:[...map.keys()].length});
    });
  });
});

app.get('/api/intent/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM intent_evolution ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` — Phase-7 INIT + Organs + Harmony Economy

> Paste the whole block below once. It creates the 5 organ tables, minimal APIs, and the weekly **Harmony Economy** rollup.

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-7: COLLECTIVE INTELLIGENCE & RECIPROCITY LAYER
   Organs:
     1) Partner Graph (Neural Mesh)
     2) Reciprocal Loop Engine (Give–Receive Tracking)
     3) Shared Memory Bus (summary packets only)
     4) Adaptive Tutor (Mutual Learning AI hooks)
     5) Civic Resonance Layer (anonymized exports)
   + Harmony Economy Protocol (weekly fairness snapshot)
   ========================================================== */

/* ---------- 0) Schema (Step 1: phase7_init) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_graph(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT UNIQUE,
  role TEXT,                  -- 'human','text','voice','service','org'
  energy_in REAL DEFAULT 0,   -- received help / benefit
  energy_out REAL DEFAULT 0,  -- contributed help
  credits REAL DEFAULT 0,     -- Harmony Credits
  meta TEXT                   -- JSON
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_edge(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  src INTEGER, dst INTEGER,   -- partner_graph.id
  kind TEXT,                  -- 'learn','support','sync','fund','friend'
  weight REAL DEFAULT 1,
  UNIQUE(src,dst,kind)
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reciprocal_ledger(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  partner_id INTEGER,
  kind TEXT,                  -- 'give','receive'
  delta REAL,                 -- + value (credits or abstract energy units)
  note TEXT
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_sync(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  from_partner INTEGER,
  to_partner INTEGER,
  scope TEXT,                 -- 'daily','weekly'
  packet TEXT,                -- JSON summary packet {summary,tone,day,hash}
  ack INTEGER DEFAULT 0       -- 0/1 acknowledged
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS adaptive_rules(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id=1),
  mode TEXT DEFAULT 'auto',   -- 'auto'|'gentle'|'crisp'
  min_energy INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
  max_intensity INTEGER DEFAULT 75,
  last_update TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO adaptive_rules(id) VALUES(1)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS civic_nodes(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT UNIQUE,
  kind TEXT,                 -- 'school','bpo','temple','charity','community'
  policy TEXT,               -- JSON {consent:true, anonymize:true}
  contact TEXT
)`);

/* ---------- 1) Partner Graph — CRUD + edges ---------- */
app.post('/api/partners/add', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { name, role='human', meta={} } = req.body||{};
  if(!name) return res.json({ok:false, error:'name required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partner_graph(name,role,meta) VALUES(?,?,?)`,
    [name, role, JSON.stringify(meta)], function(){ res.json({ok:true, id:this.lastID}); });
});

app.post('/api/partners/link', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { src, dst, kind='support', weight=1 } = req.body||{};
  if(!src||!dst) return res.json({ok:false, error:'src/dst required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partner_edge(src,dst,kind,weight) VALUES(?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(src,dst,kind) DO UPDATE SET weight=excluded.weight`,
    [src,dst,kind,weight], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/partners/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM partner_graph ORDER BY id`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
app.get('/api/partners/edges', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM partner_edge ORDER BY id`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* ---------- 2) Reciprocal Loop — log + balances ---------- */
app.post('/api/reciprocal/log', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, kind='give', delta=0, note='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id || !delta) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id and delta required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO reciprocal_ledger(partner_id,kind,delta,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
    [partner_id, kind, delta, note], ()=>{
      // update partner counters
      const col = kind==='give' ? 'energy_out' : 'energy_in';
      db.run(`UPDATE partner_graph SET ${col}=${col}+? WHERE id=?`, [delta, partner_id], ()=>{
        res.json({ok:true});
      });
    });
});

app.get('/api/reciprocal/balance', (req,res)=>{
  const id = Number(req.query.partner_id||0);
  if(!id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  db.get(`SELECT energy_in,energy_out,credits FROM partner_graph WHERE id=?`,[id],(_e,row)=>{
    res.json({ok:true, partner_id:id, balance: row||{}});
  });
});

/* ---------- 3) Shared Memory Bus — packets ---------- */
app.post('/api/sync/send', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { from_partner, to_partner, scope='daily', summary='', tone='', day='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!from_partner||!to_partner) return res.json({ok:false, error:'from/to required'});
  const packet = JSON.stringify({summary, tone, day, hash: String(summary+tone+day).length});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO memory_sync(from_partner,to_partner,scope,packet) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
    [from_partner,to_partner,scope,packet], function(){ res.json({ok:true, id:this.lastID}); });
});

app.get('/api/sync/inbox', (req,res)=>{
  const to_partner = Number(req.query.to_partner||0);
  if(!to_partner) return res.json({ok:false, error:'to_partner required'});
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM memory_sync WHERE to_partner=? AND ack=0 ORDER BY id DESC`,[to_partner],
    (_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

app.post('/api/sync/ack', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { id } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE memory_sync SET ack=1 WHERE id=?`,[id],()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

/* ---------- 4) Adaptive Tutor — rules + suggestion ---------- */
app.get('/api/tutor/rules', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM adaptive_rules WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, rules:row}));
});

app.post('/api/tutor/rules/save', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { mode, min_energy, max_intensity } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE adaptive_rules SET
    mode=COALESCE(?,mode),
    min_energy=COALESCE(?,min_energy),
    max_intensity=COALESCE(?,max_intensity),
    last_update=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
    [mode, min_energy, max_intensity], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/tutor/suggest', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(s)=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(s,[],(_e,r)=>ok(r)));
  const rules = await one(`SELECT * FROM adaptive_rules WHERE id=1`);
  const emo   = await one(`SELECT valence_avg v,intensity_avg i FROM emotion_trend ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1`);
  const en    = await one(`SELECT AVG(score) e FROM energy_curve WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const v = +((emo?.v)||0), i = Math.round((emo?.i)||0), e = Math.round((en?.e)||0);
  let plan='🧭 Baseline: 1 tiny ship.';
  if(rules.mode==='crisp' || (e>=rules.min_energy && i<=rules.max_intensity)) plan='⏱️ Focus 25m: finish one task + 5m log.';
  if(rules.mode==='gentle' || (e<rules.min_energy || i>rules.max_intensity)) plan='🌿 Gentle: 10m tidy + 10m review + gratitude line.';
  res.json({ok:true, plan, stats:{v,i,e}, rules});
});

/* ---------- 5) Civic Resonance — register + export ---------- */
app.post('/api/civic/register', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { name, kind='community', policy={consent:true, anonymize:true}, contact='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!name) return res.json({ok:false, error:'name required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO civic_nodes(name,kind,policy,contact) VALUES(?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET kind=excluded.kind, policy=excluded.policy, contact=excluded.contact`,
    [name, kind, JSON.stringify(policy), contact], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/civic/export', (req,res)=>{
  // anonymized weekly slice: Harmony Index + Coherence title only
  db.all(`SELECT d,score FROM harmony_index ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 7`,[],(_e,hi)=>{
    db.all(`SELECT week,title FROM coherence_story ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(_e,cs)=>{
      res.json({ok:true, payload:{harmony:hi||[], story:(cs?.[0]||null)}, anonymized:true});
    });
  });
});

/* ---------- Harmony Economy Protocol (Step 3) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harmony_economy(
  week TEXT PRIMARY KEY,         -- 2025-W45
  g_total REAL, r_total REAL,    -- give / receive totals
  fairness REAL,                 -- 0..1 (1=balanced)
  note TEXT
)`);

function isoWeekStr(d=new Date()){
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  const dayNum = date.getUTCDay() || 7; date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + 4 - dayNum);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
  const weekNo = Math.ceil((((date - yearStart)/86400000)+1)/7);
  return `${date.getUTCFullYear()}-W${String(weekNo).padStart(2,'0')}`;
}

app.post('/api/harmony/economy', async (_req,res)=>{
  const week = isoWeekStr(new Date());
  db.all(`SELECT kind, SUM(delta) s FROM reciprocal_ledger
          WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 day') GROUP BY kind`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    const g = Number(rows.find(x=>x.kind==='give')?.s||0);
    const r = Number(rows.find(x=>x.kind==='receive')?.s||0);
    const denom = Math.max(1, g+r);
    const fairness = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - Math.abs(g-r)/denom)); // 1 when balanced
    const note = (fairness>0.8?'balanced':fairness>0.5?'ok':'needs reciprocity boost');
    db.run(`INSERT INTO harmony_economy(week,g_total,r_total,fairness,note)
            VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
            ON CONFLICT(week) DO UPDATE SET g_total=excluded.g_total,r_total=excluded.r_total,fairness=excluded.fairness,note=excluded.note`,
      [week,g,r,fairness,note], ()=>res.json({ok:true, week, g_total:g, r_total:r, fairness, note}));
  });
});

app.get('/api/harmony/economy/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM harmony_economy ORDER BY week DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js`  (paste the whole block)

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-8: COSMIC SENSOR & RHYTHM INTELLIGENCE
   8.1 Chrono-Sensor        → time / light rhythm
   8.2 Emo-Sensor           → text tone → numbers
   8.3 Bio-Cycle Tracker    → awake/sleep windows
   8.4 Cosmic Sync Feed     → lunar day (symbolic)
   8.5 Flow Adjuster        → tune reminders + tutor
   ========================================================== */

/* ---------- shared tiny utils ---------- */
function todayStr() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function clamp01(x){ return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x)); }
function lerp(a,b,t){ return a + (b-a)*t; }

/* ---------- schema ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config_core(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  tz TEXT DEFAULT 'local',
  lat REAL, lon REAL,
  day_start INTEGER DEFAULT 7,   -- fallback day window
  day_end   INTEGER DEFAULT 19
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO config_core(id) VALUES(1)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chrono_sensor_daily(
  d TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                 -- YYYY-MM-DD
  sunrise TEXT, sunset TEXT,          -- 'HH:MM' approx; fallback via window
  light_ratio REAL,                   -- 0..1 (day length / 24h)
  active_score REAL                   -- 0..1 (based on your response hours)
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emo_sensor_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT, ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  text TEXT,
  valence REAL,        -- -1..1
  arousal INTEGER,     -- 0..100 (intensity proxy)
  tags TEXT            -- JSON array of cues
)`);
db.run(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emo_d ON emo_sensor_log(d)`);

/* ==========================================================
   8.1 CHRONO-SENSOR
   - approximate sunrise/sunset (fallback if no lat/lon)
   - computes light_ratio
   - computes active_score from recent reminder replies (if any)
   ========================================================== */

// very small sunrise/sunset approx: if no lat/lon -> use day_start/day_end; else simple seasonal proxy
function approxSunTimes(lat, lon, date=new Date()){
  if(typeof lat!=='number' || typeof lon!=='number' || isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lon)){
    return null; // use fallback window
  }
  // crude approximation: longer days in June (north) / Dec (south). Not astronomical, just a harmless rhythm cue.
  const y = date.getUTCFullYear();
  const start = Date.UTC(y,0,0);
  const doy = Math.floor((date - start)/86400000);
  const amp = 4 + 2 * Math.cos((2*Math.PI*(doy-172))/365); // vary ±2h around 12h baseline
  const daylen = 12 + (lat>=0 ? amp : -amp); // very rough
  const noon = 12;
  const rise = noon - daylen/2;
  const set  = noon + daylen/2;
  const toHHMM = (h)=>`${String(Math.floor(h)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(Math.round((h%1)*60)).padStart(2,'0')}`;
  return {sunrise:toHHMM(rise), sunset:toHHMM(set), light_ratio: clamp01(daylen/24) };
}

app.post('/api/chrono/run', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const d = todayStr();
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM config_core WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,cfg)=>{
    let sunrise='07:00', sunset='19:00', light_ratio=12/24;
    const approx = approxSunTimes(cfg?.lat, cfg?.lon, new Date());
    if(approx){ sunrise=approx.sunrise; sunset=approx.sunset; light_ratio=approx.light_ratio; }
    else { // fallback to configured window
      sunrise = `${String(cfg?.day_start??7).padStart(2,'0')}:00`;
      sunset  = `${String(cfg?.day_end??19).padStart(2,'0')}:00`;
      light_ratio = clamp01(((cfg?.day_end??19) - (cfg?.day_start??7))/24);
    }
    // crude "active score": prefer hours where you usually respond (read from reminder_tone_log timestamps if present)
    db.all(`SELECT time(ts) t FROM reminder_tone_log WHERE d=?`,[d],(_e,rows)=>{
      const active_score = rows?.length ? 0.7 : 0.5; // simple placeholder
      db.run(`INSERT INTO chrono_sensor_daily(d,sunrise,sunset,light_ratio,active_score)
              VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
              ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET sunrise=excluded.sunrise,sunset=excluded.sunset,light_ratio=excluded.light_ratio,active_score=excluded.active_score`,
        [d,sunrise,sunset,light_ratio,active_score],
        ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, sunrise, sunset, light_ratio, active_score}));
    });
  });
});

app.post('/api/config/timeplace', express.json(), (req,res)=>{

});

/* ==========================================================
   8.2 EMO-SENSOR (rule-based text tone)
   - simple lexicon for valence/arousal + tag cues
   ========================================================== */
const POS = ['grateful','thanks','calm','peace','progress','win','love','light','ok','balanced','flow'];
const NEG = ['tired','exhausted','pain','angry','sad','stuck','overwhelm','confused','lost','anxious','worry','doubt'];
const HI  = ['wow','intense','urgent','very','!!','!!!','now','must','today'];
const LO  = ['slow','soft','gentle','later','breathe','rest','pause'];

function scoreEmo(text=''){
  const t = (text||'').toLowerCase();
  let vp=0, vn=0, a=50; const tags=[];
  for(const w of POS){ if(t.includes(w)){ vp+=1; tags.push(w);} }
  for(const w of NEG){ if(t.includes(w)){ vn+=1; tags.push(`-${w}`);} }
  for(const w of HI){ if(t.includes(w)){ a+=8; tags.push('hi:'+w);} }
  for(const w of LO){ if(t.includes(w)){ a-=6; tags.push('lo:'+w);} }
  a = Math.round(clamp01(a/100)*100);
  const v = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (vp - vn)/5 ));
  return { valence:v, arousal:a, tags:[...new Set(tags)] };
}

app.post('/api/emo/analyze', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { text } = req.body||{};
  const {valence, arousal, tags} = scoreEmo(text||'');
  db.run(`INSERT INTO emo_sensor_log(d,text,valence,arousal,tags) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [todayStr(), text||'', valence, arousal, JSON.stringify(tags)],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, valence, arousal, tags}));
});

app.get('/api/emo/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d=? ORDER BY id DESC`,[todayStr()],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* ==========================================================
   8.3 BIO-CYCLE TRACKER
   - manual set or infer; computes hours + quality (basic)
   ========================================================== */
app.post('/api/bio/set', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { d=todayStr(), wake='07:30', sleep='23:30', quality=0.7 } = req.body||{};
  function hhmmToHours(s){ const [h,m]=String(s).split(':').map(Number); return h+(m||0)/60; }
  const w = hhmmToHours(wake), s = hhmmToHours(sleep);
  const span = s>w ? (s-w) : (24 - (w - s));
  const sleepH = 24 - span;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO biocycle_daily(d,wake_hhmm,sleep_hhmm,awake_hours,sleep_hours,quality)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET wake_hhmm=excluded.wake_hhmm,sleep_hhmm=excluded.sleep_hhmm,awake_hours=excluded.awake_hours,sleep_hours=excluded.sleep_hours,quality=excluded.quality`,
    [d,wake,sleep, span, sleepH, clamp01(quality)],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, wake, sleep, awake_hours:span, sleep_hours:sleepH, quality:clamp01(quality)}));
});

app.get('/api/bio/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM biocycle_daily WHERE d=?`,[todayStr()],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, row}));
});

/* ==========================================================
   8.4 COSMIC SYNC FEED (lunar phase approx)
   - simple Synodic month ≈ 29.53 days; phase buckets
   ========================================================== */
function moonPhase(date=new Date()){
  // Conway-like quick approximation (no internet): result into 0..1 cycle
  const lp = Date.UTC(2001,0,6,18,14); // known new moon anchor (rough)
  const syn = 29.530588853 * 86400000;
  const phase = ((date - lp) % syn + syn) % syn;
  const p = phase/syn; // 0..1
  let name='waxing', score=0.5;
  if(p<0.03 || p>0.97){ name='new'; score=0.2; }
  else if(p<0.25){ name='waxing'; score=0.6; }
  else if(p<0.28|| (p>0.72 && p<0.78)){ name='quarter'; score=0.5; }
  else if(p<0.47){ name='gibbous'; score=0.7; }
  else if(p<0.53){ name='full'; score=1.0; }
  else if(p<0.72){ name='waning'; score=0.6; }
  else { name='crescent'; score=0.4; }
  return {name, score};
}

app.post('/api/cosmic/run', (_req,res)=>{
  const d = todayStr();
  const {name, score} = moonPhase(new Date());
  const note = name==='full' ? 'high clarity / attention' : name==='new' ? 'seed / intention' : 'normal';
  db.run(`INSERT INTO cosmic_sync(d,moon_phase,phase_score,note)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET moon_phase=excluded.moon_phase,phase_score=excluded.phase_score,note=excluded.note`,
    [d,name,score,note], ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, moon_phase:name, phase_score:score, note}));
});

app.get('/api/cosmic/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM cosmic_sync WHERE d=?`,[todayStr()],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, row}));
});

/* ==========================================================
   8.5 FLOW ADJUSTER
   - reads chrono + emo + bio + cosmic → suggests reminder times & mode
   ========================================================== */
app.post('/api/flow/adjust', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(s,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(s,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const d = todayStr();
  const chrono = await one(`SELECT * FROM chrono_sensor_daily WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const bio    = await one(`SELECT * FROM biocycle_daily WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const cosmic = await one(`SELECT * FROM cosmic_sync WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const emo    = await one(`SELECT AVG(valence) v, AVG(arousal) a FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d=?`,[d]);

  // derive scores
  const energy  = chrono ? chrono.active_score : 0.5;            // 0..1
  const sleepQ  = bio ? (bio.quality ?? 0.7) : 0.7;              // 0..1
  const mood    = emo ? ( (Number(emo.v)||0) + 1 )/2 : 0.5;      // -1..1 → 0..1
  const lunar   = cosmic ? (cosmic.phase_score||0.5) : 0.5;      // 0..1

  const blend = (energy*0.35) + (sleepQ*0.25) + (mood*0.30) + (lunar*0.10); // 0..1
  let mode='steady';
  if(blend>=0.72) mode='crisp';
  else if(blend<=0.38) mode='gentle';
  else if(mood>0.75 && lunar>0.8) mode='celebrate';

  // suggest times: push check-in toward "sunset minus 1h" if available, else 21:00
  function toMinutes(hhmm){ const [h,m]=String(hhmm).split(':').map(Number); return h*60+(m||0); }
  function toHHMM(min){ const h=Math.floor(min/60)%24, m=Math.round(min%60); return `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}`; }
  let checkin='21:00', follow='21:05';
  if(chrono?.sunset){
    const sMin = toMinutes(chrono.sunset);
    checkin = toHHMM((sMin - 60 + 1440)%1440);
    follow  = toHHMM((toMinutes(checkin)+5)%1440);
  }

  const basis = `blend=${blend.toFixed(2)} (energy:${energy.toFixed(2)} sleep:${sleepQ.toFixed(2)} mood:${mood.toFixed(2)} moon:${lunar.toFixed(2)})`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO flow_adjustment(d,mode,checkin_hhmm,follow_hhmm,basis)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET mode=excluded.mode,checkin_hhmm=excluded.checkin_hhmm,follow_hhmm=excluded.follow_hhmm,basis=excluded.basis`,
    [d,mode,checkin,follow,basis],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, mode, checkin, follow, basis}));
});

app.get('/api/flow/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=?`,[todayStr()],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, row}));
});
```
