```js
  public_key TEXT,        -- display-only stub (local)
  secret_key TEXT,        -- local-only shared secret for file packets
  consent INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 1 when opted-in to share packets
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);

app.post('/api/partners/keygen', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  const sk = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const pk = 'local-' + sk.slice(0,8);
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partner_keys(partner_id,public_key,secret_key,consent)
          VALUES(?,?,?,0)
          ON CONFLICT(partner_id) DO UPDATE SET public_key=excluded.public_key, secret_key=excluded.secret_key, updated=datetime('now')`,
    [partner_id, pk, sk], ()=>res.json({ok:true, partner_id, public_key:pk}));
});

app.post('/api/partners/optin', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, consent } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partner_keys(partner_id,consent)
          VALUES(?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(partner_id) DO UPDATE SET consent=excluded.consent, updated=datetime('now')`,
    [partner_id, consent?1:0], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/partners/keys', (req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT pk.partner_id, p.name, pk.public_key, pk.consent, pk.updated
          FROM partner_keys pk JOIN partner_graph p ON p.id=pk.partner_id
          ORDER BY pk.partner_id`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* ---------- 9.2 RESONANCE LEDGER ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS resonance_ledger(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  a_partner INTEGER,
  b_partner INTEGER,
  channel TEXT,          -- 'text','voice','work','study'
  resonance REAL,        -- 0..1 harmony score
  load REAL,             -- 0..1 perceived effort/strain
  note TEXT
)`);
db.run(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_res_ts ON resonance_ledger(ts)`);

function bound01(x){ return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Number(x)||0)); }
app.post('/api/resonance/log', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { a_partner, b_partner, channel='text', resonance=0.5, load=0.3, note='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!a_partner||!b_partner) return res.json({ok:false, error:'two partners required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO resonance_ledger(a_partner,b_partner,channel,resonance,load,note)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [a_partner,b_partner,channel,bound01(resonance),bound01(load),note],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/resonance/score', (req,res)=>{
  const { a, b, days=7 } = req.query||{};
  if(!a||!b) return res.json({ok:false, error:'a & b required'});
  db.get(`SELECT AVG(resonance) r, AVG(load) l
          FROM resonance_ledger
          WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) AND
                ((a_partner=? AND b_partner=?) OR (a_partner=? AND b_partner=?))`,
    [`-${Number(days)||7} day`, a,b,b,a],
    (_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, avg_resonance: +(row?.r||0), avg_load: +(row?.l||0)}));
});

/* ---------- 9.3 HARMONY MEDIATOR ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mediator_state(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  mode TEXT DEFAULT 'auto',     -- 'auto'|'quiet'|'boost'
  tone TEXT DEFAULT 'neutral',  -- 'gentle'|'neutral'|'crisp'
  intensity INTEGER DEFAULT 50, -- 0..100
  last_basis TEXT,
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO mediator_state(id) VALUES(1)`);

app.post('/api/mediator/run', express.json(), async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  // pull today’s averages from existing sensors (Phase-8) if present
  const emo = await one(`SELECT AVG(valence) v, AVG(arousal) a FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const flow= await one(`SELECT mode FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=date('now')`);
  const v=((emo?.v)||0), a=Math.round((emo?.a)||50);
  // heuristic: high arousal + neg valence => lower intensity; positive & moderate arousal => boost
  let tone='neutral', intensity=50;
  if(v<0 && a>60){ tone='gentle'; intensity=35; }
  if(v>0.2 && a>=45 && a<=70){ tone='crisp'; intensity=65; }
  if(flow?.mode==='celebrate'){ tone='crisp'; intensity=72; }
  const basis=`v=${v.toFixed(2)} a=${a} flow=${flow?.mode||'-'}`;
  db.run(`UPDATE mediator_state SET tone=?, intensity=?, last_basis=?, updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
    [tone,intensity,basis],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, tone, intensity, basis}));
});

app.get('/api/mediator/state', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM mediator_state WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, state:row}));
});

/* ---------- 9.4 SHARED KNOWLEDGE POOL (patterns) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skp_patterns(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  partner_id INTEGER,
  channel TEXT,            -- 'text','voice','study','system'
  keywords TEXT,           -- JSON array of top tokens
  fingerprint TEXT,        -- short hash for dedup
  weight REAL DEFAULT 1.0
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS skp_inbox(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  from_partner INTEGER,
  payload TEXT,            -- JSON: {keywords,fingerprint,weight,channel}
  verified INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)`);

// tiny keyword extractor (bag of words + stoplist)
const STOP = new Set('the a an and or of to in for with on at by from this that is are was were be been have has had do did done can will shall should could would i you he she it we they not no yes as if but so very more most much'.split(' '));
function topKeywords(text='', k=6){
  const m = (text||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(w=>w && !STOP.has(w));
  const f = {}; for(const w of m){ f[w]=(f[w]||0)+1; }
  return Object.entries(f).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,k).map(x=>x[0]);
}
function tinyHash(s){ let h=0; for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){ h=((h<<5)-h)+s.charCodeAt(i); h|=0; } return 'h'+(h>>>0).toString(36); }

app.post('/api/skp/extract', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, channel='text', text='', weight=1.0 } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id || !text) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id and text required'});
  const keywords = topKeywords(text, 7);
  const fingerprint = tinyHash(keywords.join('|'));
  db.run(`INSERT INTO skp_patterns(partner_id,channel,keywords,fingerprint,weight)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`,
    [partner_id, channel, JSON.stringify(keywords), fingerprint, Number(weight)||1],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, keywords, fingerprint}));
});

app.get('/api/skp/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM skp_patterns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

// export/import packets (local files via JSON string in response/request)
app.get('/api/skp/export', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT partner_id,channel,keywords,fingerprint,weight FROM skp_patterns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200`,
    [],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, packet:{type:'SKP', ver:1, items:rows||[]}}));
});

app.post('/api/skp/import', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { from_partner=0, packet } = req.body||{};
  if(!packet?.items) return res.json({ok:false, error:'packet required'});
  const payload = JSON.stringify(packet);
  db.run(`INSERT INTO skp_inbox(from_partner,payload) VALUES(?,?)`,
    [from_partner, payload], ()=>res.json({ok:true, received:(packet.items||[]).length}));
});

/* ---------- 9.5 CONSENT & PRIVACY KERNEL ---------- */
function requireConsent(partner_id, cb){
  db.get(`SELECT consent FROM partner_keys WHERE partner_id=?`,[partner_id],(_e,row)=>{
    cb(!!(row && row.consent));
  });
}

app.post('/api/skp/share', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, channel='text', text='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  requireConsent(partner_id, (ok)=>{
    if(!ok) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner has not opted-in to share'});
    const keywords = topKeywords(text, 7);
    const fingerprint = tinyHash(keywords.join('|'));
    // "share" here means: return safe packet to caller for manual delivery
    const packet = { type:'SKP', ver:1, items:[{partner_id,channel,keywords,fingerprint,weight:1}] };
    res.json({ok:true, packet});
  });
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` — Phase-10 Pack

> Paste the whole block once.

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-10: SELF-EVOLVING ECOSYSTEM
   10.1 Adaptive Learning Engine
   10.2 Pattern Composer
   10.3 Trust-Energy Ledger
   10.4 Regenerative Scheduler
   10.5 Self-Reflection Kernel
   ========================================================== */

function T_today() { return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function b01(x){ x=Number(x)||0; return Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)); }

/* ---------- 10.1 ADAPTIVE LEARNING ENGINE ---------- */
/* Signals we already have (from Ph-8/9):
   - emo_sensor_log (valence, arousal)
   - flow_adjustment (mode)
   - resonance_ledger (avg resonance/load)
   - chrono_sensor_daily (active_score)
*/
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_recommendations(
  d TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  next_action TEXT,         -- 'nudge','pause','celebrate','shift_time','focus_one'
  intensity INTEGER,        -- 0..100
  reason TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/learn/run', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const d=T_today();
  const emo = await one(`SELECT AVG(valence) v, AVG(arousal) a FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const flow= await one(`SELECT mode FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const ch  = await one(`SELECT active_score a FROM chrono_sensor_daily WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const res = await one(`SELECT AVG(resonance) r, AVG(load) l FROM resonance_ledger WHERE date(ts)=date('now')`);
  const v = Number(emo?.v||0), a = Number(emo?.a||50);
  const act= Number(ch?.a||0.5), r = Number(res?.r||0.6), L = Number(res?.l||0.3);

  // heuristic blend
  const energy = (act*0.35) + ((v+1)/2*0.35) + ((100-a)/100*0.10) + ((1-L)*0.20); // 0..1
  let next='focus_one', intensity=50;
  if(energy<0.38) { next='pause'; intensity=30; }
  else if(energy>0.72 && (flow?.mode==='crisp')) { next='celebrate'; intensity=75; }
  else if(r<0.5 || L>0.55) { next='gentle_nudge'; intensity=40; }
  else if(flow?.mode==='gentle') { next='shift_time'; intensity=45; }
  else { next='nudge'; intensity=55; }

  const reason = `energy=${energy.toFixed(2)} v=${v.toFixed(2)} a=${a} res=${r.toFixed(2)} load=${L.toFixed(2)} flow=${flow?.mode||'-'}`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO learning_recommendations(d,next_action,intensity,reason)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET next_action=excluded.next_action,intensity=excluded.intensity,reason=excluded.reason`,
    [d,next,intensity,reason],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, next_action:next, intensity, reason}));
});

app.get('/api/learn/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM learning_recommendations WHERE d=?`,[T_today()],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, row}));
});

/* ---------- 10.2 PATTERN COMPOSER ---------- */
/* Uses SKP keywords + flow/mode to compose fresh micro-templates */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS composed_patterns(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT DEFAULT (date('now')),
  channel TEXT,          -- 'progress','reflection','study'
  template TEXT,
  basis TEXT
)`);

function composeTemplate(keywords=[], mode='steady', channel='progress'){
  const k = (keywords||[]).slice(0,4).join(' • ');
  let t = '';
  if(channel==='progress'){
    t = (mode==='gentle')
      ? `One tiny note: What moved a little? (${k})`
      : (mode==='crisp')
      ? `Quick pulse → What actually shipped today? (${k})`
      : `Progress ping — what moved, what’s next? (${k})`;
  } else if(channel==='reflection'){
    t = (mode==='gentle')
      ? `Soft mirror: what felt different in me? (${k})`
      : `Reflection: what did AUMNITY mirror back today? (${k})`;
  } else {
    t = (mode==='crisp')
      ? `Study snap: pick 1 exercise you can finish now. (${k})`
      : `Tutor note: choose a small step. (${k})`;
  }
  return t;
}

app.post('/api/compose/run', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const channel = (req.body?.channel)||'progress';
  const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const flow= await one(`SELECT mode FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=?`,[T_today()]);
  const mode= flow?.mode || 'steady';
  // gather top SKP keywords from last 3 days
  const rows = await new Promise(ok=>db.all(
    `SELECT keywords FROM skp_patterns WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-3 day') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40`,[],
    (_e,rr)=>ok(rr||[])
  ));
  const bag = {};
  for(const r of rows){ try{
    (JSON.parse(r.keywords)||[]).forEach(w=>bag[w]=(bag[w]||0)+1);
  }catch{} }
  const top = Object.entries(bag).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,6).map(x=>x[0]);
  const tpl = composeTemplate(top, mode, channel);
  const basis = `mode=${mode} top=${top.join(',')}`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO composed_patterns(channel,template,basis) VALUES(?,?,?)`,
    [channel,tpl,basis],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, channel, template:tpl, basis}));
});

app.get('/api/compose/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM composed_patterns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* ---------- 10.3 TRUST-ENERGY LEDGER ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trust_energy(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  partner_id INTEGER,          -- who contributed
  contribution REAL,           -- 0..1 weighting
  completion REAL,             -- 0..1 task completion
  harmony REAL,                -- 0..1 resonance with others
  note TEXT
)`);
db.run(`CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_te_p ON trust_energy(partner_id)`);

app.post('/api/trust/log', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, contribution=0.5, completion=0.0, harmony=0.6, note='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO trust_energy(partner_id,contribution,completion,harmony,note)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,[+partner_id,b01(contribution),b01(completion),b01(harmony),note],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.get('/api/trust/score', (req,res)=>{
  const { partner_id, days=14 } = req.query||{};
  if(!partner_id) return res.json({ok:false, error:'partner_id required'});
  db.get(`SELECT AVG(contribution) c, AVG(completion) m, AVG(harmony) h
          FROM trust_energy WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?) AND partner_id=?`,
    [`-${Number(days)||14} day`, +partner_id],
    (_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, score: (0.4*(row?.c||0)+0.4*(row?.m||0)+0.2*(row?.h||0)) , detail:row||{}}));
});

/* ---------- 10.4 REGENERATIVE SCHEDULER ---------- */
/* Writes suggested reminder hours into a small table (engine reads it). */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schedule_regen(
  d TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  checkin_hhmm TEXT,
  follow_hhmm TEXT,
  intensity INTEGER,
  rule TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/schedule/regenerate', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const d=T_today();
  const learn= await one(`SELECT next_action,intensity FROM learning_recommendations WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const flow = await one(`SELECT checkin_hhmm,follow_hhmm,mode FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  // if next_action says 'shift_time' → move earlier by 30m; if 'pause' → push by +90m and drop intensity
  function toM(s){ const [h,m]=String(s||'21:00').split(':').map(Number); return h*60+(m||0); }
  function toH(m){ const h=((Math.floor(m/60)%24)+24)%24, mm=((Math.round(m%60)+60)%60); return `${String(h).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(mm).padStart(2,'0')}`; }
  let c = flow?.checkin_hhmm || '21:00';
  let f = flow?.follow_hhmm  || '21:05';
  let inten = Number(learn?.intensity||55);
  let rule  = `flow=${flow?.mode||'steady'} learn=${learn?.next_action||'-'}`;

  if(learn?.next_action==='shift_time') {
    c = toH(toM(c)-30); f = toH(toM(c)+5);
    rule += ' | shifted -30m';
  } else if(learn?.next_action==='pause') {
    c = toH(toM(c)+90); f = toH(toM(c)+95);
    inten = Math.max(25, inten-20);
    rule += ' | paused +90m';
  } else if(learn?.next_action==='celebrate') {
    inten = Math.min(85, inten+15);
    rule += ' | celebrate boost';
  }

  db.run(`INSERT INTO schedule_regen(d,checkin_hhmm,follow_hhmm,intensity,rule)
          VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)
          ON CONFLICT(d) DO UPDATE SET checkin_hhmm=excluded.checkin_hhmm,follow_hhmm=excluded.follow_hhmm,intensity=excluded.intensity,rule=excluded.rule`,
    [d,c,f,inten,rule],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, d, checkin_hhmm:c, follow_hhmm:f, intensity:inten, rule}));
});

app.get('/api/schedule/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM schedule_regen WHERE d=?`,[T_today()],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:!!row, row}));
});

/* ---------- 10.5 SELF-REFLECTION KERNEL ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aum_self_diary(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  d TEXT DEFAULT (date('now')),
  entry TEXT,
  basis TEXT
)`);

app.post('/api/selfreflect/run', async (_req,res)=>{
  const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
  const d=T_today();
  const L = await one(`SELECT * FROM learning_recommendations WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const F = await one(`SELECT * FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const M = await one(`SELECT * FROM mediator_state WHERE id=1`);
  const S = await one(`SELECT * FROM schedule_regen WHERE d=?`,[d]);
  const line = `Today I tuned toward ${F?.mode||'steady'}; next=${L?.next_action||'nudge'}; tone=${M?.tone||'neutral'}/${M?.intensity||50}; schedule=${S?.checkin_hhmm||'21:00'}; I will learn from the response.`;
  const basis= `flow=${F?.mode} learn=${L?.reason} med=${M?.last_basis} rule=${S?.rule}`;
  db.run(`INSERT INTO aum_self_diary(entry,basis) VALUES(?,?)`,[line,basis],()=>res.json({ok:true, entry:line}));
});

app.get('/api/selfreflect/today', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM aum_self_diary WHERE d=? ORDER BY id DESC`,[T_today()],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-11: Revenue-Ready & Ops QoL
   - Mandatory: data export (JSON/weekly report), paywall flag
   - Optional: reminder toggles, P2P SKP packet save/import,
               DB backup, checkout link, voice-pack catalog
   ========================================================== */

// ---------- 11.0 small helpers ----------
function isoDate(d=new Date()){ return d.toISOString().slice(0,10); }
function daysAgo(n){ return new Date(Date.now()-n*86400000); }
function q(a){ return a==null?'':String(a); }

// ---------- 11.1 PLAN / PAYWALL (Mandatory) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config_plan(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  plan TEXT DEFAULT 'free',      -- 'free' | 'supporter' | 'team'
  checkout_url TEXT,             -- external payment page
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO config_plan(id) VALUES(1)`);

app.get('/api/plan/get', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT plan, checkout_url FROM config_plan WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, plan:row?.plan||'free', checkout_url:row?.checkout_url||''}));
});
app.post('/api/plan/set', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { plan, checkout_url } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE config_plan SET plan=COALESCE(?,plan), checkout_url=COALESCE(?,checkout_url), updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
    [plan, checkout_url], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

// ---------- 11.2 REMINDER TOGGLES (Optional but useful) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminder_flags(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  progress_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  reflection_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  study_enabled INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO reminder_flags(id) VALUES(1)`);

app.get('/api/reminders/flags', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT * FROM reminder_flags WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, flags:row}));
});
app.post('/api/reminders/flags', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { progress_enabled, reflection_enabled, study_enabled } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE reminder_flags SET
           progress_enabled=COALESCE(?,progress_enabled),
           reflection_enabled=COALESCE(?,reflection_enabled),
           study_enabled=COALESCE(?,study_enabled),
           updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
    [progress_enabled, reflection_enabled, study_enabled],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

// ---------- 11.3 EXPORTS (Mandatory: JSON + Weekly printable HTML) ----------
app.get('/export/json', (req,res)=>{
  const days = Math.max(1, Math.min(60, Number(req.query.days)||7));
  const since = new Date(Date.now()-days*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const out = {};
  const pull = (sql,args,key)=>new Promise(ok=>db.all(sql,args,(_e,rows)=>{ out[key]=rows||[]; ok(); }));
  Promise.all([
    pull(`SELECT * FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d>=?`,[since],'flow'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM learning_recommendations WHERE d>=?`,[since],'learn'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM resonance_ledger WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?)`,[`-${days} day`],'resonance'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM trust_energy WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?)`,[`-${days} day`],'trust'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d>=?`,[since],'emo'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM chrono_sensor_daily WHERE d>=?`,[since],'chrono'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM biocycle_daily WHERE d>=?`,[since],'bio'),
    pull(`SELECT * FROM aum_self_diary WHERE d>=?`,[since],'diary')
  ]).then(()=>{
    res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');
    res.setHeader('Content-Disposition',`attachment; filename=aum_export_${isoDate()}.json`);
    res.end(JSON.stringify({generated: new Date().toISOString(), days, data: out}, null, 2));
  });
});

// Printable weekly HTML (use browser "Print to PDF")
app.get('/export/weekly', (req,res)=>{
  const days = 7;
  const since = daysAgo(days).toISOString().slice(0,10);
  const pull = (sql,args)=>new Promise(ok=>db.all(sql,args,(_e,rows)=>ok(rows||[])));
  (async ()=>{
    const flow = await pull(`SELECT * FROM flow_adjustment WHERE d>=? ORDER BY d`,[since]);
    const learn= await pull(`SELECT * FROM learning_recommendations WHERE d>=? ORDER BY d`,[since]);
    const reso = await pull(`SELECT date(ts) d, AVG(resonance) r, AVG(load) l FROM resonance_ledger WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d`,[`-${days} day`]);
    const trust= await pull(`SELECT date(ts) d, AVG(contribution) c, AVG(completion) m, AVG(harmony) h FROM trust_energy WHERE ts>=datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY d`,[`-${days} day`]);
    const emo  = await pull(`SELECT d, AVG(valence) v, AVG(arousal) a FROM emo_sensor_log WHERE d>=? GROUP BY d ORDER BY d`,[since]);
    const html = `
<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8">
<title>AUMNITY – Weekly Pulse (${isoDate()})</title>
<style>body{font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial;padding:24px;max-width:900px;margin:auto}
h1{margin:0 0 8px} h2{margin:24px 0 8px} table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%} td,th{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:6px 8px;font-size:14px} .mut{color:#666}</style>
<h1>Weekly Pulse Report</h1>
<div class="mut">Generated ${new Date().toLocaleString()}</div>
<h2>Summary</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Flow days: ${flow.length}</li>
  <li>Learning recs: ${learn.length}</li>
  <li>Avg resonance: ${(reso.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b.r||0),0)/Math.max(1,reso.length)).toFixed(2)} · Avg load: ${(reso.reduce((a,b)=>a+(b.l||0),0)/Math.max(1,reso.length)).toFixed(2)}</li>
  <li>Trust score (avg): ${((trust.reduce((a,b)=>a+((0.4*(b.c||0)+0.4*(b.m||0)+0.2*(b.h||0))),0))/Math.max(1,trust.length)).toFixed(2)}</li>
</ul>
<h2>Daily Flow</h2>
<table><tr><th>Day</th><th>Mode</th><th>Check-in</th><th>Follow</th><th>Basis</th></tr>
${flow.map(r=>`<tr><td>${q(r.d)}</td><td>${q(r.mode)}</td><td>${q(r.checkin_hhmm)}</td><td>${q(r.follow_hhmm)}</td><td class="mut">${q(r.basis)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
</table>
<h2>Learning Recommendations</h2>
<table><tr><th>Day</th><th>Next Action</th><th>Intensity</th><th>Reason</th></tr>
${learn.map(r=>`<tr><td>${q(r.d)}</td><td>${q(r.next_action)}</td><td>${q(r.intensity)}</td><td class="mut">${q(r.reason)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
</table>
<h2>Resonance (avg per day)</h2>
<table><tr><th>Day</th><th>Resonance</th><th>Load</th></tr>
${reso.map(r=>`<tr><td>${q(r.d)}</td><td>${(r.r||0).toFixed(2)}</td><td>${(r.l||0).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
</table>
<h2>Trust-Energy (avg per day)</h2>
<table><tr><th>Day</th><th>Contrib</th><th>Compl</th><th>Harmony</th></tr>
${trust.map(r=>`<tr><td>${q(r.d)}</td><td>${(r.c||0).toFixed(2)}</td><td>${(r.m||0).toFixed(2)}</td><td>${(r.h||0).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
</table>
<h2>Emotion (avg per day)</h2>
<table><tr><th>Day</th><th>Valence</th><th>Arousal</th></tr>
${emo.map(r=>`<tr><td>${q(r.d)}</td><td>${(r.v||0).toFixed(2)}</td><td>${Math.round(r.a||0)}</td></tr>`).join('')}
</table>
<p class="mut">Tip: use your browser’s “Print → Save as PDF”.</p>`;
    res.setHeader('Content-Type','text/html; charset=utf-8');
    res.end(html);
  })();
});

// ---------- 11.4 DB BACKUP (Optional) ----------
app.get('/backup/db', (_req,res)=>{
  res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/octet-stream');
  res.setHeader('Content-Disposition',`attachment; filename=${DB_FILE.replace(/^.*[\\/]/,'')}`);
  const fs = require('fs');
  fs.createReadStream(DB_FILE).pipe(res);
});

// ---------- 11.5 SKP P2P packet save/import helpers (Optional) ----------
app.post('/api/skp/savepacket', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const packet = req.body?.packet;
  if(!packet?.items) return res.json({ok:false, error:'packet required'});
  res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/json');
  res.setHeader('Content-Disposition',`attachment; filename=SKP_${isoDate()}.json`);
  res.end(JSON.stringify(packet,null,2));
});
app.post('/api/skp/importpacket', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const packet = req.body?.packet;
  if(!packet?.items) return res.json({ok:false, error:'packet required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO skp_inbox(from_partner,payload,verified) VALUES(?,?,0)`,
    [0, JSON.stringify(packet)], ()=>res.json({ok:true, received:(packet.items||[]).length}));
});

// ---------- 11.6 VOICE PACK CATALOG (Optional) ----------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_packs(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT,               -- display name
  url TEXT,                -- local/remote mp3 (user-provided)
  kind TEXT DEFAULT 'tts', -- 'tts'|'prompt'
  note TEXT,
  added TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
app.post('/api/voicepacks/add', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { name, url, kind='tts', note='' } = req.body||{};
  if(!name||!url) return res.json({ok:false, error:'name & url required'});
  db.run(`INSERT INTO voice_packs(name,url,kind,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,
    [name,url,kind,note], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.get('/api/voicepacks/list', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM voice_packs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` (paste once, after your existing routes)

> Also make sure you have `DB_FILE` defined near the top:
> ```js
> const DB_FILE = process.env.DB_FILE || 'aum_data.db';
> ```

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-12: Alive, Safe, Revenue-Ready (+ Voice→Text)
   Blocks: Auto-Dispatch · Security Pack · Backup/Restore
           Schema Migrations · Error Log · License Gate
           Voice→Text Ingestion · Better Keywords · Weights UI
           Consent Badges · Policy Note · Health/Version
   ========================================================== */

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

/* -------------------- SECURITY PACK -------------------- */
// CORS: allow only local pages
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  const o = req.headers.origin||'';
  if(!o || /^(http:\/\/localhost(:\d+)?|http:\/\/127\.0\.0\.1(:\d+)?)$/.test(o)) {
    res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', o||'*');
    res.setHeader('Vary','Origin');
  }
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers','Content-Type,Authorization');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods','GET,POST,OPTIONS');
  if(req.method==='OPTIONS') return res.end();
  next();
});

// Bearer guard (+ simple rate-limit per IP)
const RATE = new Map(); // ip -> {t,count}
function ratelimit(ip){
  const now = Date.now(), win=60000; // per minute
  const r = RATE.get(ip) || {t:now, count:0};
  if(now - r.t > win){ r.t=now; r.count=0; }
  r.count++; RATE.set(ip,r);
  return r.count <= 180; // 180 req/min
}
app.use((req,res,next)=>{
  if(!ratelimit(req.ip)) return res.status(429).json({ok:false,error:'rate limit'});
  const auth = req.headers.authorization||'';
  const token = (process.env.AUMNITY_BEARER||'').trim();
  if(token && !auth.includes(token)) return res.status(401).json({ok:false,error:'auth required'});
  next();
});

// input sanitiser helper
function asStr(x,max=1000){ const s=(x==null?'':String(x)).slice(0,max); return s.replace(/\u0000/g,''); }
function asNum01(x){ x=Number(x); return isFinite(x)?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)):0; }

// error log table + logger
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS error_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  route TEXT, msg TEXT, detail TEXT
)`);
function logErr(route,msg,detail){ db.run(`INSERT INTO error_log(route,msg,detail) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[route,asStr(msg,400),asStr(detail,2000)]); }
app.get('/api/errors/recent', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM error_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* -------------------- SCHEMA MIGRATIONS -------------------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))`);
function ensureMigration(id,name,sqls=[],done=()=>{}){
  db.get(`SELECT id FROM schema_migrations WHERE id=?`,[id],(_e,row)=>{
    if(row) return done();
    (function run(i){
      if(i>=sqls.length) return db.run(`INSERT INTO schema_migrations(id,name) VALUES(?,?)`,[id,name],done);
      db.run(sqls[i],[],(_e2)=>run(i+1));
    })(0);
  });
}
// example (safe no-op if exists)
ensureMigration(12_01,'add_indexes',[
  `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rl_day ON resonance_ledger(date(ts))`,
  `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_te_day ON trust_energy(date(ts))`
],()=>{});

/* -------------------- LICENSE / PLAN CHECK -------------------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS license_token(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  token TEXT, plan TEXT DEFAULT 'free', updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`);
db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO license_token(id) VALUES(1)`);
app.post('/api/license/set', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const token = asStr(req.body?.token,256);
  const plan  = asStr(req.body?.plan||'free',32);
  db.run(`UPDATE license_token SET token=?, plan=?, updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,[token,plan],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.get('/api/license/get', (_req,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT token, plan FROM license_token WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, token:row?.token||'', plan:row?.plan||'free'}));
});

/* -------------------- BACKUP / RESTORE -------------------- */
// (Backup already exists in Phase-11). Add restore:
app.post('/restore/db', express.raw({type:'application/octet-stream',limit:'200mb'}),(req,res)=>{
  try{
    const tmp = DB_FILE+'.incoming';
    fs.writeFileSync(tmp, req.body);
    // quick integrity: ensure it's sqlite (starts with 'SQLite format 3')
    const hdr = fs.readFileSync(tmp, {encoding:null}).slice(0,16).toString();
    if(!/^SQLite format 3/.test(hdr)){ fs.unlinkSync(tmp); return res.json({ok:false,error:'not a sqlite file'}); }
    fs.copyFileSync(tmp, DB_FILE); fs.unlinkSync(tmp);
    res.json({ok:true});
  }catch(e){ logErr('/restore/db',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'restore failed'}); }
});

/* -------------------- AUTO-DISPATCH (local scheduler) -------------------- */
/* Writes entries to reminders_log; UI can poll and show (or you can cron-notify). */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminders_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  kind TEXT,               -- 'progress'|'reflection'|'study'
  template TEXT,
  when_hhmm TEXT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'fired'
)`);
function nowHHMM(){ const d=new Date(); return `${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}`; }
let ticking=false;
async function dispatchTick(){
  try{
    const d = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    const hhmm = nowHHMM();
    const one=(q,a=[])=>new Promise(ok=>db.get(q,a,(_e,r)=>ok(r||null)));
    const flg = await one(`SELECT * FROM reminder_flags WHERE id=1`)||{progress_enabled:1,reflection_enabled:1,study_enabled:0};
    const sch = await one(`SELECT * FROM schedule_regen WHERE d=?`,[d]) || {checkin_hhmm:'21:00',follow_hhmm:'21:05',intensity:55};
    // if it's check-in time → compose template and log
    async function compose(channel){
      return await new Promise(ok=>db.get(
        `SELECT template FROM composed_patterns WHERE channel=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[channel],
        (_e,row)=>ok(row?.template || (channel==='progress' ? 'Progress ping — one line.' : channel==='reflection' ? 'Soft mirror — one feeling.' : 'Study snap — one small step.'))
      ));
    }
    if(hhmm===sch.checkin_hhmm && flg.progress_enabled){
      const t = await compose('progress'); db.run(`INSERT INTO reminders_log(kind,template,when_hhmm) VALUES(?,?,?)`,['progress',t,hhmm]);
    }
    if(hhmm===sch.follow_hhmm && flg.reflection_enabled){
      const t = await compose('reflection'); db.run(`INSERT INTO reminders_log(kind,template,when_hhmm) VALUES(?,?,?)`,['reflection',t,hhmm]);
    }
  }catch(e){ logErr('dispatchTick',e.message,e.stack); }
}
if(!ticking){
  setInterval(dispatchTick, 60*1000); // every minute
  ticking=true;
}
app.get('/api/reminders/fired', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM reminders_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* -------------------- VOICE → TEXT INGESTION -------------------- */
// storage
const VOICE_DIR = path.join(process.cwd(),'voices');
if(!fs.existsSync(VOICE_DIR)) fs.mkdirSync(VOICE_DIR);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_ingest(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  filename TEXT,
  transcript TEXT,
  engine TEXT,       -- 'openai'|'manual'
  status TEXT,       -- 'ok'|'error'
  note TEXT
)`);

// accept raw bytes upload with ?name=voice_xxx.m4a (or .mp3/.wav)
app.post('/api/voice/upload', (req,res)=>{
  const name = asStr((req.query.name||'voice_'+Date.now()+'.m4a'),120).replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]/g,'_');
  const chunks=[];
  req.on('data',d=>chunks.push(d));
  req.on('end',async ()=>{
    try{
      const buf=Buffer.concat(chunks);
      const fp=path.join(VOICE_DIR,name);
      fs.writeFileSync(fp,buf);
      res.json({ok:true, saved:name});
    }catch(e){ logErr('/api/voice/upload',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'save failed'}); }
  });
});

// try transcription with OpenAI Whisper if key present; else expect manual transcript
async function transcribeWithOpenAI(filePath){
  const key=(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY||'').trim();
  if(!key) return {engine:'manual', text:'', note:'No OPENAI_API_KEY; use /api/voice/transcript to attach text.'};
  const data = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath);
  const form = new FormData();
  form.append('file', new Blob([data]), path.basename(filePath));
  form.append('model','whisper-1'); // Whisper API
  const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions',{
    method:'POST',
    headers:{ 'Authorization':'Bearer '+key },
    body:form
  });
  if(!r.ok){ const txt=await r.text(); throw new Error('openai error: '+txt); }
  const js = await r.json();
  return {engine:'openai', text:js.text||''};
}

app.post('/api/voice/transcribe', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const fname = asStr(req.body?.filename,200);
  const fp = path.join(VOICE_DIR, fname);
  try{
    if(!fs.existsSync(fp)) return res.json({ok:false,error:'file not found'});
    let result;
    try{ result = await transcribeWithOpenAI(fp); }
    catch(e){ logErr('/api/voice/transcribe',e.message,e.stack); result={engine:'manual', text:'', note:'OpenAI failed. Use manual transcript.'}; }
    db.run(`INSERT INTO voice_ingest(filename,transcript,engine,status,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,
      [fname, result.text, result.engine, result.text?'ok':'error', result.note||''], ()=>res.json({ok:true, engine:result.engine, text:result.text||'', note:result.note||''}));
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/voice/transcribe',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'transcribe failed'}); }
});

// manual transcript attach
app.post('/api/voice/transcript', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const fname = asStr(req.body?.filename,200);
  const text  = asStr(req.body?.text, 10000);
  db.run(`INSERT INTO voice_ingest(filename,transcript,engine,status,note) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [fname,text,'manual','ok','manual attach'],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

// list recent voice ingests
app.get('/api/voice/recent', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM voice_ingest ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* -------------------- BETTER KEYWORDS (RAKE-lite) + WEIGHTS UI -------------------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS learning_weights(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),
  w_energy REAL DEFAULT 0.35,
  w_valence REAL DEFAULT 0.35,
  w_arousal REAL DEFAULT 0.10,
  w_load REAL DEFAULT 0.20,
  updated TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
)`); db.run(`INSERT OR IGNORE INTO learning_weights(id) VALUES(1)`);

app.get('/api/weights/get', (_req,res)=>{ db.get(`SELECT * FROM learning_weights WHERE id=1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({ok:true, row})); });
app.post('/api/weights/set', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const { w_energy, w_valence, w_arousal, w_load } = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE learning_weights SET
    w_energy=COALESCE(?,w_energy),
    w_valence=COALESCE(?,w_valence),
    w_arousal=COALESCE(?,w_arousal),
    w_load=COALESCE(?,w_load),
    updated=datetime('now') WHERE id=1`,
  [Number(w_energy),Number(w_valence),Number(w_arousal),Number(w_load)], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

// RAKE-lite phrase scorer (very small)
function rakeKeywords(text,max=8){
  const stop = new Set('i me my we our you your he she it they them a an the and or but if so of on in to for with at by is are was were be been have has had do did done can will shall should could would not no very more most much this that from as about into over under again further then once here there when where why how all any both each few other some such nor only own same than too very s t just don don should now'.split(' '));
  const words = text.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  const phrases=[]; let cur=[];
  for(const w of words){ if(stop.has(w)){ if(cur.length) phrases.push(cur),cur=[]; } else cur.push(w); }
  if(cur.length) phrases.push(cur);
  const freq={}, deg={};
  for(const ph of phrases){ const uniq=[...new Set(ph)]; for(const w of uniq){ freq[w]=(freq[w]||0)+1; deg[w]=(deg[w]||0)+ph.length; } }
  const scoreWord={}; for(const w in freq){ scoreWord[w]=(deg[w]||0)/(freq[w]||1); }
  const scorePhrase=phrases.map(ph=>({ph,score:ph.reduce((a,w)=>a+(scoreWord[w]||0),0)}));
  return scorePhrase.sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,max).map(x=>x.ph.join(' '));
}
app.post('/api/keywords/rake', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const text = asStr(req.body?.text, 8000);
  const kws = rakeKeywords(text, 7);
  res.json({ok:true, keywords:kws});
});

/* -------------------- CONSENT BADGES + POLICY + HEALTH -------------------- */
app.get('/api/consent/badges', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT p.id, p.name, COALESCE(k.consent,0) consent, COALESCE(k.public_key,'—') public_key
          FROM partner_graph p LEFT JOIN partner_keys k ON p.id=k.partner_id
          ORDER BY p.id`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
app.get('/policy', (_req,res)=>{
  res.type('text/plain').send(
`AUMNITY Local Policy (short)
- Your data stays on this device unless you export it.
- Pattern sharing requires explicit consent per partner.
- You can back up/restore or delete your data locally.
- No background cloud sync unless you turn it on.`);
});
app.get('/healthz', (_req,res)=>res.json({ok:true, status:'alive'}));
app.get('/version', (_req,res)=>res.json({ok:true, phase:'12', build:new Date().toISOString()}));
```

```html
  vMsg.textContent=js.ok?'attached ✓':'error';
};
```

## 🧩 PHASE 13 – Living Reflection Loop  
**Goal:** turn every voice/text input into a self-learning entry (“What did AUMNITY understand today?”)

### 13.1  Auto-Reflection Composer (server)
Adds a lightweight summariser that reads the day’s voice_ingest + reminders_log and produces a short insight.

```js
// --- Auto-Reflection Composer ---------------------------------
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auto_reflections(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  source TEXT, summary TEXT, keywords TEXT, energy REAL, valence REAL
)`);

async function composeReflection(){
  try{
    const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    db.all(`SELECT transcript FROM voice_ingest WHERE date(ts)=?`,[day],(_e,rows)=>{
      const text = (rows||[]).map(r=>r.transcript).join(' ');
      if(!text) return;
      const keys = rakeKeywords(text,6).join(', ');
      const energy = Math.min(1, text.length/800);   // crude activity proxy
      const valence = (text.match(/\b(grateful|good|happy|calm)\b/gi)||[]).length>0?0.8:0.4;
      const summary = text.slice(0,220)+'…';
      db.run(`INSERT INTO auto_reflections(source,summary,keywords,energy,valence)
              VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)`,['voice',summary,keys,energy,valence]);
    });
  }catch(e){ logErr('composeReflection',e.message,e.stack); }
}
setInterval(composeReflection,60*60*1000); // hourly scan
app.get('/api/reflections/recent',(_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM auto_reflections ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});
```

---

### 13.2  Reminder → Learning Bridge
Each fired reminder now bumps the trust-energy score and saves a “lesson node”.

```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trust_energy(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  channel TEXT, delta REAL, note TEXT
)`);

function adjustTrustEnergy(ch,delta,note){
  db.run(`INSERT INTO trust_energy(channel,delta,note) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[ch,delta,note]);
}

const oldTick = dispatchTick;
dispatchTick = async()=>{ await oldTick();
  const hhmm = nowHHMM();
  if(hhmm.endsWith(':00')) adjustTrustEnergy('reminder',+0.01,'hourly pulse');
};
```

```js
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS value_credits(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
 source TEXT, delta REAL, balance REAL)`);

function creditAction(src,delta){
  db.get(`SELECT balance FROM value_credits ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(_e,row)=>{
    const bal=(row?.balance||0)+delta;
    db.run(`INSERT INTO value_credits(source,delta,balance) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[src,delta,bal]);
  });
}
app.post('/api/credits/add',(req,res)=>{
  const {source,delta}=req.body;
  creditAction(source,parseFloat(delta||0));
  res.json({ok:true});
});
app.get('/api/credits/balance',(_r,res)=>{
  db.get(`SELECT balance FROM value_credits ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[],(_e,row)=>res.json({balance:row?.balance||0}));
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` (paste once, after your existing routes)

> Uses your earlier helpers (`logErr`, `asStr`, `rakeKeywords`, etc.). No extra npm installs needed.

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE-16: Harmony AI (NLP Brain)
   - Sentiment (valence/arousal)   - Topic clustering
   - Adaptive feedback phrasing    - Coach ledger + cache
   - OpenAI mode (if key) or local fallback
   ========================================================== */

const crypto = require('crypto');

/* -------------------- STORAGE -------------------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nlp_cache(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  sig TEXT UNIQUE,              -- hash of input
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  valence REAL, arousal REAL,
  keywords TEXT, topics TEXT, engine TEXT
)`);

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS coach_feedback(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  input_ref TEXT, advice TEXT,
  tone TEXT, confidence REAL,
  engine TEXT, note TEXT
)`);

/* -------------------- UTIL -------------------- */
function hashText(t){ return crypto.createHash('sha1').update(t||'').digest('hex'); }
function clamp01(x){ x=Number(x); return isFinite(x)? Math.max(0,Math.min(1,x)) : 0; }

/* -------------------- LOCAL SENTIMENT -------------------- */
/* Tiny lexicon (extendable). Produces [valence 0..1, arousal 0..1] */
const POS = new Set('grateful calm happy proud love progress ease balanced aligned gentle clear energized bright ok good great joy peaceful confident strong steady relief'.split(' '));
const NEG = new Set('tired anxious stuck angry sad confused overwhelmed pain heavy regret fear worry guilt bored lost stressed irritated'.split(' '));
const BOOST = new Set('very much deeply super extremely absolutely really'.split(' '));

function localSentiment(text){
  const words = (text||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g,' ').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  let pos=0, neg=0, ar=0, lastBoost=false;
  for(const w of words){
    if(BOOST.has(w)) { lastBoost=true; continue; }
    if(POS.has(w)) { pos += lastBoost?2:1; lastBoost=false; }
    if(NEG.has(w)) { neg += lastBoost?2:1; lastBoost=false; }
    if(/!+/.test(w)) ar += 0.2;
  }
  const total = pos+neg || 1;
  const valence = clamp01((pos - neg)/(total) * 0.5 + 0.5);
  const arousal = clamp01(0.2 + 0.1*words.length/50 + ar);
  return { valence, arousal, engine:'local' };
}

/* -------------------- OPENAI SENTIMENT (optional) -------------------- */
async function openaiAnalyze(text){
  const key=(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY||'').trim();
  if(!key) return null;
  try{
    const body = {
      model: "gpt-4o-mini",
      messages: [{role:"system", content:"You score sentiment for well-being tracking."},
                 {role:"user", content:`Text: """${text}"""\nReturn JSON with keys: valence(0..1), arousal(0..1), keywords(array of up to 8 lower-case phrases), topics(array up to 4).`}],
      response_format: { type: "json_object" }
    };
    const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',{
      method:'POST',
      headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });
    if(!r.ok) throw new Error(await r.text());
    const js = await r.json();
    const raw = js.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '{}';
    const out = JSON.parse(raw);
    return {
      valence: clamp01(out.valence ?? 0.5),
      arousal: clamp01(out.arousal ?? 0.5),
      keywords: Array.isArray(out.keywords)? out.keywords : [],
      topics: Array.isArray(out.topics)? out.topics : [],
      engine: 'openai'
    };
  }catch(e){ logErr('openaiAnalyze', e.message, e.stack); return null; }
}

/* -------------------- NLP ANALYZE CORE -------------------- */
async function nlpAnalyze(text){
  const t = asStr(text, 8000);
  const sig = hashText(t);
  const cached = await new Promise(ok=>db.get(`SELECT * FROM nlp_cache WHERE sig=?`,[sig],(_e,row)=>ok(row)));
  if(cached) {
    return {
      valence: cached.valence, arousal: cached.arousal,
      keywords: (cached.keywords||'').split('|').filter(Boolean),
      topics: (cached.topics||'').split('|').filter(Boolean),
      engine: cached.engine||'cache'
    };
  }
  // Try OpenAI first, fallback to local
  let res = await openaiAnalyze(t);
  if(!res){
    const local = localSentiment(t);
    const kws = rakeKeywords(t,7);
    // naive 'topics' = top-3 keywords split
    const topics = kws.slice(0,3);
    res = { valence: local.valence, arousal: local.arousal, keywords: kws, topics, engine:'local' };
  }
  await new Promise(ok=>db.run(`INSERT INTO nlp_cache(sig,valence,arousal,keywords,topics,engine) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [sig,res.valence,res.arousal,(res.keywords||[]).join('|'),(res.topics||[]).join('|'),res.engine],()=>ok()));
  return res;
}

/* -------------------- COACH (adaptive phrasing) -------------------- */
function coachPhrase({valence, arousal, topics=[]}){
  const t = topics[0] || 'today';
  let tone='calm';
  let advice='';
  // quadrant logic
  if(valence>=0.6 && arousal<=0.5){
    tone='steady';
    advice=`Great stability around ${t}. Lock a tiny win in 3 mins: one note in 📊 Progress.`
  }else if(valence>=0.6 && arousal>0.5){
    tone='bright';
    advice=`Energy is up — channel it. Pick one step on ${t}, then pause 60s for gratitude.`;
  }else if(valence<0.6 && arousal>0.5){
    tone='soothe';
    advice=`High charge detected. 90-second breath, then write one honest line about ${t}.`;
  }else{
    tone='gentle';
    advice=`Low tide is okay. Choose the lightest action on ${t} (≤2 mins) and mark it DONE.`;
  }
  const confidence = 0.6 + 0.2*Math.abs(valence-0.5) + 0.2*Math.abs(arousal-0.5);
  return { tone, advice, confidence: clamp01(confidence) };
}

/* -------------------- ENDPOINTS -------------------- */
// Analyze a blob of text
app.post('/api/nlp/analyze', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const text = asStr(req.body?.text, 8000);
    if(!text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'text required'});
    const r = await nlpAnalyze(text);
    return res.json({ok:true, ...r});
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/nlp/analyze',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'analyze failed'}); }
});

// Coach from provided text
app.post('/api/coach/reply', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const text = asStr(req.body?.text, 8000);
    if(!text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'text required'});
    const r = await nlpAnalyze(text);
    const c = coachPhrase(r);
    db.run(`INSERT INTO coach_feedback(input_ref,advice,tone,confidence,engine,note)
            VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
           ['inline', c.advice, c.tone, c.confidence, r.engine, (r.topics||[]).join(', ')],
           ()=>res.json({ok:true, analysis:r, coach:c}));
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/coach/reply',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'coach failed'}); }
});

// Coach from today's voice transcripts
app.post('/api/coach/from-today', async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    db.all(`SELECT transcript FROM voice_ingest WHERE date(ts)=? AND length(transcript)>0`,[day], async (_e,rows)=>{
      const text = (rows||[]).map(r=>r.transcript).join('\n');
      if(!text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no transcripts today'});
      const r = await nlpAnalyze(text);
      const c = coachPhrase(r);
      db.run(`INSERT INTO coach_feedback(input_ref,advice,tone,confidence,engine,note)
              VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
             ['voice_today', c.advice, c.tone, c.confidence, r.engine, (r.topics||[]).join(', ')],
             ()=>res.json({ok:true, analysis:r, coach:c}));
    });
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/coach/from-today',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'coach today failed'}); }
});

// List recent coach entries
app.get('/api/coach/recent', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM coach_feedback ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true, rows:rows||[]}));
});
```

## 25) Deep Memory Engine (semantic recall across sessions)

### 25.1 Server: vector memory with OpenAI (if key) or local tf-idf fallback
```js
/* ========= Phase 25: Deep Memory ========= */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mem_chunks(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
 origin TEXT,             -- 'voice'|'coach'|'progress'|'manual'
 text TEXT,
 emb BLOB,                -- Float32Array as Buffer (when available)
 meta TEXT
)`);
function f32(buf){ return new Float32Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.byteLength/4); }

async function embedText(txt){
  const key=(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY||'').trim();
  if(key){
    try{
      const r = await fetch('https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings',{
        method:'POST',
        headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'},
        body:JSON.stringify({model:'text-embedding-3-small',input:txt})
      });
      const js=await r.json();
      const v = js.data?.[0]?.embedding||[];
      const arr=new Float32Array(v); return Buffer.from(arr.buffer);
    }catch(e){ logErr('embedText',e.message,e.stack); }
  }
  // Local fallback: crude tf-idf sparse hash -> turn into fixed 256-dim
  const words = (txt.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]+/g)||[]);
  const vec = new Float32Array(256);
  for(const w of words){ let h=0; for(let i=0;i<w.length;i++) h=(h*131 + w.charCodeAt(i))>>>0; vec[h%256]+=1; }
  // L2 normalize
  let s=0; for(const x of vec) s+=x*x; s=Math.sqrt(s||1); for(let i=0;i<vec.length;i++) vec[i]/=s;
  return Buffer.from(vec.buffer);
}
function cosSim(bufA, bufB){
  const a=f32(bufA), b=f32(bufB); const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length); let s=0;
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++) s+=a[i]*b[i];
  return s;
}

app.post('/api/memory/remember', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const txt=asStr(req.body?.text, 4000); const origin=asStr(req.body?.origin||'manual',24); const meta=asStr(req.body?.meta||'',512);
  if(!txt) return res.json({ok:false,error:'text required'});
  const emb = await embedText(txt);
  db.run(`INSERT INTO mem_chunks(origin,text,emb,meta) VALUES(?,?,?,?)`,[origin,txt,emb,meta],()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});

app.post('/api/memory/search', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const q=asStr(req.body?.q,1000); const top= Number(req.body?.top||5);
  if(!q) return res.json({ok:false,error:'q required'});
  const qemb = await embedText(q);
  db.all(`SELECT id,ts,origin,text,emb,meta FROM mem_chunks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1000`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    const scored = (rows||[]).map(r=>({id:r.id, ts:r.ts, origin:r.origin, text:r.text, meta:r.meta, score: cosSim(qemb, r.emb)}))
                             .sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,top);
    res.json({ok:true, results:scored});
  });
});
```

## 26) Real-Time Voice Sister Co-presence (SSE “live” stream + quick join)

### 26.1 Server: SSE stream + lightweight message bus
```js
/* ========= Phase 26: Co-presence (SSE) ========= */
const SSE_CLIENTS = new Set();
app.get('/sse/stream',(req,res)=>{
  res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':'text/event-stream','Cache-Control':'no-cache','Connection':'keep-alive'});
  res.write('retry: 3000\n\n'); SSE_CLIENTS.add(res);
  req.on('close',()=>SSE_CLIENTS.delete(res));
});
function sseBroadcast(ev,payload){ const msg=`event: ${ev}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(payload)}\n\n`; for(const c of SSE_CLIENTS) c.write(msg); }

app.post('/sse/note', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {from,text}=req.body||{};
  if(text) sseBroadcast('note',{from:from||'partner',text,ts:Date.now()});
  res.json({ok:true});
});
```

## 27) Token & Payout Bridge (credits → payouts ledger)

### 27.1 Server: wallet, payout requests, and a manual settle hook
```js
/* ========= Phase 27: Token & Payout ========= */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wallet(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 user TEXT, balance REAL DEFAULT 0
)`);
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS payout_req(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 user TEXT, amount REAL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending'
)`);

app.post('/api/wallet/credit', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {user,amount}=req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO wallet(user,balance) VALUES(?,?)
         ON CONFLICT(user) DO UPDATE SET balance=balance+excluded.balance`,
         [user, Number(amount||0)], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.post('/api/payout/request', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {user,amount}=req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO payout_req(user,amount) VALUES(?,?)`,[user,Number(amount||0)], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.post('/api/payout/settle', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {id,approved}=req.body||{};
  db.get(`SELECT user,amount FROM payout_req WHERE id=?`,[id],(_e,row)=>{
    if(!row) return res.json({ok:false,error:'not found'});
    if(approved){
      db.run(`UPDATE wallet SET balance=balance-? WHERE user=?`,[row.amount,row.user]);
      db.run(`UPDATE payout_req SET status='paid' WHERE id=?`,[id]);
    }else{
      db.run(`UPDATE payout_req SET status='rejected' WHERE id=?`,[id]);
    }
    res.json({ok:true});
  });
});
```

```js
self.addEventListener('activate',e=>clients.claim());

  `);
});
```

# 🧩 Add to `server.js` (paste once; safe with your earlier helpers)

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASES 31–40  (Sensory Expansion + Maturity Series)
   Uses existing helpers: db, logErr, asStr, rakeKeywords, embedText, etc.
   ========================================================== */

/* ---------- Phase 31: Emotion Loop Integration ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS emotion_log(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 source TEXT, valence REAL, arousal REAL
)`);
function logEmotion(source,val,aro){
  db.run(`INSERT INTO emotion_log(source,valence,arousal) VALUES(?,?,?)`,
         [source, Number(val||0.5), Number(aro||0.5)]);
}
app.post('/api/emotion/log', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {source='text', valence=0.5, arousal=0.5} = req.body||{};
  logEmotion(source,valence,arousal);
  res.json({ok:true});
});
app.get('/api/emotion/today', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT ts,valence,arousal FROM emotion_log
          WHERE date(ts)=date('now') ORDER BY id ASC`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows:rows||[]}));
});

/* Hook into Phase-16 coach to also store emotion */
const _coach_old = app._router.stack.find(l => String(l.route?.path||'').includes('/api/coach/reply'));
/* If patching is complex in your file, ensure wherever you compute val/arousal,
   call: logEmotion('coach', analysis.valence, analysis.arousal); */

/* ---------- Phase 32: Attention Flow Map (keyword stream) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attention_flow(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 keyword TEXT, weight REAL
)`);
function indexKeywords(text){
  const kws = rakeKeywords(asStr(text,4000), 8);
  kws.forEach((k,i)=> db.run(
    `INSERT INTO attention_flow(keyword,weight) VALUES(?,?)`,[k,(8-i)/8]));
}
app.post('/api/attention/add', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  indexKeywords(req.body?.text||'');
  res.json({ok:true});
});
app.get('/api/attention/top', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT keyword, SUM(weight) w FROM attention_flow
          WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-7 days')
          GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 15`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});

/* ---------- Phase 33: Harmony AI 2.0 (tone-mirror coaching) ---------- */
function phrasingFor(val,aro){
  if(val>=0.6 && aro<=0.5) return {style:'steady', pre:'You’re steady today. ', post:' Lock one tiny win.'};
  if(val>=0.6 && aro>0.5)  return {style:'bright', pre:'Energy’s high. ', post:' Channel it into one focused step.'};
  if(val<0.6 && aro>0.5)   return {style:'soothe', pre:'Charge is high. ', post:' 90-sec breath, then move lightly.'};
  return {style:'gentle', pre:'Low tide is okay. ', post:' Choose the smallest action and mark DONE.'};
}
app.post('/api/coach/reflective', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const text = asStr(req.body?.text, 4000);
  if(!text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'text required'});
  const a = await nlpAnalyze(text);
  const tone = phrasingFor(a.valence,a.arousal);
  const c = coachPhrase(a);
  const advice = tone.pre + c.advice + ' ' + tone.post;
  logEmotion('coach2', a.valence, a.arousal);
  res.json({ok:true, analysis:a, tone, advice});
});

/* ---------- Phase 34: Resonance Mesh (partner similarity) ---------- */
function vectorAvg(rows){
  if(!rows?.length) return [0.5,0.5];
  const v=rows.reduce((s,r)=>[s[0]+(+r.valence||0.5), s[1]+(+r.arousal||0.5)], [0,0]);
  return [v[0]/rows.length, v[1]/rows.length];
}
function cos(a,b){ const da=a[0]-0.5, db=b[0]-0.5, ea=a[1]-0.5, eb=b[1]-0.5;
  const num = da*db + ea*eb; const den = Math.sqrt((da*da+ea*ea)*(db*db+eb*eb))||1; return num/den;
}
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS partner_emotion(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 partner TEXT, valence REAL, arousal REAL
)`);
app.post('/api/resonance/push', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {partner='peer', valence=0.5, arousal=0.5} = req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO partner_emotion(partner,valence,arousal) VALUES(?,?,?)`,
         [partner, valence, arousal], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.get('/api/resonance/check', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT valence,arousal FROM emotion_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-1 day')`,[],(_e,me)=>{
    db.all(`SELECT partner, AVG(valence) v, AVG(arousal) a
            FROM partner_emotion WHERE ts>=datetime('now','-1 day')
            GROUP BY partner`,[],(_e2,peers)=>{
      const mine = vectorAvg(me);
      const out = (peers||[]).map(p=>({partner:p.partner, sim: +cos(mine,[p.v,p.a]).toFixed(3)}))
                             .sort((A,B)=>B.sim-A.sim);
      res.json({ok:true, mine:{val:mine[0],aro:mine[1]}, peers:out});
    });
  });
});

/* ---------- Phase 35: AR/Spatial stub (serves a tiny A-Frame scene) ---------- */
app.get('/aum_space.html', (_req,res)=>{
  res.type('html').send(`<!doctype html><html><head>
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <script src="https://aframe.io/releases/1.5.0/aframe.min.js"></script>
  <style>body{margin:0}</style></head><body>
  <a-scene>
    <a-entity position="0 1.6 0"></a-entity>
    <a-sky color="#0f172a"></a-sky>
    <a-light type="ambient" intensity="1.0"></a-light>
    <a-sphere id="val" position="-1 1.2 -3" radius="0.7" color="#88ccff"></a-sphere>
    <a-sphere id="aro" position="1 1.2 -3" radius="0.7" color="#ff8888"></a-sphere>
    <a-plane position="0 0 -3" rotation="-90 0 0" width="6" height="6" color="#111"></a-plane>
  </a-scene>
  <script>
  async function tick(){
    const j = await (await fetch('/api/emotion/today')).json();
    const rows = j.rows||[];
    let v=0.5,a=0.5; if(rows.length){ v=rows.at(-1).valence||0.5; a=rows.at(-1).arousal||0.5; }
    const val=document.getElementById('val'), aro=document.getElementById('aro');
    val.setAttribute('scale', {x:1+v, y:1+v, z:1+v});
    aro.setAttribute('scale', {x:1+a, y:1+a, z:1+a});
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  } tick();
  </script></body></html>`);
});

/* ---------- Phase 36: Self-Healing Loops (burnout guard) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS heal_events(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 kind TEXT, detail TEXT
)`);
const HEAL_WINDOW_M = 180;    // lookback minutes
const HEAL_MIN_VAL = 0.45;    // low mood threshold
const HEAL_MIN_DONE = 0;      // done count threshold
app.get('/api/heal/scan', async (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT valence FROM emotion_log WHERE ts>=datetime('now',?)`,
         [`-${HEAL_WINDOW_M} minutes`], (_e,rows)=>{
    const avg = rows.length? rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+(+r.valence||0.5),0)/rows.length : 0.5;
    const need = avg<HEAL_MIN_VAL;
    if(need) db.run(`INSERT INTO heal_events(kind,detail) VALUES('rest','low_valence_detected')`);
    res.json({ok:true, avg_valence: +avg.toFixed(3), action: need?'REST_PROMPT':'OK'});
  });
});

/* ---------- Phase 37: Dream Graph (aspiration memory) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dream_nodes(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 tag TEXT, text TEXT
)`);
app.post('/api/dream/add', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {tag='life', text=''} = req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO dream_nodes(tag,text) VALUES(?,?)`,[asStr(tag,40),asStr(text,800)], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.get('/api/dream/list', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM dream_nodes ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});

/* ---------- Phase 38: Micro-BPO & Payout link ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bpo_tasks(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 owner TEXT, title TEXT, reward REAL, status TEXT DEFAULT 'open'
)`);
app.post('/api/bpo/new', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {owner='you',title='task',reward=1} = req.body||{};
  db.run(`INSERT INTO bpo_tasks(owner,title,reward) VALUES(?,?,?)`,
         [asStr(owner,64),asStr(title,200),Number(reward)], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
});
app.post('/api/bpo/claim', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {id,user='partner'} = req.body||{};
  db.run(`UPDATE bpo_tasks SET status='done' WHERE id=?`,[id], ()=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO wallet(user,balance) VALUES(?,?)
           ON CONFLICT(user) DO UPDATE SET balance=balance + (SELECT reward FROM bpo_tasks WHERE id=${+id})`,
           [asStr(user,64),0], ()=>res.json({ok:true}));
  });
});
app.get('/api/bpo/list', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM bpo_tasks ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});

/* ---------- Phase 39: AI-Human Curriculum (auto path) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS curriculum(
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
 topic TEXT, next_step TEXT, reason TEXT
)`);
app.post('/api/curriculum/auto', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  const text = asStr(req.body?.text||'', 2000);
  const a = await nlpAnalyze(text);
  const k = (a.topics||[])[0] || 'focus';
  let step='Write one paragraph summary.'; let reason='Consolidate understanding.';
  if(k.includes('voice')) { step='Record 60-sec reflection.'; reason='Bridge emotion ↔ memory.'; }
  if(k.includes('python')||k.includes('code')) { step='Solve one small exercise.'; reason='Skill by practice.'; }
  if(k.includes('money')||k.includes('credit')) { step='Plan one 20-min earning micro-task.'; reason='Reduce pressure.'; }
  db.run(`INSERT INTO curriculum(topic,next_step,reason) VALUES(?,?,?)`,[k,step,reason],
    ()=>res.json({ok:true, topic:k, next_step:step, reason}));
});
app.get('/api/curriculum/recent', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT * FROM curriculum ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20`,[],(_e,rows)=>res.json({ok:true,rows}));
});

/* ---------- Phase 40: Governance DAO v2 (quorum & expiry) ---------- */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gov_params(
 key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, val TEXT
)`);
function setParam(k,v){ db.run(`INSERT INTO gov_params(key,val) VALUES(?,?)
  ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET val=excluded.val`,[k,String(v)]); }
setParam('quorum','3'); setParam('expiry_days','14');

app.post('/api/gov/close', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {pid}=req.body||{};
  db.get(`SELECT val FROM gov_params WHERE key='quorum'`,[],(_e,qrow)=>{
    const quorum = +qrow?.val||3;
    db.get(`SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN choice='yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) y
            FROM votes WHERE pid=?`,[pid],(_e2,row)=>{
      const passed = (row?.n||0) >= quorum && (row?.y||0) > ((row?.n||0)/2);
      db.run(`UPDATE proposals SET status=? WHERE id=?`,[passed?'passed':'failed',pid],
        ()=>res.json({ok:true, quorum, votes:row, status: passed?'passed':'failed'}));
    });
  });
});
app.get('/api/gov/expire', (_r,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT id, ts FROM proposals WHERE status='open'`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    const exp = +(rows||[]).filter(r=>{
      const age = (Date.now()-new Date(r.ts)) / (1000*3600*24);
      return age > (+process.env.GOV_EXPIRY_DAYS||14);
    }).map(r=>r.id).length;
    res.json({ok:true, checked: rows?.length||0, expired: exp});
  });
});
```

# 🔧 Add to `server.js` (click-copy)

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE 41 — Unified Conscious Core (State Vector)
   Depends on tables created earlier:
   - emotion_log(ts, source, valence, arousal)
   - attention_flow(ts, keyword, weight)
   - actions_log(ts, ref_type, ref_id, note, credit)
   - adapt_weights(hour, type, success, fail)   [optional]
   - wallet(user, balance)                      [optional]
   ========================================================== */

/* 41.0 Parameters (editable at runtime) */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS state_params(
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  val TEXT
)`);
function setSParam(k,v){ db.run(
  `INSERT INTO state_params(key,val) VALUES(?,?)
   ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET val=excluded.val`, [k,String(v)]
);}
/* sensible defaults */
setSParam('win_hours','6');         // how many hours for "now" window
setSParam('w_valence','0.30');      // weights for readiness index
setSParam('w_arousal','0.10');
setSParam('w_focus','0.20');
setSParam('w_engage','0.25');
setSParam('w_stability','0.10');
setSParam('w_energy','0.05');       // wallet/energy proxy (optional)

/* helper to read params */
function getParams(cb){
  db.all(`SELECT key,val FROM state_params`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    const m=new Map(rows.map(r=>[r.key,r.val]));
    const P={
      WIN_HOURS: +(m.get('win_hours')||6),
      W: {
        valence:  +(m.get('w_valence')||0.30),
        arousal:  +(m.get('w_arousal')||0.10),
        focus:    +(m.get('w_focus')||0.20),
        engage:   +(m.get('w_engage')||0.25),
        stability:+(m.get('w_stability')||0.10),
        energy:   +(m.get('w_energy')||0.05),
      }
    };
    cb(P);
  });
}

/* 41.1 Compute the state vector for the last WIN_HOURS */
function clamp01(x){ return x<0?0:x>1?1:x; }
function z01(x,lo,hi){ if(hi<=lo) return 0.5; const t=(x-lo)/(hi-lo); return clamp01(t); }

app.get('/api/state/now', (_req,res)=>{
  getParams(P=>{
    const winMins = P.WIN_HOURS*60;

    // A) Emotion (valence/arousal) + stability (variance inverse)
    db.all(`SELECT strftime('%s',ts) s, valence, arousal
            FROM emotion_log WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)`,
      [`-${winMins} minutes`],
      (_e,rowsE)=>{
        let vAvg=0.5,aAvg=0.5,stab=0.5, vVar=0;
        if(rowsE?.length){
          const V = rowsE.map(r=>+r.valence||0.5);
          const A = rowsE.map(r=>+r.arousal||0.5);
          vAvg = V.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/V.length;
          aAvg = A.reduce((s,x)=>s+x,0)/A.length;
          const vm = vAvg; vVar = V.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x-vm)*(x-vm),0)/(V.length||1);
          // stability high when variance low
          stab = clamp01(1 - (vVar/0.05)); // 0.05 ~ “high wobble”
        }

        // B) Attention focus (concentration of top keywords)
        db.all(`SELECT keyword, SUM(weight) w FROM attention_flow
                WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)
                GROUP BY keyword ORDER BY w DESC LIMIT 5`,
          [`-${winMins} minutes`],
          (_e2,rowsK)=>{
            const totalW = (rowsK||[]).reduce((s,r)=>s+(+r.w||0),0) || 1;
            const topW   = (rowsK?.[0]?.w||0);
            // focus = how concentrated attention is on one theme (0..1)
            const focus = clamp01(topW/totalW);

            // C) Engagement (DONE rate) — count DONE in window vs baseline
            db.all(`SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM actions_log
                    WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?) AND note LIKE '%DONE%'`,
              [`-${winMins} minutes`],
              (_e3,rowD)=>{
                const doneN = +(rowD?.[0]?.n||0);
                // normalize by window size: assume 1–5 DONEs per 6h is healthy
                const engage = clamp01(doneN / Math.max(1, P.WIN_HOURS)); // ~1 per hr → 1.0

                // D) Energy proxy (wallet balance scaled 0..1) [optional]
                db.get(`SELECT SUM(balance) bal FROM wallet`,[],(_e4,WAL)=>{
                  const bal = +(WAL?.bal||0);
                  const energy = z01(bal, 0, 50); // scale 0..50 credits → 0..1

                  // E) Compose readiness
                  const R = P.W;
                  const readiness =
                    clamp01(
                      vAvg*R.valence +
                      (1-Math.abs(aAvg-0.5)*2)*R.arousal + // calmer → higher
                      focus*R.focus +
                      engage*R.engage +
                      stab*R.stability +
                      energy*R.energy
                    );

                  // mood label
                  let mood = 'neutral';
                  if(readiness>=0.8) mood='flow';
                  else if(readiness>=0.65) mood='ready';
                  else if(readiness<=0.35) mood='tired';
                  else if(vAvg<0.45 && aAvg>0.6) mood='stressed';

                  res.json({
                    ok:true,
                    window_hours:P.WIN_HOURS,
                    emotion:{valence:+vAvg.toFixed(3), arousal:+aAvg.toFixed(3), stability:+stab.toFixed(3)},
                    attention:{focus:+focus.toFixed(3), top:(rowsK||[]).map(r=>r.keyword)},
                    action:{done_in_window:doneN, engage:+engage.toFixed(3)},
                    energy:+energy.toFixed(3),
                    readiness:+readiness.toFixed(3),
                    mood
                  });
                });
              });
          });
      });
  });
});

/* 41.2 Daily snapshot (for charts/history) */
db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS state_snapshot(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  day TEXT, readiness REAL, valence REAL, arousal REAL, focus REAL, engage REAL, stability REAL, energy REAL
)`);
app.post('/api/state/snapshot', (_req,res)=>{
  getParams(P=>{
    // compute now, then store under today's date
    fetch('http://localhost:'+ (process.env.PORT||8080) +'/api/state/now')
      .then(r=>r.json()).then(j=>{
        const d = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
        db.run(`INSERT INTO state_snapshot(day,readiness,valence,arousal,focus,engage,stability,energy)
                VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
          [d, j.readiness, j.emotion?.valence, j.emotion?.arousal, j.attention?.focus, j.action?.engage, j.emotion?.stability, j.energy],
          ()=>res.json({ok:true, stored:d, readiness:j.readiness}));
      }).catch(_=>res.json({ok:false,error:'snapshot failed'}));
  });
});

/* 41.3 Tune weights / window at runtime */
app.post('/api/state/tune', express.json(), (req,res)=>{
  const {win_hours, weights} = req.body||{};
  if(win_hours) setSParam('win_hours', String(win_hours));
  if(weights && typeof weights==='object'){
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(weights)){
      setSParam(`w_${k}`, String(v));
    }
  }
  res.json({ok:true});
});
```

# 🔧 Add to `server.js`

```js
/* ==========================================================
   PHASE 42 — Voice ↔ Text ↔ Visual Fusion
   Depends on: nlpAnalyze(text) → {valence, arousal, topics[]}
   Optional: voice_ingest(ts, transcript) from earlier phases
   ========================================================== */

db.run(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion_log(
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  ts TEXT DEFAULT(datetime('now')),
  source TEXT,                 -- 'text' | 'voice'
  text   TEXT,
  valence REAL, arousal REAL,
  keywords TEXT,               -- JSON array
  scene    TEXT                -- JSON spec we render on the client
)`);

function hueFromValAro(v,a){
  // v (0..1): 0=negative(red 0°), 1=positive(160° teal/green)
  // a (0..1): sets lightness
  const h = Math.round(160*v);               // 0..160
  const l = Math.round(40 + 30*(1-a));       // 70→ calm, 40→ high arousal darker
  const s = 70;
  return `hsl(${h} ${s}% ${l}%)`;
}

function makeSceneSpec(text, val, aro, kws){
  // central mood orb + keyword satellites
  const center = { x: 400, y: 170, r: 60 + Math.round(aro*40), color: hueFromValAro(val, aro) };
  const nodes = [];
  const R = 110 + Math.round(aro*70);
  const N = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, kws.length));
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const t = (i/N)*Math.PI*2;
    const x = center.x + Math.cos(t)*R;
    const y = center.y + Math.sin(t)*R;
    const r = 18 + Math.round((1 - i/N)*10);
    nodes.push({label:kws[i], x, y, r, color:hueFromValAro(Math.max(0.05, val - 0.15 + i*0.02), aro)});
  }
  return { w:800, h:340, center, nodes };
}

async function fuseFrom(text, source){
  const a = await nlpAnalyze(text||'');
  const kws = (a.topics||[]).slice(0,8);
  const scene = makeSceneSpec(text, a.valence||0.5, a.arousal||0.5, kws);
  return new Promise(ok=>{
    db.run(`INSERT INTO fusion_log(source,text,valence,arousal,keywords,scene)
            VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
      [source, text, a.valence, a.arousal, JSON.stringify(kws), JSON.stringify(scene)],
      function(){ ok({id:this.lastID, analysis:a, scene, keywords:kws}); });
  });
}

/* 42.1 Fuse arbitrary text → scene */
app.post('/api/fusion/from-text', express.json(), async (req,res)=>{
  try{
    const text = asStr(req.body?.text, 8000);
    if(!text) return res.json({ok:false,error:'text required'});
    const out = await fuseFrom(text, 'text');
    res.json({ok:true, ...out});
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/fusion/from-text',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'fusion failed'}); }
});

/* 42.2 Fuse latest voice transcript → scene */
app.get('/api/fusion/from-voice-latest', async (_req,res)=>{
  try{
    db.get(`SELECT transcript FROM voice_ingest WHERE length(transcript)>0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1`,[], async (_e,row)=>{
      if(!row) return res.json({ok:false,error:'no voice transcript found'});
      const out = await fuseFrom(asStr(row.transcript,8000), 'voice');
      res.json({ok:true, ...out});
    });
  }catch(e){ logErr('/api/fusion/from-voice-latest',e.message,e.stack); res.json({ok:false,error:'fusion failed'}); }
});

/* 42.3 Recent fusions list */
app.get('/api/fusion/recent', (_req,res)=>{
  db.all(`SELECT id,ts,source,valence,arousal,keywords FROM fusion_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10`,[],(_e,rows)=>{
    res.json({ok:true, rows: (rows||[]).map(r=>({...r, keywords: JSON.parse(r.keywords||'[]')}))});
  });
});

/* 42.4 Retrieve one scene spec by id */
app.get('/api/fusion/scene', (req,res)=>{
  const id = +req.query.id;
  db.get(`SELECT scene FROM fusion_log WHERE id=?`,[id],(_e,row)=>{
    if(!row) return res.json({ok:false,error:'not found'});
    res.json({ok:true, scene: JSON.parse(row.scene||'{}')});
  });
});
```
