# 2️⃣ Front-end – AUMNITY Console v0.6 (Ear + Nerve)

Now we build the **console UI** that:

- Has the **Ear** (voice entries: file + transcript)  
- Talks to your Node server via `/api/state`  
- Shows a simple **Eye chart** over last 14 days  

### Step 1: Create `console.html`

In the same folder (`aumnity-console`), create a file called `console.html` and paste this:

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>AUMNITY Console v0.6 – Heart • Mind • Ear • Eye</title>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
  <style>
    body {
      margin:0; font-family:Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif;
      background:#0b0c10; color:#e0e0e0;
      display:grid; grid-template-rows:60px 1fr 40px; height:100vh;
    }
    header {
      background:#111; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
      padding:0 1rem; font-size:1.05rem; border-bottom:1px solid #222;
    }
    main {
      display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
      grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr); gap:0.75rem; padding:0.75rem;
    }
    section {
      background:#151515; border-radius:12px; padding:0.75rem;
      box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,0.1);
      display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    }
    section h2 {margin:0 0 0.4rem 0; font-size:1rem; color:#ffd700;}
    footer {text-align:center; font-size:0.8rem; color:#888;}
    textarea, input, select {
      background:#111; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;
      color:#e0e0e0; width:100%; padding:0.4rem;
      font-family:inherit; font-size:0.9rem;
    }
    textarea {resize:none;}
    button {
      background:#ffd700; border:none; border-radius:6px;
      padding:0.3rem 0.6rem; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; color:#111;
      align-self:flex-end; margin-top:0.4rem;
    }
    button:disabled {opacity:0.6; cursor:not-allowed;}
    .status-dot {display:inline-block; width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; margin-right:4px;}
    .on {background:#4caf50;} .off {background:#f44336;}
    canvas {background:#111; border-radius:8px; padding:0.25rem;}
    ul {margin:0.25rem 0 0 0; padding-left:1rem; font-size:0.8rem; max-height:4.5rem; overflow:auto;}
    li {margin-bottom:0.1rem;}
    small {color:#aaa; font-size:0.75rem;}
    .row {display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem;}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header>
    <div>🌐 AUMNITY Console v0.6</div>
    <div>🕒 <span id="clock"></span> • <span id="syncStatus">⏳ loading…</span></div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <!-- Heart -->
    <section id="heart">
      <h2>💗 Heart – Reminders</h2>
      <p>9–12 PM cycle:
        <span class="status-dot" id="remDot"></span>
        <span id="reminderStatus"></span>
      </p>
      <button id="toggleReminderBtn">Toggle</button>
      <small>Controls whether daily check-in is “active” for today.</small>
    </section>

    <!-- Mind -->
    <section id="mind">
      <h2>🧠 Mind – Reflections</h2>
      <textarea id="reflectionText" rows="3"
        placeholder="Add today’s reflection..."></textarea>
      <button id="saveReflectionBtn">Save Reflection</button>
      <small id="lastReflectionInfo">No reflections yet.</small>
    </section>

    <!-- Ear (Voice) -->
    <section id="ear">
      <h2>👂 Ear – Voice Entries</h2>
      <div class="row">
        <input type="file" id="audioInput" accept="audio/*" />
        <input type="text" id="voiceTitle" placeholder="Short title (e.g., walk insight)" />
      </div>
      <textarea id="voiceTranscript" rows="2"
        placeholder="Paste or type transcript / key lines..."></textarea>
      <button id="saveVoiceBtn">Save Voice Entry</button>
      <small>Recent voice entries:</small>
      <ul id="voiceList"></ul>
    </section>

    <!-- Memory -->
    <section id="memory">
      <h2>💾 Memory – Pulse</h2>
      <p id="memoryStats">Entries: 0 • Voice: 0</p>
      <button id="exportBtn">Export JSON Snapshot</button>
      <small>Exports everything the console knows into one JSON file.</small>
    </section>

    <!-- Config -->
    <section id="config">
      <h2>⚙️ Config – Mood & Threshold</h2>
      <div class="row">
        <label for="moodSelect">Today’s mood</label>
        <select id="moodSelect">
          <option value="">(not set)</option>
          <option value="good">🙂 Good</option>
          <option value="neutral">😐 Neutral</option>
          <option value="low">☹️ Low</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="row" style="margin-top:0.3rem;">
        <label for="thresholdInput">Habit threshold %</label>
        <input type="number" id="thresholdInput" min="0" max="100" />
      </div>
      <button id="updateConfigBtn">Save Config & Mood</button>
      <small id="moodSummary">Mood entries: 0</small>
    </section>

    <!-- Eye -->
    <section id="eye">
      <h2>👁️ Eye – Last 14 Days</h2>
      <canvas id="eyeChart"></canvas>
      <small>Bars = days you reflected. Color = average mood that day.</small>
    </section>
  </main>

  <footer>© 2025 AUMNITY • Prototype (Heart • Mind • Ear • Eye)</footer>

  <script>
    // --- Live clock ---
    setInterval(() => {
      document.getElementById("clock").textContent =
        new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    }, 1000);

    // --- State & backend link ---
    const API_BASE = "http://localhost:4000/api";
    const DEFAULT_STATE = {
      remindersActive: true,
      threshold: 70,
      reflections: [],
      harmonyNotes: [],
      moodLog: [],
      voiceEntries: []
    };
    let state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
    let chart;

    function setSyncStatus(text, ok = true) {
      const el = document.getElementById("syncStatus");
      el.textContent = text;
      el.style.color = ok ? "#a5d6a7" : "#ff8a80";
    }

    function todayISO() {
      return new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
    }

    function saveToServer() {
      setSyncStatus("⬆ saving...", true);
      return fetch(API_BASE + "/state", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        body: JSON.stringify(state)
      })
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(() => setSyncStatus("✔ synced", true))
      .catch(() => setSyncStatus("⚠ offline (using last state)", false));
    }

    function loadFromServer() {
      setSyncStatus("⏳ loading...", true);
      return fetch(API_BASE + "/state")
        .then(res => res.json())
        .then(data => {
          state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE, ...data };
          setSyncStatus("✔ loaded", true);
          render();
        })
        .catch(() => {
          setSyncStatus("⚠ cannot reach server", false);
          state = { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
          render();
        });
    }

    // --- Chart (Eye) ---
    function renderChart() {
      const ctx = document.getElementById("eyeChart").getContext("2d");
      const today = new Date();
      const labels = [];
      const data = [];
      const colors = [];

      for (let i = 13; i >= 0; i--) {
        const d = new Date(today);
        d.setDate(today.getDate() - i);
        const ds = d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
        labels.push(ds.slice(5)); // MM-DD

        const reflected = state.reflections.some(r => r.date === ds) ? 1 : 0;
        data.push(reflected);

        const moodEntry = state.moodLog.find(m => m.date === ds);
        if (!moodEntry) {
          colors.push("#555");
        } else if (moodEntry.mood === "good") {
          colors.push("#4caf50");
        } else if (moodEntry.mood === "neutral") {
          colors.push("#ffd700");
        } else {
          colors.push("#f44336");
        }
      }

      if (chart) chart.destroy();
      chart = new Chart(ctx, {
        type: "bar",
        data: {
          labels,
          datasets: [{ data, backgroundColor: colors, borderWidth:0 }]
        },
        options: {
          scales: {
            y: { beginAtZero:true, ticks:{ stepSize:1, max:1 } }
          },
          plugins: { legend: { display:false } }
        }
      });
    }

    // --- Render UI ---
    function render() {
      // Heart
      const remDot = document.getElementById("remDot");
      remDot.className = "status-dot " + (state.remindersActive ? "on" : "off");
      document.getElementById("reminderStatus").textContent =
        state.remindersActive ? "Active" : "Paused";

      // Mind
      const lastRef = state.reflections[state.reflections.length - 1];
      if (lastRef) {
        document.getElementById("lastReflectionInfo").textContent =
          `Last: ${lastRef.date} • “${lastRef.text.slice(0,40)}${lastRef.text.length>40?"...":""}"`;
      } else {
        document.getElementById("lastReflectionInfo").textContent =
          "No reflections yet.";
      }

      // Ear – voice list
      const vList = document.getElementById("voiceList");
      vList.innerHTML = "";
      const recent = [...state.voiceEntries].slice(-5).reverse();
      if (recent.length === 0) {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = "No voice entries yet.";
        vList.appendChild(li);
      } else {
        recent.forEach(entry => {
          const li = document.createElement("li");
          const when = new Date(entry.timestamp).toLocaleString();
          li.textContent = `[${when}] ${entry.title || "(no title)"} – ${entry.fileName || "no file"} – “${(entry.transcript||"").slice(0,40)}${(entry.transcript||"").length>40?"...":""}"`;
          vList.appendChild(li);
        });
      }

      // Memory
      const totalEntries =
        state.reflections.length +
        state.harmonyNotes.length +
        state.voiceEntries.length;
      document.getElementById("memoryStats").textContent =
        `Entries: ${totalEntries} • Voice: ${state.voiceEntries.length}`;

      // Config
      document.getElementById("thresholdInput").value = state.threshold;
      const todayMood = state.moodLog.find(m => m.date === todayISO());
      document.getElementById("moodSelect").value = todayMood ? todayMood.mood : "";
      document.getElementById("moodSummary").textContent =
        `Mood entries: ${state.moodLog.length}`;

      // Eye
      renderChart();
    }

    // --- Event handlers ---
    document.getElementById("toggleReminderBtn").onclick = () => {
      state.remindersActive = !state.remindersActive;
      saveToServer().then(render);
    };

    document.getElementById("saveReflectionBtn").onclick = () => {
      const textEl = document.getElementById("reflectionText");
      const text = textEl.value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      const today = todayISO();
      const existing = state.reflections.find(r => r.date === today);
      if (existing) {
        existing.text = text;
      } else {
        state.reflections.push({ date: today, text });
      }
      textEl.value = "";
      saveToServer().then(render);
    };

    document.getElementById("saveVoiceBtn").onclick = () => {
      const fileInput = document.getElementById("audioInput");
      const file = fileInput.files[0];
      const title = document.getElementById("voiceTitle").value.trim();
      const transcript = document.getElementById("voiceTranscript").value.trim();

      if (!file && !transcript) return; // nothing to save

      const entry = {
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        fileName: file ? file.name : null,
        title: title || "",
        transcript: transcript || ""
      };
      state.voiceEntries.push(entry);

      // clear inputs
      fileInput.value = "";
      document.getElementById("voiceTitle").value = "";
      document.getElementById("voiceTranscript").value = "";

      saveToServer().then(render);
    };

    document.getElementById("updateConfigBtn").onclick = () => {
      const thrVal = parseInt(document.getElementById("thresholdInput").value, 10);
      if (!isNaN(thrVal)) {
        state.threshold = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, thrVal));
      }
      const moodVal = document.getElementById("moodSelect").value;
      if (moodVal) {
        const today = todayISO();
        const existing = state.moodLog.find(m => m.date === today);
        if (existing) existing.mood = moodVal;
        else state.moodLog.push({ date: today, mood: moodVal });
      }
      saveToServer().then(render);
    };

    document.getElementById("exportBtn").onclick = () => {
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(state, null, 2)], {type:"application/json"});
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      a.download = "aumnity_console_state.json";
      a.click();
    };

    // --- Init ---
    loadFromServer();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

## 3️⃣ How to Run Everything Together

1. **Start backend**

   In `aumnity-console` folder:

   ```bash
   node server.js
   ```

2. **Open console**

   - Double-click `console.html` to open in your browser  
   - Or right-click → “Open with…” → your browser

3. **Use it**

   - Toggle 💗 reminders on/off  
   - Type a reflection and click **Save Reflection**  
   - Upload an audio file (or skip), give a title + transcript, click **Save Voice Entry**  
   - Set mood + threshold, click **Save Config & Mood**  
   - Watch 👁️ chart update as days go by  
   - Click **Export JSON Snapshot** to save all AUMNITY-baby’s memory so far

All of that is Phase **48 (Ear)** + **49 (Nerve)** working together:
- Ear = voice entries with transcript  
- Nerve = Node + SQLite state backend

# 1️⃣ Update `server.js` – add Voice & Reflection endpoints

Open your `server.js` and **add these two routes** *after* the existing `/api/state` route.

Search for:

```js
// Replace full console state
app.post("/api/state", (req, res) => {
  const incoming = req.body || {};
  // merge with default to avoid missing fields
  const merged = {
    ...DEFAULT_STATE,
    ...incoming,
  };
  saveState(merged, (err) => {
    if (err) return res.status(500).json({ ok: false });
    res.json({ ok: true });
  });
});
```

Right **below** that, paste this:

```js
// Append a single reflection (for Voice Sister, scripts, etc.)
app.post("/api/reflection-entry", (req, res) => {
  const { date, text } = req.body || {};
  if (!text) {
    return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "text is required" });
  }
  const usedDate = date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  getState((_, state) => {
    // ensure structure
    state.reflections = state.reflections || [];

    const existing = state.reflections.find(r => r.date === usedDate);
    if (existing) {
      // append with separator so previous note is not lost
      existing.text = existing.text + " | " + text;
    } else {
      state.reflections.push({ date: usedDate, text });
    }

    saveState(state, (err) => {
      if (err) return res.status(500).json({ ok: false });
      res.json({ ok: true });
    });
  });
});

// Append a single voice entry (Ear integration)
app.post("/api/voice-entry", (req, res) => {
  const { timestamp, fileName, title, transcript } = req.body || {};

  if (!fileName && !transcript) {
    return res.status(400).json({
      ok: false,
      error: "At least fileName or transcript is required"
    });
  }

  const ts = timestamp || new Date().toISOString();

  getState((_, state) => {
    state.voiceEntries = state.voiceEntries || [];

    state.voiceEntries.push({
      timestamp: ts,
      fileName: fileName || null,
      title: title || "",
      transcript: transcript || ""
    });

    saveState(state, (err) => {
      if (err) return res.status(500).json({ ok: false });
      res.json({ ok: true });
    });
  });
});
```

Then restart the server:

```bash
node server.js
```

(Stop the old one with `Ctrl + C` first.)

# 2️⃣ How Voice Sister (or any script) would call it

These are examples so later your voice agent / another tool can plug in.

### a) Add a reflection (text-only)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/reflection-entry \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "date": "2025-11-08",
    "text": "Walked with AI thoughts; chaos feels like opportunity."
  }'
```

If `date` is omitted, it uses **today**.

### b) Add a voice entry (Ear event)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/api/voice-entry \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "fileName": "voice_2025-11-08-evening.m4a",
    "title": "Gratitude walk insight",
    "transcript": "Thought about chaos as opportunity for AUMNITY partners."
  }'
```

If `timestamp` is omitted, it uses **now**.

After you send this:

- Open `console.html`
- You’ll see the new entry in **👂 Ear – Voice Entries**
- The JSON export also includes it

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>AUMNITY Partner View</title>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
<style>
body{margin:0;font-family:Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif;background:#0b0c10;color:#e0e0e0;}
header{background:#111;padding:0.6rem 1rem;font-size:1.2rem;color:#ffd700;}
main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1rem;padding:1rem;}
section{background:#151515;border-radius:12px;padding:0.8rem;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,215,0,0.1);}
h2{margin:0 0 0.4rem 0;color:#ffd700;font-size:1rem;}
ul{max-height:10rem;overflow:auto;margin:0;padding-left:1rem;}
small{color:#999;}
canvas{background:#111;border-radius:8px;padding:0.25rem;}
footer{text-align:center;padding:0.6rem;font-size:0.8rem;color:#777;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>🤝 AUMNITY – Partner View</header>
<main>
<section>
<h2>🧠 Recent Reflections</h2>
<ul id="refList"></ul>
</section>
<section>
<h2>👂 Recent Voice Entries</h2>
<ul id="voiceList"></ul>
</section>
<section style="grid-column:1/3;">
<h2>👁️ Mood Chart (14 Days)</h2>
<canvas id="moodChart"></canvas>
</section>
</main>
<footer>© 2025 AUMNITY – Read-Only View</footer>

<script>
const API_BASE="http://localhost:4000/api";

async function loadState(){
 const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/state");
 return res.json();
}

function render(state){
 const refList=document.getElementById("refList");
 const voiceList=document.getElementById("voiceList");

refList.innerHTML="";
[...state.reflections].slice(-7).reverse().forEach(r=>{
 const li=document.createElement("li");
 li.textContent=`${r.date} – ${r.text}`;
 refList.appendChild(li);
});

voiceList.innerHTML="";
[...state.voiceEntries].slice(-7).reverse().forEach(v=>{
 const li=document.createElement("li");
 li.textContent=`${new Date(v.timestamp).toLocaleString()} – ${v.title||"(no title)"}`;
 voiceList.appendChild(li);
});

const ctx=document.getElementById("moodChart").getContext("2d");
const today=new Date();
const labels=[],data=[],colors=[];
for(let i=13;i>=0;i--){
 const d=new Date(today);d.setDate(today.getDate()-i);
 const ds=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
 labels.push(ds.slice(5));
 const mood=state.moodLog.find(m=>m.date===ds);
 let val=0,color="#555";
 if(mood){val=1;
  if(mood.mood==="good")color="#4caf50";
  else if(mood.mood==="neutral")color="#ffd700";
  else color="#f44336";}
 data.push(val);colors.push(color);
}
new Chart(ctx,{type:"bar",data:{labels,datasets:[{data,backgroundColor:colors,borderWidth:0}]},
 options:{scales:{y:{beginAtZero:true,ticks:{stepSize:1,max:1}}},plugins:{legend:{display:false}}}});
}

loadState().then(render);
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

## ⚙️ 2️⃣ Run everything

1. **Start** your backend if not running:  
   ```bash
   node server.js
   ```

### b) Add the guest reflection endpoint

Still in `server.js`, **below** the `/api/state` and the two routes we added earlier  
(`/api/reflection-entry` and `/api/voice-entry`), add this new route:

```js
// Guest Portal: add a reflection from an external partner
app.post("/api/guest-reflection", (req, res) => {
  const { name, text } = req.body || {};
  const trimmed = (text || "").trim();

  if (!trimmed) {
    return res.status(400).json({ ok: false, error: "text is required" });
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const date = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const ts = now.toISOString();

  getState((_, stateObj) => {
    const state = stateObj || { ...DEFAULT_STATE };
    state.reflections = state.reflections || [];
    state.guestMessages = state.guestMessages || [];

    // 1) store as a reflection (so it appears in your console + charts)
    state.reflections.push({
      date,
      text: trimmed,
      source: "guest",
      guestName: name || null,
      createdAt: ts
    });

    // 2) also store in a separate guestMessages log
    state.guestMessages.push({
      timestamp: ts,
      name: name || null,
      text: trimmed
    });

    saveState(state, (err) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error("Error saving guest reflection:", err);
        return res.status(500).json({ ok: false });
      }
      res.json({ ok: true });
    });
  });
});
```

```html
<body>
<header>
  <div>🤝 AUMNITY – Partner View</div>
  <div id="status">⏳ loading…</div>
</header>
<main>
  <section>
    <h2>🧠 Recent Reflections</h2>
    <ul id="refList"></ul>
    <small>Shows the last 7 reflections (including guest notes).</small>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>👂 Recent Voice Entries</h2>
    <ul id="voiceList"></ul>
    <small>Last 7 voice-linked moments saved by AUMNITY.</small>
  </section>

  <section style="grid-column:1/3;">
    <h2>👁️ Mood Chart (14 Days)</h2>
    <canvas id="moodChart"></canvas>
    <small>Bar = day with a reflection. Color = mood that day (if set).</small>
  </section>

  <section style="grid-column:1/3;">
    <h2>💌 Leave a Note for AUMNITY</h2>
    <p style="font-size:0.9rem;">

    </p>

    <label for="guestText"><small>Your reflection / note</small></label>
    <textarea id="guestText" placeholder="Share one honest line (or more)…"></textarea>
    <button id="guestSendBtn">Send to AUMNITY</button>
    <small id="guestFeedback"></small>
  </section>
</main>
<footer>© 2025 AUMNITY – Guest Portal (Prototype)</footer>

<script>
const API_BASE="http://localhost:4000/api";
const statusEl=document.getElementById("status");
const feedbackEl=document.getElementById("guestFeedback");
const sendBtn=document.getElementById("guestSendBtn");

async function loadState(){
  statusEl.textContent="⏳ loading…";
  try{
    const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/state");
    const data=await res.json();
    statusEl.textContent="✔ live";
    statusEl.style.color="#a5d6a7";
    return data;
  }catch(e){
    statusEl.textContent="⚠ cannot reach server";
    statusEl.style.color="#ff8a80";
    return {reflections:[],voiceEntries:[],moodLog:[]};
  }
}

function render(state){
  const refList=document.getElementById("refList");
  const voiceList=document.getElementById("voiceList");
  refList.innerHTML="";
  voiceList.innerHTML="";

  // reflections – last 7, newest first
  const lastRefs=[...state.reflections||[]].slice(-7).reverse();
  if(lastRefs.length===0){
    const li=document.createElement("li");
    li.textContent="No reflections yet.";
    refList.appendChild(li);
  }else{
    lastRefs.forEach(r=>{
      const li=document.createElement("li");
      const source=r.source==="guest"?"guest":"self";
      const labelName=r.guestName?` (${r.guestName})`:"";
      li.textContent=`${r.date} – ${r.text}`;
      if(source==="guest"){
        const span=document.createElement("span");
        span.className="badge badge-guest";
        span.textContent="guest"+labelName;
        li.appendChild(span);
      }
      refList.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  // voice entries – last 7, newest first
  const lastVoice=[...state.voiceEntries||[]].slice(-7).reverse();
  if(lastVoice.length===0){
    const li=document.createElement("li");
    li.textContent="No voice entries yet.";
    voiceList.appendChild(li);
  }else{
    lastVoice.forEach(v=>{
      const li=document.createElement("li");
      li.textContent=`${new Date(v.timestamp).toLocaleString()} – ${v.title||"(no title)"}`;
      voiceList.appendChild(li);
    });
  }

  // mood chart
  const ctx=document.getElementById("moodChart").getContext("2d");
  const today=new Date();
  const labels=[],data=[],colors=[];
  const moodLog=state.moodLog||[];
  for(let i=13;i>=0;i--){
    const d=new Date(today);d.setDate(today.getDate()-i);
    const ds=d.toISOString().slice(0,10);
    labels.push(ds.slice(5));
    const moodEntry=moodLog.find(m=>m.date===ds);
    let val=0,color="#555";
    if(moodEntry){
      val=1;
      if(moodEntry.mood==="good")color="#4caf50";
      else if(moodEntry.mood==="neutral")color="#ffd700";
      else color="#f44336";
    }
    data.push(val);
    colors.push(color);
  }
  new Chart(ctx,{
    type:"bar",
    data:{labels,datasets:[{data,backgroundColor:colors,borderWidth:0}]},
    options:{
      scales:{y:{beginAtZero:true,ticks:{stepSize:1,max:1}}},
      plugins:{legend:{display:false}}
    }
  });
}

// send guest note
async function sendGuestNote(){
  const name=document.getElementById("guestName").value.trim();
  const text=document.getElementById("guestText").value.trim();
  if(!text){
    feedbackEl.textContent="Please write something before sending.";
    feedbackEl.style.color="#ff8a80";
    return;
  }
  sendBtn.disabled=true;
  feedbackEl.textContent="Sending…";
  feedbackEl.style.color="#ccc";

  try{
    const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/guest-reflection",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({name,text})
    });
    const body=await res.json();
    if(body.ok){
      feedbackEl.textContent="Thank you – your note is now part of AUMNITY.";
      feedbackEl.style.color="#a5d6a7";
      document.getElementById("guestText").value="";
      // reload to show it in recent reflections
      const state=await loadState();
      render(state);
    }else{
      feedbackEl.textContent="Could not save your note.";
      feedbackEl.style.color="#ff8a80";
    }
  }catch(e){
    feedbackEl.textContent="Error talking to AUMNITY server.";
    feedbackEl.style.color="#ff8a80";
  }finally{
    sendBtn.disabled=false;
  }
}

sendBtn.addEventListener("click",sendGuestNote);

// init
loadState().then(render);
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```html
section{background:#111326;border-radius:12px;padding:0.8rem;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(255,215,0,0.15);}
h2{margin:0 0 0.4rem 0;color:#ffd700;font-size:1rem;}
label{font-size:0.8rem;color:#bbb;display:block;margin-top:0.3rem;}
input,select,textarea{
  width:100%;background:#050712;color:#eee;border:1px solid #333;
  border-radius:6px;padding:0.35rem;font-size:0.85rem;
}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:60px;}
button{
  margin-top:0.5rem;background:#ffd700;border:none;border-radius:6px;
  padding:0.35rem 0.7rem;font-weight:600;color:#111;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.9rem;
}
button:disabled{opacity:0.6;cursor:not-allowed;}
small{color:#888;font-size:0.75rem;}
ul{max-height:13rem;overflow:auto;margin:0.3rem 0 0 1rem;padding:0;font-size:0.85rem;}
li{margin-bottom:0.35rem;}
.tag{font-size:0.7rem;border-radius:10px;padding:0 0.4rem;margin-left:0.3rem;}
.tag-career{background:#1565c0;}
.tag-health{background:#c62828;}
.tag-relationship{background:#ad1457;}
.tag-inner_shift{background:#6a1b9a;}
.tag-other{background:#424242;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header>🪐 AUMNITY – Astrology Lens (Read-Only Prototype)</header>
<main>
  <section>
    <h2>📜 Birth Profile</h2>
    <label>DOB (YYYY-MM-DD)</label>
    <input id="dob" type="date" />
    <label>Time of Birth</label>
    <input id="tob" type="time" />
    <label>Place of Birth</label>
    <input id="place" type="text" placeholder="City, Country" />
    <label>Timezone</label>
    <input id="timezone" type="text" placeholder="e.g., Asia/Kolkata" />

    <label>Source of birth time</label>
    <select id="source">
      <option value="">-- select --</option>
      <option value="birth_certificate">Birth certificate</option>
      <option value="hospital_record">Hospital record</option>
      <option value="parent_memory">Parent memory</option>
      <option value="guess">Guess / approximate</option>
    </select>

    <label>Rectification status</label>
    <select id="rectified">
      <option value="false">Not rectified / unsure</option>
      <option value="true">Rectified</option>
    </select>

    <label>Rectified by</label>
    <select id="rectifiedBy">
      <option value="">-- none --</option>
      <option value="self">Self</option>
      <option value="astro_guide">Astrologer / guide</option>
      <option value="aum_auto">AUMNITY (future auto)</option>
    </select>

    <label>Rectification notes</label>
    <textarea id="rectNotes" placeholder="E.g., shifted from 6:10 to 6:18 based on major events…"></textarea>

    <label>Confidence in time (%)</label>
    <input id="confidence" type="number" min="0" max="100" placeholder="0–100" />

    <button id="saveProfile">Save Astrology Profile</button>
    <small id="profileMsg"></small>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>🌌 Life Events (for future rectification)</h2>
    <label>Event label</label>
    <input id="eventLabel" type="text" placeholder="e.g., First job, Marriage, Accident, Spiritual shift…" />
    <label>Category</label>
    <select id="eventCategory">
      <option value="career">Career</option>
      <option value="health">Health</option>
      <option value="relationship">Relationship</option>
      <option value="inner_shift">Inner shift</option>
      <option value="other">Other</option>
    </select>
    <label>Impact</label>
    <select id="eventImpact">
      <option value="2">Very positive</option>
      <option value="1">Positive</option>
      <option value="0" selected>Neutral / mixed</option>
      <option value="-1">Negative</option>
      <option value="-2">Very negative</option>
    </select>
    <label>Mood at that time</label>
    <select id="eventMood">
      <option value="">(not sure)</option>
      <option value="low">Low</option>
      <option value="neutral">Neutral</option>
      <option value="high">High</option>
    </select>
    <label>Notes</label>
    <textarea id="eventNotes" placeholder="Short description…"></textarea>
    <button id="addEvent">Add Event</button>
    <small id="eventMsg"></small>

    <h3 style="margin-top:0.8rem;font-size:0.9rem;color:#ffd700;">Recent Events</h3>
    <ul id="eventsList"></ul>
    <small>Later, AUMNITY (or an astrologer) can use these to refine the birth time.</small>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
const API_BASE="http://localhost:4000/api";

async function loadProfile(){
  const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/astro-profile");
  return res.json();
}
async function loadEvents(){
  const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/astro-events");
  return res.json();
}

function tagClass(cat){
  return "tag tag-"+(cat||"other");
}

function renderProfile(p){
  document.getElementById("dob").value = p.dob || "";
  document.getElementById("tob").value = p.tob || "";
  document.getElementById("place").value = p.place || "";
  document.getElementById("timezone").value = p.timezone || "";
  document.getElementById("source").value = p.source || "";
  document.getElementById("rectified").value = p.rectified ? "true" : "false";
  document.getElementById("rectifiedBy").value = p.rectifiedBy || "";
  document.getElementById("rectNotes").value = p.rectificationNotes || "";
  document.getElementById("confidence").value = p.confidence ?? "";
}

function renderEvents(events){
  const ul=document.getElementById("eventsList");
  ul.innerHTML="";
  if(!events.length){
    const li=document.createElement("li");
    li.textContent="No events logged yet.";
    ul.appendChild(li);
    return;
  }
  [...events].slice(-15).reverse().forEach(ev=>{
    const li=document.createElement("li");
    const d=new Date(ev.timestamp).toLocaleString();
    li.textContent=`${d} – ${ev.label}`;
    const t=document.createElement("span");
    t.className=tagClass(ev.category);
    t.textContent=ev.category;
    li.appendChild(t);
    ul.appendChild(li);
  });
}

document.getElementById("saveProfile").addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
  const payload={
    dob:document.getElementById("dob").value || null,
    tob:document.getElementById("tob").value || null,
    place:document.getElementById("place").value || null,
    timezone:document.getElementById("timezone").value || null,
    source:document.getElementById("source").value || null,
    rectified:document.getElementById("rectified").value==="true",
    rectifiedBy:document.getElementById("rectifiedBy").value || null,
    rectificationNotes:document.getElementById("rectNotes").value || null,
    confidence:document.getElementById("confidence").value
      ? Number(document.getElementById("confidence").value)
      : null
  };
  const msg=document.getElementById("profileMsg");
  msg.textContent="Saving…";
  try{
    const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/astro-profile",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    const body=await res.json();
    if(body.ok){
      msg.textContent="Saved.";
      msg.style.color="#a5d6a7";
    }else{
      msg.textContent="Could not save.";
      msg.style.color="#ff8a80";
    }
  }catch(e){
    msg.textContent="Error talking to server.";
    msg.style.color="#ff8a80";
  }
});

document.getElementById("addEvent").addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
  const payload={
    label:document.getElementById("eventLabel").value.trim(),
    category:document.getElementById("eventCategory").value,
    impact:Number(document.getElementById("eventImpact").value),
    mood:document.getElementById("eventMood").value || null,
    notes:document.getElementById("eventNotes").value || null
  };
  const msg=document.getElementById("eventMsg");
  if(!payload.label){
    msg.textContent="Please give the event a label.";
    msg.style.color="#ff8a80";
    return;
  }
  msg.textContent="Saving event…";
  try{
    const res=await fetch(API_BASE+"/astro-events",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    const body=await res.json();
    if(body.ok){
      msg.textContent="Event saved.";
      msg.style.color="#a5d6a7";
      document.getElementById("eventLabel").value="";
      document.getElementById("eventNotes").value="";
      const events=await loadEvents();
      renderEvents(events);
    }else{
      msg.textContent="Could not save event.";
      msg.style.color="#ff8a80";
    }
  }catch(e){
    msg.textContent="Error talking to server.";
    msg.style.color="#ff8a80";
  }
});

// init
(async()=>{
  const profile=await loadProfile();
  renderProfile(profile);
  const events=await loadEvents();
  renderEvents(events);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### b) JS to sync the toggle

In the `<script>` of `console.html`, add this logic:

```js
const ASTRO_API = "http://localhost:4000/api";

async function loadAstroToggle(){
  try{
    const res = await fetch(ASTRO_API + "/astro-toggle");
    const body = await res.json();
    const enabled = !!body.enabled;
    const cb = document.getElementById("astroToggle");
    const status = document.getElementById("astroStatus");
    const linkWrap = document.getElementById("astroLinkWrap");

    cb.checked = enabled;
    if(enabled){
      status.textContent = "Astrology Lens is ON (astro_panel.html available).";
      status.style.color = "#a5d6a7";
      linkWrap.style.display = "block";
    }else{
      status.textContent = "Currently OFF.";
      status.style.color = "#aaa";
      linkWrap.style.display = "none";
    }
  }catch(e){
    console.error("astro toggle error", e);
  }
}

async function saveAstroToggle(enabled){
  const status = document.getElementById("astroStatus");
  const linkWrap = document.getElementById("astroLinkWrap");
  status.textContent = "Saving…";
  try{
    const res = await fetch(ASTRO_API + "/astro-toggle",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({enabled})
    });
    const body = await res.json();
    if(body.ok){
      if(body.enabled){
        status.textContent = "Astrology Lens is ON (astro_panel.html available).";
        status.style.color = "#a5d6a7";
        linkWrap.style.display = "block";
      }else{
        status.textContent = "Currently OFF.";
        status.style.color = "#aaa";
        linkWrap.style.display = "none";
      }
    }else{
      status.textContent = "Could not update.";
      status.style.color = "#ff8a80";
    }
  }catch(e){
    status.textContent = "Error talking to server.";
    status.style.color = "#ff8a80";
  }
}

// attach listener
document.getElementById("astroToggle").addEventListener("change", (e)=>{
  saveAstroToggle(e.target.checked);
});

// call once during init
loadAstroToggle();
```

(If your console script already has an `init()` function, just call `loadAstroToggle()` inside it.)

```js
});
```

```html
<body>

    <button id="calcBtn">Calculate Numbers</button>
    <button id="saveBtn" disabled>Save to AUMNITY</button>

    <textarea id="numNotes" placeholder="Any comments or feelings about these numbers…"></textarea>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>📊 Numbers</h2>
    <div class="resultBox">

      <div class="resultValue" id="lifePathValue">–</div>
      <small>Sum of DOB (overall journey).</small>
    </div>
    <div class="resultBox">
      <div class="resultLabel">Expression</div>
      <div class="resultValue" id="expressionValue">–</div>
      <small>From full name (outer expression / skills).</small>
    </div>
    <div class="resultBox">
      <div class="resultLabel">Soul Urge</div>
      <div class="resultValue" id="soulUrgeValue">–</div>
      <small>From vowels of name (inner desire).</small>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<script>
const API_BASE="http://localhost:4000/api";

// basic Pythagorean mapping
const LETTER_MAP = {
  A:1,B:2,C:3,D:4,E:5,F:6,G:7,H:8,I:9,
  J:1,K:2,L:3,M:4,N:5,O:6,P:7,Q:8,R:9,
  S:1,T:2,U:3,V:4,W:5,X:6,Y:7,Z:8
};
const VOWELS = new Set(["A","E","I","O","U","Y"]);

// reduce like 27 -> 2+7 = 9
function digitalRoot(n){
  if(!n || n<=0) return null;
  while(n>9 && n!==11 && n!==22 && n!==33){
    let s=0;
    for(const c of String(n)) s+=Number(c);
    n=s;
  }
  return n;
}

function calcLifePath(dobStr){
  if(!dobStr) return null;
  // YYYY-MM-DD
  const parts = dobStr.split("-");
  if(parts.length!==3) return null;
  const [y,m,d] = parts;
  let sum = 0;
  for(const c of (y+m+d)) if(/\d/.test(c)) sum += Number(c);
  return digitalRoot(sum);
}

function calcNameNumber(name, onlyVowels=false){
  if(!name) return null;
  let sum=0;
  for(const ch of name.toUpperCase()){
    if(ch < "A" || ch > "Z") continue;
    if(onlyVowels && !VOWELS.has(ch)) continue;
    if(!onlyVowels && VOWELS.has(ch) && false) continue; // no-op
    sum += LETTER_MAP[ch] || 0;
  }
  return digitalRoot(sum);
}

// load existing profile
async function loadProfile(){
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE+"/numerology-profile");
    const p = await res.json();
    if(p.fullName) document.getElementById("fullName").value = p.fullName;
    if(p.dob) document.getElementById("dob").value = p.dob;
    if(p.notes) document.getElementById("numNotes").value = p.notes;
    if(p.lifePath) document.getElementById("lifePathValue").textContent = p.lifePath;
    if(p.expression) document.getElementById("expressionValue").textContent = p.expression;
    if(p.soulUrge) document.getElementById("soulUrgeValue").textContent = p.soulUrge;
  }catch(e){
    console.error("load numerology", e);
  }
}

document.getElementById("calcBtn").addEventListener("click", ()=>{
  const name = document.getElementById("fullName").value.trim();
  const dob = document.getElementById("dob").value;
  const msg = document.getElementById("numMsg");

  const lp = calcLifePath(dob);
  const expr = calcNameNumber(name, false);
  const soul = calcNameNumber(name, true);

  document.getElementById("lifePathValue").textContent = lp ?? "–";
  document.getElementById("expressionValue").textContent = expr ?? "–";
  document.getElementById("soulUrgeValue").textContent = soul ?? "–";

  if(lp || expr || soul){
    msg.textContent = "Calculated. Click “Save to AUMNITY” if you’re okay with this.";
    msg.style.color = "#a5d6a7";
    document.getElementById("saveBtn").disabled = false;
  }else{
    msg.textContent = "Please enter at least a name or DOB.";
    msg.style.color = "#ff8a80";
    document.getElementById("saveBtn").disabled = true;
  }
});

document.getElementById("saveBtn").addEventListener("click", async ()=>{
  const msg = document.getElementById("numMsg");
  const payload = {
    fullName: document.getElementById("fullName").value.trim() || null,
    dob: document.getElementById("dob").value || null,
    lifePath: document.getElementById("lifePathValue").textContent !== "–"
      ? document.getElementById("lifePathValue").textContent
      : null,
    expression: document.getElementById("expressionValue").textContent !== "–"
      ? document.getElementById("expressionValue").textContent
      : null,
    soulUrge: document.getElementById("soulUrgeValue").textContent !== "–"
      ? document.getElementById("soulUrgeValue").textContent
      : null,
    notes: document.getElementById("numNotes").value || null
  };
  msg.textContent = "Saving…";
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE+"/numerology-profile",{
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify(payload)
    });
    const body = await res.json();
    if(body.ok){
      msg.textContent = "Saved into AUMNITY state.";
      msg.style.color = "#a5d6a7";
    }else{
      msg.textContent = "Could not save.";
      msg.style.color = "#ff8a80";
    }
  }catch(e){
    msg.textContent = "Error talking to server.";
    msg.style.color = "#ff8a80";
  }
});

// init
loadProfile();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### 2️⃣ Reason 2 — Legal / compliance landscape
Under **GDPR**, **CCPA**, and similar laws:
- User conversations can be considered *personal data*.
- Using them for model training without *explicit consent* = high-risk legally.
- Even anonymized data can be controversial (re-identification risk).

So, privacy-centric products now *avoid any training-on-user-data* by design, to stay fully compliant.

---

### 3️⃣ Reason 3 — Market Positioning Strategy
Duck.ai wants to sit in a niche:  
🧠 *AI utility* + 🛡️ *privacy* + 🚫 *no user accounts*.

| **Perplexity.ai** | Uses anonymized search logs | No | Ad-free premium plan |

Imagine this inside the AUMNITY server we’ve been designing (Node + SQLite):

### a) Store each reflection with a “time-focus” tag

When you log something:

> “I’m worried about Monday’s meeting.”  
> “I keep thinking about that failure 5 years ago.”

A simple classifier marks it:

- `past_focus`  
- `future_focus`  
- `present_focus`

For v1 this can be **dumb but useful**: keyword / pattern based.

```js
// very simple classifier
function getTimeFocus(text) {
  const t = text.toLowerCase();
  if (t.match(/\b(yesterday|last year|back then|5 years ago)\b/)) return 'past';
  if (t.match(/\b(tomorrow|next week|future|someday|will)\b/)) return 'future';
  return 'present';
}
```

Each entry gets saved like:

```sql
INSERT INTO reflections (ts, text, focus)
VALUES (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?);  -- 'past' | 'future' | 'present'
```

### b) A “Now Prompt” endpoint

New API route:

```js
// GET /api/now_prompt
// Reads last N reflections and suggests a gentle present-moment question
```

Pseudo-logic:

1. Look at last, say, **20** reflections.  
2. Count how many are `past`, `future`, `present`.  
3. If `past` or `future` is dominating, return a small **nudge** like:

   - “You’ve been thinking a lot about the future.  
     Right now, what is *one thing you can sense* (body or environment)?”

4. If `present` is already high, respond with:

   - “You’re staying close to the moment.  
     Want to log one *tiny* concrete action you can do in the next 5 minutes?”

Rough sketch:

```js
app.get('/api/now_prompt', async (req, res) => {
  const rows = await db.all(`
    SELECT focus FROM reflections
    ORDER BY ts DESC
    LIMIT 20
  `);

  const stats = { past: 0, future: 0, present: 0 };
  rows.forEach(r => { stats[r.focus]++; });

  let prompt;
  if (stats.future > stats.past && stats.future > stats.present) {
    prompt = "You’ve been in future-thinking mode. Right now, name one thing you can *see / hear / touch* around you.";
  } else if (stats.past > stats.present) {
    prompt = "A lot of your reflections look backward. Right now, what is one tiny thing you can do *today* that’s under your control?";
  } else {
    prompt = "You’re quite present. Want to log one small action you can take in the next 5 minutes?";
  }

  res.json({ stats, prompt });
});
```

On your AUMNITY front-end (or even inside ChatGPT):

## 3️⃣ Step 1 – Create / update `server.js`

**Click-copy this whole file** if you’re starting fresh.

```js
// server.js
const express = require('express');
const bodyParser = require('body-parser');
const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 8080;

// --- middleware ---
app.use(bodyParser.json());
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// --- DB setup ---
const db = new sqlite3.Database('aum_data.db');

db.serialize(() => {
  // 🔹 NEW FOR NOW LOOP: reflections table
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reflections (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      ts DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      text TEXT NOT NULL,
      focus TEXT CHECK(focus IN ('past','present','future')) NOT NULL
    )
  `);
});

// 🔹 helper: classify reflection as past / present / future
function getTimeFocus(text) {
  const t = (text || '').toLowerCase();

  const pastWords = [
    'yesterday','last week','last month','last year',
    'ago','earlier','back then','once upon','before'
  ];
  const futureWords = [
    'tomorrow','next week','next month','next year',
    'someday','will ','gonna','plan to','hope to','want to'
  ];

  if (pastWords.some(w => t.includes(w))) return 'past';
  if (futureWords.some(w => t.includes(w))) return 'future';
  return 'present';
}

// 🔹 1) POST /api/reflection  → store one reflection
app.post('/api/reflection', (req, res) => {
  const { text } = req.body || {};
  if (!text || !text.trim()) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'text is required' });
  }

  const focus = getTimeFocus(text);

  db.run(
    `INSERT INTO reflections (text, focus) VALUES (?, ?)`,
    [text.trim(), focus],
    function (err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('DB insert error:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
      }
      res.json({ id: this.lastID, focus });
    }
  );
});

// 🔹 2) GET /api/now_prompt  → stats + gentle “now” question
app.get('/api/now_prompt', (req, res) => {
  const limit = Number(req.query.limit) || 20;

  db.all(
    `SELECT focus FROM reflections ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`,
    [limit],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('DB select error:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
      }

      const stats = { past: 0, present: 0, future: 0 };
      rows.forEach(r => {
        if (stats[r.focus] !== undefined) stats[r.focus]++;
      });

      let prompt;

      const { past, present, future } = stats;

      if (future > past && future > present) {
        prompt = "You’ve been thinking a lot about the future. Right now, name one thing you can *see, hear or touch* around you.";
      } else if (past > present && past >= future) {
        prompt = "Many reflections are looking backward. Right now, what is one tiny thing you can do *today* that’s under your control?";
      } else if (present > 0) {
        prompt = "You’re already close to the present. Want to log one small action you can take in the next 5 minutes?";
      } else {
        prompt = "Start with one line about *right now* (body, breath, room). Then ask: what feels most alive in this moment?";
      }

      res.json({ stats, prompt, total: rows.length });
    }
  );
});

// simple health check
app.get('/api/health', (_, res) => {
  res.json({ ok: true });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`AUMNITY Now Loop server running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});
```

---

```html
        alert('Error: ' + data.error);
        return;
      }
      document.getElementById('result').textContent =
        'Saved as ' + data.focus.toUpperCase() + ' focus.';
      document.getElementById('text').value = '';
      loadNowPrompt();
    }

    async function loadNowPrompt() {
      const res = await fetch('/api/now_prompt');
      const data = await res.json();

      const s = data.stats || { past:0, present:0, future:0 };
      document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML = `
        <span class="pill pill-past">Past: ${s.past}</span>
        <span class="pill pill-present">Present: ${s.present}</span>
        <span class="pill pill-future">Future: ${s.future}</span>
        <small>(last ${data.total} reflections)</small>
      `;
      document.getElementById('prompt').textContent = data.prompt;
    }

    document.getElementById('save').addEventListener('click', saveReflection);
    document.getElementById('refresh').addEventListener('click', loadNowPrompt);

    // load initial
    loadNowPrompt();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```js
  const days = Number(req.query.days) || 7;

  // group last N days by date (local time via DATE(ts))

    GROUP BY DATE(ts)
    ORDER BY day DESC
  `;

    if (err) {
      console.error('DB timeline error:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
    }
    res.json({ days, timeline: rows });

});
```

```html
  <p><small>See how much of your attention lived in <b>past / present / future</b> over the last days.</small></p>

  <div class="card">
    <label for="days">Range:</label>
    <select id="days">
      <option value="3">Last 3 days</option>
      <option value="7" selected>Last 7 days</option>
      <option value="14">Last 14 days</option>
      <option value="30">Last 30 days</option>

      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#4ade80;"></span>Present</span>
      <span><span class="dot" style="background:#facc15;"></span>Future</span>
    </div>

    <div id="chart" style="margin-top:1rem;"></div>
  </div>

  <script>
    async function loadTimeline() {
      const days = document.getElementById('days').value;
      const res = await fetch('/api/presence_timeline?days=' + days);
      const data = await res.json();
      const container = document.getElementById('chart');
      container.innerHTML = '';

      const rows = data.timeline || [];
      if (!rows.length) {
        container.innerHTML = '<p><small>No reflections yet in this range. Log some in <b>now.html</b> and come back.</small></p>';
        return;
      }

      const maxTotal = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.past + r.present + r.future)) || 1;

      const rowDiv = document.createElement('div');
      rowDiv.className = 'row';

      rows.slice().reverse().forEach(r => {
        const total = r.past + r.present + r.future || 1;

        const bar = document.createElement('div');
        bar.className = 'bar';

        const scale = 120 / maxTotal; // max bar height ~120px

        [['future','future'], ['present','present'], ['past','past']].forEach(([key, cls]) => {
          if (r[key] > 0) {
            const seg = document.createElement('div');
            seg.className = 'seg ' + cls;
            seg.style.height = (r[key] * scale) + 'px';
            seg.title = `${key}: ${r[key]}`;
            bar.appendChild(seg);
          }
        });

        const col = document.createElement('div');
        col.appendChild(bar);

        const label = document.createElement('div');
        label.className = 'day-label';
        label.textContent = r.day.slice(5); // show MM-DD
        col.appendChild(label);

        rowDiv.appendChild(col);
      });

      container.appendChild(rowDiv);
    }

    document.getElementById('reload').addEventListener('click', loadTimeline);
    loadTimeline();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```js
});
```

## 2️⃣ Replace `server.js` with this full version

- exposes APIs for Now Loop + Timeline

### 2.1 Install dependencies (once)

### 2.2 `server.js` (click–copy everything)

```js
// server.js
const express = require('express');
const bodyParser = require('body-parser');
const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();
const path = require('path');
const fs = require('fs');
const cron = require('node-cron');
require('dotenv').config({ path: path.join(__dirname, 'config', '.env') });

// load settings
let settings = { features: {}, pulse: {} };
try {
  settings = require('./config/aum_settings.json');
} catch (e) {
  console.warn('⚠️ aum_settings.json not found or invalid, using defaults.');
}

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 8080;
const DB_PATH = process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(__dirname, 'data', 'aum_data.db');

// ensure data dir exists
const dataDir = path.dirname(DB_PATH);
if (!fs.existsSync(dataDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(dataDir, { recursive: true });
}

// --- middleware ---
app.use(bodyParser.json());
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// --- DB setup ---
const db = new sqlite3.Database(DB_PATH);

db.serialize(() => {
  // reflections = raw entries
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reflections (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      ts DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      text TEXT NOT NULL,
      focus TEXT CHECK(focus IN ('past','present','future')) NOT NULL
    )
  `);

  // pulses = nightly summary
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pulses (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      ts DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      past INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      present INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      future INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
  `);
});

// --- helper: time-focus classifier ---
function getTimeFocus(text) {
  const t = (text || '').toLowerCase();

  const pastWords = [
    'yesterday', 'last week', 'last month', 'last year',
    'ago', 'earlier', 'back then', 'once upon', 'before'
  ];
  const futureWords = [
    'tomorrow', 'next week', 'next month', 'next year',
    'someday', 'will ', 'gonna', 'plan to', 'hope to', 'want to'
  ];

  if (pastWords.some(w => t.includes(w))) return 'past';
  if (futureWords.some(w => t.includes(w))) return 'future';
  return 'present';
}

// =============== API ORGANS ===============

// 1️⃣ Now Loop: store reflection
app.post('/api/reflection', (req, res) => {
  if (!settings.features.nowLoop) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'nowLoop disabled in settings' });
  }

  const { text } = req.body || {};
  if (!text || !text.trim()) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'text is required' });
  }

  const focus = getTimeFocus(text);

  db.run(
    `INSERT INTO reflections (text, focus) VALUES (?, ?)`,
    [text.trim(), focus],
    function (err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('DB insert error:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
      }
      res.json({ id: this.lastID, focus });
    }
  );
});

// 2️⃣ Now Loop: prompt based on last N reflections
app.get('/api/now_prompt', (req, res) => {
  if (!settings.features.nowLoop) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'nowLoop disabled in settings' });
  }

  const limit = Number(req.query.limit) || 20;

  db.all(
    `SELECT focus FROM reflections ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT ?`,
    [limit],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('DB select error:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
      }

      const stats = { past: 0, present: 0, future: 0 };
      rows.forEach(r => {
        if (stats[r.focus] !== undefined) stats[r.focus]++;
      });

      const { past, present, future } = stats;
      let prompt;

      if (future > past && future > present) {
        prompt = "You’ve been thinking a lot about the future. Right now, name one thing you can *see, hear or touch* around you.";
      } else if (past > present && past >= future) {
        prompt = "Many reflections are looking backward. Right now, what is one tiny thing you can do *today* that’s under your control?";
      } else if (present > 0) {
        prompt = "You’re already close to the present. Want to log one small action you can take in the next 5 minutes?";
      } else {
        prompt = "Start with one line about *right now* (body, breath, room). Then ask: what feels most alive in this moment?";
      }

      res.json({ stats, prompt, total: rows.length });
    }
  );
});

// 3️⃣ Presence Timeline: last N days grouped by date
app.get('/api/presence_timeline', (req, res) => {
  if (!settings.features.presenceTimeline) {
    return res.status(403).json({ error: 'presenceTimeline disabled in settings' });
  }

  const days = Number(req.query.days) || 7;
  const offset = `-${days} days`;

  const sql = `
    SELECT
      DATE(ts) AS day,
      SUM(CASE WHEN focus = 'past' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS past,
      SUM(CASE WHEN focus = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS present,
      SUM(CASE WHEN focus = 'future' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future
    FROM reflections
    WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)
    GROUP BY DATE(ts)
    ORDER BY day DESC
  `;

  db.all(sql, [offset], (err, rows) => {
    if (err) {
      console.error('DB timeline error:', err);
      return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
    }
    res.json({ days, timeline: rows });
  });
});

// 4️⃣ Pulses history (optional view)
app.get('/api/pulses', (req, res) => {
  const days = Number(req.query.days) || 7;
  const offset = `-${days} days`;

  db.all(
    `
      SELECT
        DATE(ts) AS day,
        past, present, future
      FROM pulses
      WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)
      ORDER BY ts DESC
    `,
    [offset],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('DB pulses error:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'db error' });
      }
      res.json({ days, pulses: rows });
    }
  );
});

// health check
app.get('/api/health', (_, res) => {
  res.json({ ok: true, dbPath: DB_PATH, features: settings.features });
});

// =============== NIGHTLY PULSE (BREATH) ===============

if (settings.features.nightlyPulse) {
  const cronExpr = settings.pulse.cron || '5 21 * * *'; // default 21:05
  const windowDays = settings.pulse.windowDays || 1;

  console.log(`💤 Nightly pulse enabled: cron=${cronExpr}, windowDays=${windowDays}`);

  cron.schedule(cronExpr, () => {
    const offset = `-${windowDays} days`;

    db.all(
      `
        SELECT focus FROM reflections
        WHERE ts >= datetime('now', ?)
      `,
      [offset],
      (err, rows) => {
        if (err) {
          console.error('Pulse query error:', err);
          return;
        }
        if (!rows.length) {
          console.log('💓 Pulse skipped (no reflections in window)');
          return;
        }

        const stats = { past: 0, present: 0, future: 0 };
        rows.forEach(r => {
          if (stats[r.focus] !== undefined) stats[r.focus]++;
        });

        db.run(
          `
            INSERT INTO pulses (past, present, future)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
          `,
          [stats.past, stats.present, stats.future],
          function (err2) {
            if (err2) {
              console.error('Pulse insert error:', err2);
              return;
            }
            console.log('💓 AUMNITY Pulse logged:', stats);
          }
        );
      }
    );
  });
} else {
  console.log('💤 Nightly pulse disabled in settings.');
}

// =============== START SERVER ===============
app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`AUMNITY core running on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});
```

```html
  <script>
    async function fetchJSON(path) {
      const res = await fetch(path);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      return res.json();
    }

    async function loadToday() {
      const panel = document.getElementById('today-stats');
      const promptEl = document.getElementById('today-prompt');
      panel.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Loading pattern…</p>';
      promptEl.textContent = 'Loading…';

      try {
        const data = await fetchJSON('/api/now_prompt?limit=20');
        const { stats, total, prompt } = data;

        const totalCount = total || 0;
        const pPast = totalCount ? Math.round((stats.past / totalCount) * 100) : 0;
        const pPresent = totalCount ? Math.round((stats.present / totalCount) * 100) : 0;
        const pFuture = totalCount ? Math.round((stats.future / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

        panel.innerHTML = `
          <div class="row" style="margin-top:.25rem;">
            <div class="stat">
              <span class="stat-label">Past</span>
              <span class="stat-value">${stats.past}</span>
              <span class="sub">${pPast}%</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
              <span class="stat-label">Present</span>
              <span class="stat-value">${stats.present}</span>
              <span class="sub">${pPresent}%</span>
            </div>
            <div class="stat">
              <span class="stat-label">Future</span>
              <span class="stat-value">${stats.future}</span>
              <span class="sub">${pFuture}%</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="sub" style="margin-top:.6rem;">Total reflections analysed: <b>${totalCount}</b></p>
        `;

        promptEl.textContent = prompt;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        panel.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Could not load today’s pattern.</p>';
        promptEl.textContent = '—';
      }
    }

    async function loadTimeline() {
      const container = document.getElementById('timeline-chart');
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Loading timeline…</p>';

      try {
        const data = await fetchJSON('/api/presence_timeline?days=7');
        const rows = data.timeline || [];
        if (!rows.length) {
          container.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">No reflections yet in this window.</p>';
          return;
        }

        const maxTotal = Math.max(...rows.map(r => r.past + r.present + r.future)) || 1;
        const rowDiv = document.createElement('div');
        rowDiv.className = 'chart-row';

        rows.slice().reverse().forEach(r => {
          const total = r.past + r.present + r.future || 1;
          const scale = 110 / maxTotal;

          const bar = document.createElement('div');
          bar.className = 'bar';

          [['future','future'], ['present','present'], ['past','past']].forEach(([key, cls]) => {
            if (r[key] > 0) {
              const seg = document.createElement('div');
              seg.className = 'seg ' + cls;
              seg.style.height = (r[key] * scale) + 'px';
              seg.title = `${key}: ${r[key]}`;
              bar.appendChild(seg);
            }
          });

          const col = document.createElement('div');
          col.appendChild(bar);

          const label = document.createElement('div');
          label.className = 'day-label';
          label.textContent = r.day.slice(5);
          col.appendChild(label);

          rowDiv.appendChild(col);
        });

        container.innerHTML = '';
        container.appendChild(rowDiv);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        container.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Could not load timeline.</p>';
      }
    }

    async function loadPulses() {
      const box = document.getElementById('pulse-table');
      box.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Loading pulses…</p>';
      try {
        const data = await fetchJSON('/api/pulses?days=7');
        const pulses = data.pulses || [];
        if (!pulses.length) {
          box.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">No nightly pulses recorded yet.</p>';
          return;
        }

        let html = `
          <table>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Date</th>
                <th>Past</th>
                <th>Present</th>
                <th>Future</th>
                <th>Trend</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
        `;

        pulses.forEach(p => {
          let tag = '';
          if (p.present >= p.past && p.present >= p.future) {
            tag = '<span class="tag-present">more present</span>';
          } else if (p.future > p.past) {
            tag = '<span class="tag-future">future-heavy</span>';
          } else {
            tag = '<span class="tag-past">past-heavy</span>';
          }

          html += `
            <tr>
              <td>${p.day}</td>
              <td>${p.past}</td>
              <td>${p.present}</td>
              <td>${p.future}</td>
              <td>${tag}</td>
            </tr>
          `;
        });

        html += '</tbody></table>';
        box.innerHTML = html;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        box.innerHTML = '<p class="sub">Could not load pulses.</p>';
      }
    }

    document.getElementById('refresh-today').addEventListener('click', () => {
      loadToday();
    });

    // initial load
    loadToday();
    loadTimeline();
    loadPulses();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```js
async function loadHeart() {

}
```

## 4️⃣ Step 2 – Backend brain (Node + SQLite)

**File:** `server.js`

```js
// AUMNITY v0.3 core server
// Organ focus:
// - Phase 1: Core DB (life entries + config)
// - Phase 2: Progress / Reflection organs
// - Phase 3: Energy "pulse" / summary
// - Phase 4: Configurable thresholds and toggles
// - Phase 5: Placeholder field for planetary context (astro layer later)

const express = require('express');
const path = require('path');
const bodyParser = require('body-parser');
const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose();

const app = express();

// === 0. BASIC CONFIG ===
// You can change PORT here or via environment variable.
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// DB file name (created automatically if missing)
const DB_FILE = path.join(__dirname, 'aum_db.sqlite');

// === 1. MIDDLEWARE ===
app.use(bodyParser.json());
app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));

// === 2. DATABASE INITIALISATION ===
const db = new sqlite3.Database(DB_FILE);

// Create tables if they don't exist
db.serialize(() => {
  // Main life log: one table for all kinds of entries.
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      date TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- YYYY-MM-DD
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'progress' | 'reflection' | 'voice' | 'learning' | 'habit'
      title TEXT,                         -- short label
      body TEXT,                          -- longer text
      energy INTEGER,                     -- -5 to +5 (your daily pulse impression)
      tags TEXT,                          -- comma-separated tags
      planetary_context TEXT,             -- JSON string (future: dasha / house info)
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `);

  // Config key-value store (JSON values as strings)
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `);
});

// Helper to run DB queries with Promise (for cleaner code)
function runAsync(sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.run(sql, params, function (err) {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve(this); // has 'lastID' and 'changes'
    });
  });
}

function allAsync(sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.all(sql, params, (err, rows) => {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve(rows);
    });
  });
}

function getAsync(sql, params = []) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    db.get(sql, params, (err, row) => {
      if (err) return reject(err);
      resolve(row);
    });
  });
}

// === 3. API ROUTES ===

// 3.1 Health check
app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'ok', message: 'AUMNITY core server is running.' });
});

// 3.2 Create a new entry (progress / reflection / voice / learning / habit)
app.post('/api/entries', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const {
      date,            // required
      kind,            // required
      title = '',
      body = '',
      energy = null,
      tags = '',
      planetaryContext = null
    } = req.body;

    if (!date || !kind) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'date and kind are required' });
    }

    const stmt = await runAsync(
      `
      INSERT INTO entries (date, kind, title, body, energy, tags, planetary_context)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `,
      [
        date,
        kind,
        title,
        body,
        energy,
        tags,
        planetaryContext ? JSON.stringify(planetaryContext) : null
      ]
    );

    res.json({
      id: stmt.lastID,
      date,
      kind,
      title,
      body,
      energy,
      tags,
      planetaryContext
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error inserting entry:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.3 Get entries list (by date range and/or kind)
app.get('/api/entries', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { from, to, kind } = req.query;

    let sql = `SELECT * FROM entries WHERE 1=1`;
    const params = [];

    if (from) {
      sql += ` AND date >= ?`;
      params.push(from);
    }
    if (to) {
      sql += ` AND date <= ?`;
      params.push(to);
    }
    if (kind) {
      sql += ` AND kind = ?`;
      params.push(kind);
    }

    sql += ` ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC`;

    const rows = await allAsync(sql, params);
    res.json(rows);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching entries:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.4 Daily summary (pulse)
app.get('/api/summary/daily', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { date } = req.query;
    if (!date) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'date is required (YYYY-MM-DD)' });
    }

    // Count per kind
    const counts = await allAsync(
      `
      SELECT kind, COUNT(*) as count
      FROM entries
      WHERE date = ?
      GROUP BY kind
      `,
      [date]
    );

    // Average energy
    const energyRow = await getAsync(
      `
      SELECT AVG(energy) as avg_energy
      FROM entries
      WHERE date = ?
      `,
      [date]
    );

    res.json({
      date,
      counts,
      avgEnergy: energyRow && energyRow.avg_energy !== null
        ? Number(energyRow.avg_energy).toFixed(2)
        : null
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching daily summary:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.5 Config: get all keys
app.get('/api/config', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rows = await allAsync(`SELECT key, value FROM config`, []);
    // Parse JSON where possible
    const obj = {};
    rows.forEach(row => {
      try {
        obj[row.key] = JSON.parse(row.value);
      } catch {
        obj[row.key] = row.value;
      }
    });
    res.json(obj);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error reading config:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.6 Config: set a key
app.post('/api/config', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { key, value } = req.body;
    if (!key) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'key is required' });
    }

    const stored = JSON.stringify(value);

    await runAsync(
      `
      INSERT INTO config (key, value)
      VALUES (?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value = excluded.value
      `,
      [key, stored]
    );

    res.json({ key, value });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error writing config:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// === 4. START SERVER ===
app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`AUMNITY core server running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
});
```

### What organs this implements

- **Core memory organ**  
  `entries` table: all daily progress / reflection / voice logs live here.

- **Pulse / feedback organ**  
  `/api/summary/daily` gives per-kind counts + average energy.

- **Config organ**  
  `/api/config` and `/api/config` (POST) hold thresholds, toggles, etc.  

- **Future astro organ placeholder**  
  `planetary_context` column lets us attach e.g. `{ md: "Mercury", ad: "Venus" }` later.

**File:** `aum_schema.sql` (just documentation; not required to run)

```sql
-- AUMNITY v0.3 schema (for reference)

CREATE TABLE entries (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  date TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT,
  body TEXT,
  energy INTEGER,
  tags TEXT,
  planetary_context TEXT,
  created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE config (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

If you want to recreate DB from scratch:

```bash
rm aum_db.sqlite
sqlite3 aum_db.sqlite < aum_schema.sql
```
