### 6.3 `public/app.js`

```js
// AUMNITY v0.3 front-end logic
// Maps UI <-> server API
// Organs:
// - Entry form = your daily "voice"
// - Summary view = pulse mirror
// - Config form = thresholds/toggles organ

async function apiGet(path) {
  const res = await fetch(path);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`GET ${path} failed: ${res.status}`);
  return res.json();
}

async function apiPost(path, body) {
  const res = await fetch(path, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`POST ${path} failed: ${res.status}`);
  return res.json();
}

// Helper: format date to YYYY-MM-DD
function toYMD(date) {
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const today = toYMD(new Date());

  // --- DOM references ---

  // Entry form
  const entryForm = document.getElementById('entry-form');
  const entryDate = document.getElementById('entry-date');
  const entryKind = document.getElementById('entry-kind');
  const entryTitle = document.getElementById('entry-title');
  const entryEnergy = document.getElementById('entry-energy');
  const entryTags = document.getElementById('entry-tags');
  const entryBody = document.getElementById('entry-body');

  // Summary
  const summaryDate = document.getElementById('summary-date');
  const summaryRefresh = document.getElementById('summary-refresh');
  const summaryOutput = document.getElementById('summary-output');

  // Entries list
  const entriesFrom = document.getElementById('entries-from');
  const entriesTo = document.getElementById('entries-to');
  const entriesKind = document.getElementById('entries-kind');
  const entriesRefresh = document.getElementById('entries-refresh');
  const entriesList = document.getElementById('entries-list');

  // Config
  const configForm = document.getElementById('config-form');
  const cfgDailyEnergyTarget = document.getElementById('cfg-daily-energy-target');
  const cfgWeeklyReflectionTarget = document.getElementById('cfg-weekly-reflection-target');
  const cfgEnableProgress = document.getElementById('cfg-enable-progress');
  const cfgEnableVoice = document.getElementById('cfg-enable-voice');
  const configStatus = document.getElementById('config-status');

  // Initialise default dates
  entryDate.value = today;
  summaryDate.value = today;
  entriesFrom.value = today;
  entriesTo.value = today;

  // --- Load initial data ---
  loadDailySummary();
  loadEntries();
  loadConfig();

  // --- Event handlers ---

  // 1) Save new entry
  entryForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = {
        date: entryDate.value,
        kind: entryKind.value,
        title: entryTitle.value.trim(),
        body: entryBody.value.trim(),
        energy: entryEnergy.value ? Number(entryEnergy.value) : null,
        tags: entryTags.value.trim()
      };

      await apiPost('/api/entries', payload);

      // Reset minimal fields
      entryTitle.value = '';
      entryBody.value = '';
      entryTags.value = '';
      entryEnergy.value = '';

      // Refresh summary and list
      loadDailySummary();
      loadEntries();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to save entry.');
    }
  });

  // 2) Refresh daily summary
  summaryRefresh.addEventListener('click', () => {
    loadDailySummary();
  });

  // 3) Load entries with filters
  entriesRefresh.addEventListener('click', () => {
    loadEntries();
  });

  // 4) Save config
  configForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const updates = [
        {
          key: 'daily_energy_target',
          value: cfgDailyEnergyTarget.value
            ? Number(cfgDailyEnergyTarget.value)
            : null
        },
        {
          key: 'weekly_reflection_target',
          value: cfgWeeklyReflectionTarget.value
            ? Number(cfgWeeklyReflectionTarget.value)
            : null
        },
        {
          key: 'enable_progress',
          value: cfgEnableProgress.checked
        },
        {
          key: 'enable_voice',
          value: cfgEnableVoice.checked
        }
      ];

      for (const item of updates) {
        await apiPost('/api/config', item);
      }

      configStatus.textContent = 'Config saved.';
      setTimeout(() => (configStatus.textContent = ''), 2000);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to save config.');
    }
  });

  // --- Loaders ---

  async function loadDailySummary() {
    try {
      const date = summaryDate.value || today;
      const data = await apiGet(`/api/summary/daily?date=${encodeURIComponent(date)}`);

      if (!data || !data.counts) {
        summaryOutput.innerHTML = '<p>No data for this date.</p>';
        return;
      }

      let html = `<p><strong>Date:</strong> ${data.date}</p>`;
      html += `<p><strong>Average Energy:</strong> ${data.avgEnergy ?? 'N/A'}</p>`;
      html += '<ul>';
      data.counts.forEach(c => {
        html += `<li>${c.kind}: ${c.count}</li>`;
      });
      html += '</ul>';

      summaryOutput.innerHTML = html;
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      summaryOutput.innerHTML = '<p>Error loading summary.</p>';
    }
  }

  async function loadEntries() {
    try {
      const params = [];
      if (entriesFrom.value) params.push(`from=${encodeURIComponent(entriesFrom.value)}`);
      if (entriesTo.value) params.push(`to=${encodeURIComponent(entriesTo.value)}`);
      if (entriesKind.value) params.push(`kind=${encodeURIComponent(entriesKind.value)}`);

      const qs = params.length ? `?${params.join('&')}` : '';
      const rows = await apiGet(`/api/entries${qs}`);

      entriesList.innerHTML = '';

      if (!rows.length) {
        entriesList.innerHTML = '<li>No entries.</li>';
        return;
      }

      rows.forEach(row => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'entry-item';

        const kindClass = `kind-${row.kind}`;

        li.innerHTML = `
          <div class="entry-meta">
            <span>${row.date}</span>
            <span class="entry-kind ${kindClass}">${row.kind}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="entry-title">${row.title || '(no title)'}</div>
          <div>${row.body ? row.body : ''}</div>
          <div class="entry-meta">
            <span>Energy: ${row.energy ?? 'N/A'}</span>
            <span>Tags: ${row.tags || '-'}</span>
          </div>
        `;

        entriesList.appendChild(li);
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      entriesList.innerHTML = '<li>Error loading entries.</li>';
    }
  }

  async function loadConfig() {
    try {
      const cfg = await apiGet('/api/config');

      if (cfg.daily_energy_target != null) {
        cfgDailyEnergyTarget.value = cfg.daily_energy_target;
      }
      if (cfg.weekly_reflection_target != null) {
        cfgWeeklyReflectionTarget.value = cfg.weekly_reflection_target;
      }
      if (typeof cfg.enable_progress === 'boolean') {
        cfgEnableProgress.checked = cfg.enable_progress;
      }
      if (typeof cfg.enable_voice === 'boolean') {
        cfgEnableVoice.checked = cfg.enable_voice;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      // Silent fail is okay; config starts empty.
    }
  }
});
```

### 2.1 Extend `server.js` – add `reminders` table

Find this block in `server.js` (DB init):

```js
db.serialize(() => {
  // Main life log: one table for all kinds of entries.
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      date TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- YYYY-MM-DD
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'progress' | 'reflection' | 'voice' | 'learning' | 'habit'
      title TEXT,                         -- short label
      body TEXT,                          -- longer text
      energy INTEGER,                     -- -5 to +5 (your daily pulse impression)
      tags TEXT,                          -- comma-separated tags
      planetary_context TEXT,             -- JSON string (future: dasha / house info)
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `);

  // Config key-value store (JSON values as strings)
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `);
});
```

Replace it with this (adds `reminders`):

```js
db.serialize(() => {
  // Main life log: one table for all kinds of entries.
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      date TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- YYYY-MM-DD
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'progress' | 'reflection' | 'voice' | 'learning' | 'habit'
      title TEXT,                         -- short label
      body TEXT,                          -- longer text
      energy INTEGER,                     -- -5 to +5 (your daily pulse impression)
      tags TEXT,                          -- comma-separated tags
      planetary_context TEXT,             -- JSON string (future: dasha / house info)
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `);

  // Config key-value store (JSON values as strings)
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS config (
      key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      value TEXT NOT NULL
    )
  `);

  // Reminder definitions: AUMNITY-level reminders (not OS notifications).
  db.run(`
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reminders (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
      label TEXT NOT NULL,          -- e.g. "Night progress check-in"
      kind TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 'progress' | 'reflection' | 'voice' | 'learning' | 'habit'
      time TEXT NOT NULL,           -- "21:00" (24h format)
      enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,     -- 0 or 1
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    )
  `);
});
```

### 2.2 Add Reminder APIs in `server.js`

After the existing config routes (`/api/config` GET & POST), add:

```js
// 3.7 Reminders: list all
app.get('/api/reminders', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const rows = await allAsync(
      `SELECT id, label, kind, time, enabled FROM reminders ORDER BY time ASC`,
      []
    );
    res.json(rows);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error fetching reminders:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.8 Reminders: create or update
app.post('/api/reminders', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id, label, kind, time, enabled } = req.body;
    if (!label || !kind || !time) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'label, kind, time are required' });
    }

    const enabledFlag = enabled ? 1 : 0;

    if (id) {
      // Update existing
      await runAsync(
        `
        UPDATE reminders
        SET label = ?, kind = ?, time = ?, enabled = ?
        WHERE id = ?
        `,
        [label, kind, time, enabledFlag, id]
      );
      res.json({ id, label, kind, time, enabled: !!enabledFlag });
    } else {
      // Create new
      const stmt = await runAsync(
        `
        INSERT INTO reminders (label, kind, time, enabled)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        `,
        [label, kind, time, enabledFlag]
      );
      res.json({
        id: stmt.lastID,
        label,
        kind,
        time,
        enabled: !!enabledFlag
      });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error writing reminder:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});

// 3.9 Reminders: toggle enabled flag
app.post('/api/reminders/toggle', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const { id, enabled } = req.body;
    if (!id) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'id is required' });
    }
    const enabledFlag = enabled ? 1 : 0;
    await runAsync(
      `UPDATE reminders SET enabled = ? WHERE id = ?`,
      [enabledFlag, id]
    );
    res.json({ id, enabled: !!enabledFlag });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error toggling reminder:', err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
  }
});
```

🔎 **What this does**

- Lets you define **logical reminders** like:
  - “21:00 – progress – Night progress check-in”
  - “21:05 – reflection – One line about today’s feeling”
- They live in the **AUMNITY DB** (not in ChatGPT).
- Later, a small script (or you manually) can read them and trigger notifications on any device.

I’m not scheduling real OS notifications here (I can’t control your laptop), but:

Add event handler:

```js
  // 5) Save reminder
  remForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    try {
      const payload = {
        id: currentReminderId,
        label: remLabel.value.trim(),
        kind: remKind.value,
        time: remTime.value,
        enabled: remEnabled.checked
      };

      await apiPost('/api/reminders', payload);

      // Reset form
      currentReminderId = null;

      remEnabled.checked = true;

      loadReminders();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Failed to save reminder.');
    }
  });
```

And define the loader:

```js
  async function loadReminders() {
    try {
      const rows = await apiGet('/api/reminders');
      remList.innerHTML = '';

      if (!rows.length) {
        remList.innerHTML = '<li>No reminders defined.</li>';
        return;
      }

      rows.forEach(row => {
        const li = document.createElement('li');
        li.className = 'entry-item';

        li.innerHTML = `
          <div class="entry-meta">
            <span>${row.time}</span>
            <span class="entry-kind kind-${row.kind}">${row.kind}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="entry-title">${row.label}</div>
          <div class="entry-meta">
            <span>Enabled: ${row.enabled ? 'Yes' : 'No'}</span>
            <button data-id="${row.id}" data-enabled="${row.enabled ? 1 : 0}" class="rem-toggle">
              ${row.enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'}
            </button>
          </div>
        `;

        remList.appendChild(li);
      });

      // Attach toggle handlers
      remList.querySelectorAll('.rem-toggle').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          const id = Number(btn.getAttribute('data-id'));
          const current = btn.getAttribute('data-enabled') === '1';
          try {
            await apiPost('/api/reminders/toggle', {
              id,
              enabled: !current
            });
            loadReminders();
          } catch (err) {
            console.error(err);
            alert('Failed to toggle reminder.');
          }
        });
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      remList.innerHTML = '<li>Error loading reminders.</li>';
    }
  }
```

No CSS change is strictly required; it reuses `.entry-item` styling.
